jobs.title: Ryhmäliikunnanohjaaja – tule Verden tuuraajatiimiin
jobs.description:
Etsimme Kuntokeskus Verdeen innostavia ja luotettavia ryhmäliikunnanohjaajia tuuraustehtäviin.

**Haluaisitko ohjata ryhmäliikuntaa joustavasti oman aikataulusi mukaan?** Verden tuuraajatiimissä voit ottaa vastaan vapaita tunteja silloin, kun ne sopivat sinulle. Tuuraustyö sopii hyvin esimerkiksi muun työn tai opiskelun rinnalle sekä liikunta-alan yrittäjälle.

**Mitä työ sisältää?**

Verdessä järjestetään ryhmäliikuntaa seitsemänä päivänä viikossa. Tuntivalikoimaamme kuuluu muun muassa lihaskuntoharjoittelua, pumppia, kuntopiiriä, zumbaa ja sisäpyöräilyä.

Kevät- ja syyskaudella järjestämme noin 20 ryhmäliikuntatuntia viikossa maanantaista sunnuntaihin. Vakituisten ohjaajiemme rinnalle etsimme uusia tuuraajia esimerkiksi sairastumisten ja muiden poissaolojen varalle.

Voit ottaa tuurauksia vastaan oman aikataulusi ja tilanteesi mukaan. Hyvin sujuneiden tuurausten kautta voi myöhemmin avautua mahdollisuus myös omiin vakituisiin tunteihin.

Kenelle työ sopii?

Toivomme sinulta liikunta-alan koulutusta ja/tai kokemusta ryhmäliikunnan ohjaamisesta. Ennen kaikkea etsimme ohjaajia, jotka nauttivat ihmisten kohtaamisesta ja osaavat luoda tunnille kannustavan ja hyvän ilmapiirin.

Asiakkaamme ovat pääasiassa noin 30–50-vuotiaita aikuisia, joista monet liikkuvat säännöllisesti. Meille on tärkeää, että jokainen voi tulla tunnille omana itsenään ja saada onnistumisen kokemuksia omasta lähtötasostaan riippumatta.

**Saatat sopia joukkoomme, jos**

- sinulla on koulutusta tai kokemusta ryhmäliikunnan ohjaamisesta

- olet energinen, kannustava ja luotettava

- viihdyt erilaisten ihmisten parissa

- haluat tehdä ohjaustyötä joustavasti muun elämäsi rinnalla.


Työ sopii hyvin myös esimerkiksi toiminimiyrittäjälle.

jobs.title: Management Support Role to Service Operations - At the Heart of the Nordic Power System
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by supporting highly skilled engineers and contributing to the secure operation of the Nordic power system? Do you thrive in an environment where operational reliability, collaboration, and continuous improvement are essential?

At the Nordic Regional Coordination Centre, in the Service Operations department, you will work closely with a team of engineers delivering critical services to the Nordic Transmission System Operators around the clock. In the role, you will act as a daily sparring partner and facilitator for the engineering team, helping ensure effective coordination between control center duties and development activities outside the operator chair.

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the security of supply and the Nordic green energy transition, while supporting the development of engineers working in a highly specialized operational environment.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time.

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Right now, we are looking for a management support role who would like to make a difference!

Job description:

You would be supporting an engineering team that works in a hybrid setup, combining:

  • Operator-on-shift roles in the Nordic RCC coordination centre, supporting Nordic TSOs around the clock

  • Work outside the operational shift including projects, operational follow-up, and continuous improvement activities

Your primary focus will be daily coordination, professional sparring, and supporting the development of effective structures and ways of working across the team, supporting and facilitating the performance of these roles.

You will NOT be part of the Operator on-shift roster, who is performing the coordination centre tasks and services 24/7.

The position does not initially include formal personnel management, as the engineers in the setup today report directly to the Head of Department in Service Operations. You will work closely with the Head of Department on topics like department structure and set-up, and by providing day-to-day coordination and operational support, as well as mentoring and sparring on subject matter topics with the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Driving department strategy and development in collaboration with the Head of Department (HoD) supporting effective coordination between coordination centre duties and non-operational activities, both within the team and externally towards other departments

  • Facilitating knowledge sharing, supporting and securing continuous training and collaboration

  • Supporting engineers in their professional development, and acting as a sparring partner, particularly those early in their careers

  • Identifying opportunities to improve structures, processes, and operational workflows

  • Supporting planning, prioritization, and follow-up across shifts, projects, and operational tasks

  • Contributing to continuous improvement of service quality and operational efficiency as well as securing the level of contingency and business continuity

  • The role will include sharing of responsibilities as part of 3rd line support with Head of Department as the department runs 24/7 operational services

Requirements:

You bring experience from a technical or operational environment and enjoy supporting the development and collaboration of highly skilled professionals.

We expect that you:

  • Have experience working in a technical, operational, or knowledge-intensive organization

  • Demonstrate strong ability to mentor, support, and collaborate with technical specialists

  • Have experience identifying and improving structures, processes, and ways of working

  • Are comfortable working in a complex environment with the responsibility of 24/7 operational services

  • Communicate clearly and effectively across technical and organizational boundaries

Additional beneficial competencies include:

  • Experience from the power system, electrical infrastructure, or energy sector

  • Engineering or technical background

  • Experience working in control centre or operational environments

  • Familiarity with organizations delivering 24/7operational services

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.

What we offer

You will be joining a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently 25 nationalities with over 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We offer workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance, including the possibility to work from home some of the time. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note, that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than September 13th  2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include a photograph in your CV or any other materials.

jobs.title: Salgs- og rekrutteringskonsulent til JWC Staffing Agency
jobs.description:
Salgs- og rekrutteringskonsulent til JWC Staffing Agency

30 timer om ugen – med mulighed for fuldtid

Har du et skarpt salgsgen, trives med en travl hverdag og motiveres af at skabe resultater gennem stærke relationer?

Hos JWC Staffing Agency søger vi en engageret salgs- og rekrutteringskonsulent, der vil være med til at udvikle vores forretning og sikre de bedste medarbejdere til byggebranchen.

Du bliver en nøglespiller i vores fortsatte vækst, hvor du får ansvaret for både at udvikle vores kundeportefølje og sikre en professionel rekrutteringsproces fra første kontakt til medarbejderen er godt i gang hos kunden.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du får en alsidig hverdag, hvor salg, rekruttering og koordinering går hånd i hånd.

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:

· Opsøge og udvikle nye kunder inden for bygge- og anlægsbranchen.

· Vedligeholde og udvikle eksisterende kunderelationer.

· Planlægge og koordinere rekrutteringsforløb fra start til slut.

· Udarbejde og publicere stillingsopslag.

· Aktivt søge efter kandidater via jobportaler, sociale medier, og netværk.

· Gennemføre telefoninterviews, jobsamtaler og kandidatvurderinger.

· Koordinere ansættelser, onboarding og opfølgning.

· Arbejde målrettet med salgsbudgetter, pipeline og KPI'er.

Vi forestiller os, at du

· Har erfaring med salg – gerne inden for byggebranchen eller bemandingsbranchen.

· Trives i en hverdag med højt tempo og mange forskellige opgaver.

· Er en dygtig relationsskaber og kommunikerer naturligt med både kunder og kandidater.

· Arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket – også når tempoet er højt.

· Er selvstændig, initiativrig og tager ansvar for dine opgaver.

· Motiveres af at skabe resultater og nå dine mål.

· Taler - forstår og skriver dansk og kan begå dig på engelsk.

Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du har erfaring fra byggebranchen eller selv har en håndværksmæssig baggrund.

Vi tilbyder

Hos os får du ikke bare et job – du bliver en del af en virksomhed i udvikling, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

Hvem er vi?

JWC Staffing Agency leverer vikar- og rekrutteringsløsninger til bygge- og anlægsbranchen i hele Danmark.

Vi er en ung virksomhed med store ambitioner. Selvom JWC Staffing Agency er en relativt ny virksomhed, består vores team af medarbejdere med mange års erfaring inden for bemandings- og byggebranchen. Derfor bygger vores samarbejde på værdier som ordentlighed, troværdighed og professionalisme.

Hos os bliver du en del af et mindre team med højt humør, en uformel omgangstone og stor respekt for hinandens kompetencer. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, og derfor arbejder vi ud fra filosofien: "Vi løfter i flok."

Hos os er kolleger ikke konkurrenter. Vi deler viden, hjælper hinanden og fejrer succeserne sammen. Den kultur afspejler sig både i vores daglige samarbejde og i vores bonusstruktur.

Vi har kontorer i Kolding og Odense, og denne stilling har primær arbejdsplads i Odense.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Human-Centered Interactive AI Agents for Maritime Simulator Training
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0About the position

The maritime industry faces increasing demands for safe and efficient operations due to growing traffic, more complex vessels, and higher safety requirements. Simulator-based training is essential for preparing maritime professionals, but it relies heavily on experienced human instructors, whose availability is limited.

Recent advances in artificial intelligence, especially large language models (LLMs), enable the development of interactive AI agents that can support human learning in complex, safety-critical environments. Human-centered AI in this project means that the agent will learn from simulator data and expert knowledge, and will be designed to work collaboratively with trainees and instructors rather than replacing them. The AI agents will leverage LLMs for knowledge acquisition, natural language interaction, and decision support, while integrating simulator data and multimodal inputs to provide timely guidance, feedback, and post-training analysis.

This PhD project aims to develop human-centered interactive AI agents for maritime simulator training. The research will investigate how LLM-driven agents can perceive and interpret dynamic maritime environments, collaborate with human trainees during simulator sessions, provide transparent explanations for their actions, and adapt their support to individual training needs

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Set up research plans with the help of the supervision team and conduct them accordingly
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Take lead in research idea generation and research paper writing
  • Collaborate closely with other PhD candidates and project partners to share knowledge, integrate findings, and coordinate research activities
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in computer science, automation, maritime-related engineering or equivalent. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at master's level. Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position.
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you maybe considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme in Engineering

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions and Regulations for the degrees philosophiae doctor (ph.d.) and philosophiae doctor (ph.d.) in artistic development work at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • You demonstrate a strong motivation for the position
  • You have experience of LLM and and related applications, preferably in maritime-relevant projects
  • You demonstrate knowledge/experience in AI and data-driven approaches

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently as well as in a cross disciplinary team
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback 
  • Show enthusiasm and a strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • Communicate well in English

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. (delete if not applicable)


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 550 800,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Houxiang Zhang, email: hozh@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact PhD Coordinator Lara Bromann, e-mail: lara.bromann@ntnu.no

Application deadline: 20.09.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage.

jobs.title: 2 Närvårdare inom äldreomsorgen
jobs.description:
Vi söker nu två engagerade närvårdare till Saltviks kommuns äldreomsorg, med aktuell placering på våra demensenheter Viken och Udden på Sunnanberg vårdhem. Här får du arbeta nära människor med demenssjukdom i en trygg, hemlik miljö där personcentrerad vård, delaktighet och livskvalitet står i fokus.

Sunnanberg vårdhem ligger i Kvarnbo och erbjuder långvarigt serviceboende med heldygnsomsorg. Verksamheten består av tre enheter med totalt 32 platser. Viken och Udden är särskilt inriktade på vård och omsorg för personer med demenssjukdom, medan Fyren erbjuder vård för personer med andra omfattande omsorgsbehov.

Hos oss är ingen dag den andra lik. Du blir en viktig del av ett engagerat team som tillsammans skapar trygghet, glädje och meningsfulla dagar för våra boende. Vi tror på att se människan bakom sjukdomen och att ta tillvara varje individs resurser, vanor och önskemål.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som närvårdare ansvarar du tillsammans med dina kollegor för att ge en trygg, professionell och personcentrerad vård. Arbetet omfattar bland annat att:

- planera och utföra individuellt anpassade vård- och omsorgsinsatser

- skapa trygghet, struktur och meningsfulla aktiviteter i vardagen

- stärka och bevara den boendes egna resurser och självständighet

- samarbeta med kollegor, anhöriga och andra yrkesgrupper

- utföra medicinska arbetsuppgifter enligt delegering.


Vi söker dig som

- är utbildad närvårdare och registrerad i Valvira

- gärna har erfarenhet av eller intresse för demensvård

- är trygg, lyhörd och har ett respektfullt bemötande

- uppskattar samarbete och bidrar till ett gott arbetsklimat

- kan arbeta självständigt och ta ansvar

- har goda kunskaper i svenska, både muntligt och skriftligt, samt grundläggande datavana.


Därför ska du välja Saltviks kommun:

Vi vill att våra medarbetare ska trivas och utvecklas. Hos oss får du:

- ett varierande och meningsfullt arbete

- engagerade kollegor och ett nära samarbete i arbetsgruppen

- möjlighet att utvecklas inom demensvård

- utökad företagshälsovård

- friskvårdsförmån med massage, kultur och motion till ett värde av 400 euro per år

- lön och övriga anställningsvillkor enligt AKTA.


Anställningsvillkor

Arbetet är periodarbete. Anställningen inleds med sex månaders prövotid. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Vill du veta mer?

- Omvårdnadsledare Malin Häggblom, tel. 431 641, malin.haggblom@saltvik.ax

Au sein d'un environnement Supply Chain Optimization (4PL), vous intervenez sur un périmètre stratégique visant à piloter et optimiser les opérations de transport multimodal, avec une dominante route.

Rémunération selon profil.

jobs.title: Front of House Manager – Diamond Slice
jobs.description:
Front of House Manager – Diamond Slice

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark (Nørrebro)

Position: Full-Time (37 hours / week)

Salary: 28,000 – 35,000 DKK / month (based on experience)

Start Date: As soon as we find the right candidate

About Diamond Slice

At Diamond Slice, we bring proper New York slice shop culture to Copenhagen. We elevate the humble slice with high-hydration sourdough, top-tier seasonal local ingredients, natural wines, craft beers, and cocktails—all served in a fast-paced, high-energy, welcoming neighborhood environment.  We pride ourselves on exceptional quality, great hospitality, and an unpretentious vibe.

We are growing and looking for a driven Front of House Manager to lead our floor operations, nurture our team culture, and deliver outstanding guest experiences.

The Role & Key Responsibilities

As FOH Manager, you will take ownership of the day-to-day guest experience, lead shift execution, and serve as a key operational anchor for both our daily service and special events.

  • FOH Leadership & Experience: Take ownership of the Front of House, ensuring smooth service flow, excellent atmosphere, and high operational standards.

  • Team Coaching & Motivation: Train, mentor, and inspire the FOH team to build a high-performing, friendly, and efficient service squad.

  • Guest Communication: Serve as the primary face and voice for guest interactions, handling feedback, special requests, and inquiries with warmth and professionalism.

  • Festivals & Events Logistics: Play a central, hands-on role in planning and executing logistics for outdoor festivals, pop-ups, and special catering events.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for an experienced hospitality leader who takes initiative, and thrives with autonomy.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of experience in hospitality (with proven leadership or supervisory experience preferred).

  • Autonomy & Problem Solving: Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership to solve operational challenges independently.

  • Assertive Communication: Unafraid to speak up, bring issues to the table, and constructively challenge the status quo to make operations better.

  • Feedback Culture: Skilled and comfortable with both giving and receiving direct, constructive feedback with colleagues and leadership.

  • Guest-Centric Mindset: Genuinely loves host culture, high-energy environments, and personal interactions with guests.

  • Schedule Availability: Fully comfortable working evenings, weekends, and peak service hours.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation: 28,000 – 35,000 DKK / month, aligned with your experience.

  • Flexible Schedule: High degree of scheduling flexibility, provided operations run smoothly and team coverage is secure.

  • Autonomous Role: Real freedom to shape FOH operations and make your mark on our growing brand.

  • Great Culture: A fast-paced, supportive, and passionate workplace with high standards and great pizza.

How to Apply

Ready to join the Diamond Slice team?

Please submit your CV along with a short introduction telling us about yourself and why you'd be a great fit for Diamond Slice to: work@diamondslice.dk

Note! Applications must include: "Diamond Slice FOH Manager" in the subject line to be considered.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we will hire as soon as we find the right candidate.

jobs.title: PhD in modelling state shifts and transient population dynamics of iconic alpine birds
jobs.description:
This is Nord University

Would you like to help create knowledge that makes a difference? At Nord University, we develop future solutions through education, research, and collaboration with the society around us.

Together, we shape the future with roots in the North and our eyes on what lies ahead.

Nord in the world - knowledge for the future.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KWoZi6o-EB4About the position

The Faculty of Biosciences and Aquaculture at Nord University, Norway, invites applications from outstanding candidates for a three-year PhD position in alpine ecosystems.

Ecosystems are currently facing rapid transformation all over the world. In alpine ecosystems, it is well known that climate change have a strong influence on the system dynamics, often in synergy with other human-caused perturbations to the system. Under periods with rapid environmental change, a key discussion in population ecology is connected to the potential existence of different (stable or unstable) states to which the system can be attracted. Such state-dependent dynamics is key to both basic and applied ecology. The PhD project will use both advanced statistical and mathematical modelling to enhance our understanding of state shifts and state-dependent population dynamics. The main objective is to understand better the key demographic and environmental that transition alpine bird populations from one state to another. The successful candidate will have access to extensive, long-term field data from alpine ecosystems in Norway, with the willow ptarmigan serving as the model species. Some fieldwork in scenic alpine environments should be expected.

The appointed candidate will be affiliated with the Ecology Research Division.

The position is offered for a three-year period and will be based in Steinkjer, Trøndelag, Norway.

The appointment is scheduled to commence on 1 January 2027, or on another date by mutual agreement.


Qualification requirements
  • A master’s degree in ecology or a closely related field is required.
  • An overall grade average of B or better (ECTS scale) is required for both the master’s degree programme and the master’s thesis for admission to the PhD programme.
  • Employment is conditional upon admission to the Faculty’s doctoral programme in Biosciences.
  • The final PhD project outline must be approved within three months of appointment. Failure to obtain admission, to submit required annual progress reports, or to demonstrate satisfactory progress or duty work may result in termination of the contract.
  • Good proficiency in written and spoken English is required.
  • The PhD thesis may be written in English or Norwegian (or another Scandinavian language).
  • See admission requirements: PhD in Biosciences

Desired Qualifications

  • Solid background in population ecology.
  • Good knowledge of natural resource management.
  • Working knowledge of the statistical software R.
  • Strong skills and/or a clear interest in mathematical and statistical modelling.
  • Ability and willingness to conduct fieldwork in remote alpine environments.
  • A proven record in scientific writing (e.g. peer‑reviewed publications) is an advantage, but not a prerequisite.

Candidates who already have a PhD degree will not be considered for the position.


Qualified applicants will be ranked according to the following criteria:
  • Theme and perspectives from the applicant’s master’s study. Project outline with description of project idea and plan for implementation
  • The applicant’s description of motivation for the doctoral work and opportunities for completion
  • Relevant experience from research work
  • Ability to work independently, goal-oriented and systematically
  • Personal suitability

We offer

The annual salary for doctoral researchers (code 1017) is NOK 565 000,-.

  • Advantages within the Government Pension Fund for loans, insurance and pension
  • Creative and collegial working environment
  • A workplace with progressive development
  • Flexible working hours  
  • Active university sports team

General information

The person who is appointed must abide by the applicable laws, agreements, and directives. The responsibilities and duties associated with the position may change with future reorganization at Nord University.

Nord University is subject to the Security Act, which sets requirements for the handling of classified and sensitive information. To increase security in the hiring process, Nord may conduct background checks on relevant candidates.

The public sector workforce is expected to reflect the diversity of the population in general. Nord University therefore encourages qualified candidates with disabilities, gaps in their CV, immigrant backgrounds or different life experience to apply. 

If applicants indicate they have disabilities or gaps in their CV, their details may be used anonymously for the purposes of governmental annual review.


For this position, Nord University is cautious about hiring individuals with connections to countries that PST has identified as key threat actors in its annual threat assessment. 


Application process

Applicants will be evaluated by an internal expert committee. Relevant applicants will be invited for an interview, trial lecture or other presentations. For more information, see Nord`s website .

The Faculty reserve the right not to hire applicants who may be scientifically qualified but who do not meet other criteria such as language, educational background or personal characteristics


Application

Applications must be submitted electronically by 04.09.2026

The application should include:

  • Application letter with description of your motivation for applying for the position
  • Complete CV (education, work and teaching experience and overview of any scientific publications)
  • Copy of diploma for both bachelor and master education and relevant certificates
  • Applicants with education from countries outside Scandinavia with diplomas issued in a language other than English, must enclose witnessed diplomas in both the original language and authorized English translations
  • Applicants from outside the EU/EEA must submit HK-dir approval of their master´s degree
  • Copy of the applicant’s master’s thesis
  • Name and contact information of 1-3 references (name, your relation to the person, email and phone number)
  • Other activity that is considered relevant for the position, and wishes to be taken into account in the assessment

All documents must be uploaded as attachments as a PDF files to the electronic application form.

It is the applicant's responsibility to submit the complete documentation within the deadline.

After the application period has expired a list of applicants will be published. Note that, in special cases, the identity of particular applicants to a position may be made public even when that applicant has requested that their application be processed confidentially. Applicants requesting an exemption from publication of their identity must explain their reasons for doing so in their application. In this case, advance notice will be given in the event of a decision to make any information about the applicant public.

Refnr. 30255479


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Through research, education and social engagement, Nord University contributes to the creation of a sustainable future.

In cooperation with society, business and industry in Northern and Central Norway, our 11,500 students and 1,350 staff promote innovative solutions and knowledge-based practice, both locally and internationally.

Nord University has four strategic focus areas: blue and green growth, sustainable innovation and entrepreneurship, societal security, and health, welfare and education.

Faculty of Biosciences and Aquaculture (FBA) educates people with the aim of promoting sustainable and innovative development to meet global challenges in food production, climate and environment. The faculty is an international arena for education, research and knowledge dissemination, with employees and students from 39 different countries. The faculty offers a PhD in Biosciences. FBA has 900 students and 165 employees in Bodø and Steinkjer. The professional community is organised into the following divisions: Aquaculture, Ecology, Genomics and Animal Science, Production and Welfare and Algae and microbial biotechnology.

jobs.title: Vi søger betonchauffør til Unicon Avedøre og Prøvestenen
jobs.description:
Der er chauffører - og der er Unicon chauffører 

Som betonchauffør er du andet og mere end bare en “ratholder”. Du er chaufførernes svar på Tom Kristensen og en ørn til at navigere under selv de trangeste forhold. Derudover kan du håndtere betonen, når den skal off-loades via båndet eller til en pumpechauffør, og du ved, hvordan man får en god dialog med de ansvarlige på pladsen, der modtager betonen.  

Der er dig, der sørger for, at betonen bliver leveret rigtigt og til tiden – og derfor også dig, der er respekt om, når folk får øje på den blå- og hvidstribede Unicon-bil. At være en del af holdet hos Unicon er noget ganske særligt, og det kræver, at du også er det.  

Vi arbejder tæt sammen i teams på de enkelte fabrikker og er der for hinanden, når der er brug for det. Og så har vi branchens bedste betingelser; med karrieremuligheder, fleksibilitet, betalt arbejdstøjsordning med vask, tryghed og gode forhold.  

Der er flere gode grunde til at blive chauffør hos Unicon:  

  • Vi har branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold 

  • Fleksibilitet for dig i forhold til vagter og arbejdssted 

  • Betalt arbejdstøjsordning, hvor vi også vasker tøjet for dig  

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder både fagligt og personligt og spændende karrieremuligheder 

  • En helt unik holdånd  

  • En grundig introduktion og oplæring i jobbet  

  • Gode arbejdsforhold. Unicon er medlem af Dansk Industri, som har overenskomst med 3F 

For at komme med på holdet kræver det, at... 

  • Du har stort kørekort inkl. hænger/trailer og EU-bevis

  • Du har fokus på din og andres sikkerhed  

  • Du er præsentabel og serviceminded, da du er vores ansigt udadtil 

  • Du har fysik til at rengøre og vedligeholde din betonbil 

  • Du kan holde orden omkring dig 

  • Det er en fordel, hvis du har krancertifikat samt erfaring fra bygge-/entreprenørbranchen

Du vil referere til fabrikkens daglige leder.

Hvis du vil med på holdet, så send os din ansøgning og CV hurtigst muligt. Såfremt du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte fabriksleder Michael Rud Larsen på telefon 40181421. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og ansætter, når vi har den rette kandidat.

Unicon Danmark tilbyder lige muligheder for alle og har aktivt fokus på at fremme et arbejdsmiljø, der er fri for diskrimination, og hvor medarbejdere behandles med værdighed og respekt. Vi diskriminerer ikke nogen medarbejder eller jobansøger baseret på race, etnicitet, nationalitet, herkomst, genetiske oplysninger, statsborgerskab, religion, alder, køn, kønsidentitet/udtryk, seksuel orientering, graviditet, civilstand, handicap eller andre beskyttede karakteristika efter gældende love eller regler. jobs.title: Data Engineer for the banking sector in Helsinki
jobs.description:
About the role

In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain observability solutions to provide end users with critical insights. You will work within a compact team focused on creating robust data flows and intuitive dashboards.

You are offered
- Independent and responsible role
- Support and guidance from your team and other colleagues
- A hybrid work model with up to 2 remote days per week
- Epassi lunch deduction

Work tasks

Together with your team, you will be responsible for the end-to-end development of monitoring views, from configuring diverse data sources to scripting automation and troubleshooting technical issues.
- Participate actively in team's own planning sessions, suggest improvements, and bring new ideas
- Co-operate with other technical experts and various other stakeholders
- Participate in implementation work and troubleshoot any technical issues on your own area

We are looking for

We are looking for person who has:
- Graduate degree in Computer Science, Telecommunication, or a related field
- Minimum 3 years of corresponding work experience
- Strong skills and knowledge of observability fundamentals including metrics, logs, and traces
- Skills with data source configuration from various sources such as Prometheus, InfluxDB, or AppDynamics
- Good knowledge of data visualization best practices and dashboard design (panels, rows, variables/templating, transformations)
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and provisioning
- Proficiency in JSON and scripting with Bash or Python
- Advanced analysis and troubleshooting skills
- Fluent English communication skills

It is meritorious if you have
- Hands-on experience with Splunk and/or AppDynamics
- Practical experience using PowerBI for statistical visualization
- Experience working in international projects using agile methodologies

For at least the first 6 months, you will work on an assignment for our client in the banking industry. A credit check will be conducted for the selected individual.

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Lärare inom småbarnspedagogik till Folkhälsans daghem i Hyvinge
jobs.description:
På Folkhälsan jobbar vi tillsammans för en god vardag för små och stora. Vi är en hälsofrämjande organisation och en familjevänlig arbetsplats, som arbetsgivare är vi flexibla och pålitliga. Vi jobbar aktivt för jämlikhet, värdesätter mångfald på vår arbetsplats och uppmuntrar personer med olika bakgrund och som tillhör olika minoriteter att söka jobb hos oss. Kom och jobba med oss!

Folkhälsan Välfärd Ab rekryterar en lärare inom småbarnspedagogik

till daghemmet i Hyvinge för en tillsvidareanställning. Arbetet är på heltid och inleds enligt överenskommelse under hösten 2026.

Hyvinge daghem är beläget centralt i Hyvinge med parker och natur på gångavstånd. Vi finns i samma byggnad som Svenska skolan i Hyvinge och har ett aktivt samarbete samt möjlighet att använda både gymnastiksal och slöjdsal i vår verksamhet. Tillsammans med Svenska skolan i Hyvinge bildar vi en helhet där barnens lärstig fortsätter naturligt från småbarnspedagogiken till grundläggande utbildningen. Välkommen att jobba för en svenskspråkig helhet på en språkö!

Vi erbjuder småbarnspedagogik och förskoleundervisning samt språkbadsinriktad verksamhet. Du tar dig smidigt till daghemmet med tåg eller buss.

Som lärare inom småbarnspedagogik ansvarar du för och planerar den pedagogiska verksamheten. Arbetet sker i en miljö med kunniga pedagoger samt andra sakkunniga. Du är teamledare för ditt arbetsteam. På daghemmet arbetar vi i enlighet med Grunderna för planen för småbarnspedagogik samt Folkhälsans handbok. Vi erbjuder dig en arbetsplats där du har möjlighet att påverka och utveckla ditt arbete. Förmågor så som kreativitet, samarbetsvilja, flexibilitet, kommunikation och hälsofrämjande arbetssätt värderas hos oss.

Behörighetsvillkor är behörighet enligt lagen om småbarnspedagogik (540/2018) eller enligt rådande övergångsbestämmelse (75 §): pedagogie kandidat (lärare inom småbarnspedagogik), lämplig yrkeshögskoleexamen eller tidigare motsvarande examen på institutnivå, t.ex. barnträdgårdslärare eller socialpedagog.

Vi erbjuder dig en inkluderande arbetsgemenskap där alla stöder varandra. Du får tillgång till olika personalförmåner (bl.a. företagshälsovård via Mehiläinen och ePassi-förmån) för att du skall må bra i ditt arbete, samt utbildningsdagar och sektorsspecifika utbildningar i Eduhouse för att få goda förutsättningar för att utvecklas professionellt. Lön enligt kollektivavtalet för den privata småbarnspedagogiken med möjlighet till personliga tillägg.
Den som väljs till arbetet bör uppvisa utdrag ur straffregistret enligt 6 § 2 mom. i straffregisterlagen samt tuberkulosutredning enligt 55 § i lagen om smittsamma sjukdomar. Folkhälsan är en rökfri arbetsplats.

Läs mer om oss här: [Hyvinge daghem - Folkhälsan](https://www.folkhalsan.fi/service/daghem/hyvinge-daghem) och följ oss gärna på Instagram för att se mer av vår verksamhet: [@hyvingedagis](https://www.instagram.com/hyvingedagis/)

För närmare information om jobbet kan du kontakta enhetschef Anna Holmgren per e-post, anna.holmgren@folkhalsan.fi , eller per telefon, +358 44 788 3670.

Vi önskar få din ansökan senast den 7.9.2026 kl. 14:00. Använd gärna det elektroniska ansökningsformuläret när du skickar in din ansökan. Vi intervjuar under ansökningstiden och platsen fylls genast då lämplig person hittas.

Vi ser fram emot att få höra mer om dig!

jobs.title: Kiertävä liikunnanohjaaja
jobs.description:
Loviisan kaupungin koulutuspalvelut hakee määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen ajalle 1.9.2026-4.6.2027 tai heti kun sopiva hakija löytyy, kiertävää liikunnanohjaajaa. Liikunnanohjaaja on liikunta-alan ammattilainen, joka työskentelee kaikissa Loviisan peruskouluissa (luokat 1-6 sekä esikoulut) erilaisissa ohjaustehtävissä Liikkuva koulu -hankkeessa. Liikunnallisuudesta, positiivisesta asenteesta ja hyvistä vuorovaikutustaidoista on hyötyä. Edellisellä hakukierroksella saapuneet hakemukset huomioidaan.

Hankekaudella edistetään opetussuunnitelman mukaista liikunnallista elämäntapaa yhteistyössä koulujen henkilöstön kanssa. Toimenpiteet vahvistavat koulujen arkea liikuntamyönteisemmäksi, jotta aktiivisuus koulupäivän aikana lisääntyy välitunneilla, oppitunneilla ja koulukerhoissa.

Odotamme hakijalta vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja sekä valmiuksia sopeutua nopeasti muuttuviin tilanteisiin. Arvostamme monialaista osaamista, oma-aloitteisuutta, joustavuutta sekä aktiivista, kehittämismyönteistä ja itsenäistä työotetta. Sujuva suomen ja ruotsin kielen taito on tehtävän hoitamisen edellytys kaksikielisessä ympäristössä.

Tarjoamme monipuolisen työn, osaavan, kokeneen ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön, nykyaikaiset työvälineet, kuntosali- sekä Epassi-henkilöstöetuuden.
Palkkaus ja palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyy KVTES mukaan ja viikoittainen työaika on 38 h 15 min.

Kelpoisuusehtona on alalle soveltuva koulutus ja kokemus lasten ja nuorten kanssa tehtävästä työstä. Tehtävästä suoriutuminen vaatii itsenäistä työotetta, kokemusta ryhmänohjauksesta sekä hyviä yhteistyötaitoja.

B-ajokortti sekä oman auton käyttö on välttämätön työn kannalta.

Työn kesto 1.9.2026-4.6.2027, 100 % työajalla.

Valitun henkilön on ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista esitettävä lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote sekä toimitettava hyväksyttävä lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan 30 päivän kuluessa työsuhteen alkamisesta.

Tehtävään ja hakuprosessiin liittyvissä kysymyksissä voit olla yhteydessä: liikuntakoordinaattori Karolina Hoviin puh. 050 382 7554 tai koulutuspäälikkö Auli Saariseen puh. 0440 555 332.

jobs.title: Junior Embedded Software / Payload Engineer
jobs.description:
Want to work within sustainability and drones? Looking to be part of an innovative, fast-growing Danish greentech company with global reach? Then Explicit might be the place for you. 

Our tech team is looking for a new colleague to help build and improve the electronics that turn our drones into precision measuring instruments. If you enjoy hands-on hardware work in a greentech environment and want real ownership over what you build, we want to hear from you. 

About the job 

You will be part of a small, talented tech team, responsible for designing, building and maintaining our fleet of custom UAV deployed across the world to help map critical emissions. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Developing payload firmware that communicates with our drone systems (MAVLink / DJI) and onboard gas instrumentation and other sensors. 

  • Helping to bring new sensor instruments from datasheet to bench to flight. 

  • Improving and fixing existing payloads, diagnose issues on the bench and through in-flight data, harden the firmware, and ship the fix. 

  • Building small interface and breakout PCBs in KiCad, from assembly and bringing it up through to your own revisions. 

  • Potential for CAD and other mechanical work, depending on your qualifications. 

About you 

  • A bachelor's degree or similar/higher in electronics, robotics, computer engineering, mechatronics, physics or similar. 

  • 1+ years of hands-on experience, from your studies, a project, or a job. 

  • Tinker with Arduino/Raspberry Pi type projects. 

  • Wired up and used Serial/UART, I²C, SPI, etc., not just read about them. 

  • Basic C/C++ (or Arduino) and a bit of Python. 

  • English at a professional level. 

Nice to have 

  • Curiosity about drones, sensors and physical measurements. 

  • PCB design/KiCad experience, with signal/noise integrity knowledge. 

  • CAD and/or mechanical knowledge. 

  • Python for log analysis and quick tooling. 

  • Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement. 

What we offer 

  • A permanent, full-time position in a fast-growing greentech company with real-world impact. 

  • Competitive benefits including paid pension, health insurance, parental leave and 6 weeks' holiday allowance. 

  • Real hardware ownership early on, with a senior engineer to learn from. 

  • A flat hierarchy where ideas are heard, initiative is encouraged, and responsibility comes early. 

  • A close-knit, supportive team that values collaboration, trust and learning. 

  • Work that measurably cuts industrial emissions. 

About Explicit 

Explicit ApS is a pioneering Danish engineering company specialising in drone-based emissions monitoring across the energy, maritime, waste management, and other industry sectors. We deliver reliable, transparent and actionable emissions data to some of the largest energy companies all over the world using our patented drone-based methodology. Every measurement depends on the payload the drone carries: the boards, firmware, and sensors. 

We are headquartered in Virum, Denmark, with offices in Norway, Germany and Australia. Our international team of around 30 colleagues brings together engineering, data and environmental expertise, united by a shared mission to make a difference in emissions monitoring. 

Practical information

jobs.title: Keittiön palveluvastaava, ABC Pitkälahti
jobs.description:
Primary location:
KUOPIO

ABC PITKÄLAHTI etsii nyt KEITTIÖN PALVELUVASTAAVAA vakituiseen kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen - ihan tavallisiin töihin, harvinaisen toimeliaaseen porukkaan

Sopimustunnit: keskimäärin 112,5 t / 3 viikkoa
Työ alkaa: sopimuksen mukaan

Työtä kuvataan usein korulauseilla, mutta meidän mielestämme tavallisuudessa ei ole mitään pahaa. Me Osuuskauppa PeeÄssällä sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä - eikä se tarkoita tylsää porukkaa, päinvastoin. Työ on hyvää ja sujuvaa arkea, jossa teemme muiden arjesta, ja välillä juhlastakin, vähän parempaa. Ja joskus juhlitaan itsekin. Jos työpaikkailmoitusten kliseet kyllästyttävät, tule meille ihan tavallisiin töihin.

ABC Pitkälahdessa halutaan tarjota liikkuville asiakkaille nopea ja helppo tauko savolaiseen, rennon lupsakkaan tyyliin. Palveluvastaavana olet mukana luomassa hyvää fiilistä ympärillesi ja varmistamassa, että asiakkaamme saavat sujuvaa ja lämminhenkistä palvelua, josta voimme olla yhdessä ylpeitä. Lisäksi huolehdit sujuvasta vuoron johtamisesta ja varmistat, että pääsemme porukalla yhteisiin tavoitteisiimme. Odotamme sinulta positiivisuutta, reipasta otetta työhösi ja halua tarjota asiakkaillemme unohtumattomia asiakaskokemuksia.

Pitkälahden liikennemyymäläpäällikön Miran sanoin: Meillä pääset joukkoon mukavaan ja rentoon, ja työhön, jossa todellakin jokainen päivä on erilainen. Itse puhun usein Apsin sykkeestä, joka itselleni antaa energiaa valtavasti jokaiseen päivääni. Työ on mielenkiintoista ja erilaisia työtehtäviä meidän asemallemme on paljon. Pääset kehittymään itse sekä kehittämään yksikkömme toimintaa ihanien työkavereiden kanssa.

Tämä työ sopii sinulle, jos olet ravintola-alan ammattilainen, jolla on kokemusta kannustavasta ja innostavasta lähijohtamisesta. Pidät langat käsissä myös silloin, kun ravintolassa riittää asiakkaita ja tekemistä. Johdat tiimiäsi omalla esimerkilläsi ja pidät huolta, että peukutettava asiakaspalvelu on arjessa keskiössä.

Tässä tehtävässä onnistut, kun:
- Hyödynnät työssä hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja valmennustaitojasi.
- Työskentelet sujuvasti suomen ja englannin kielellä.
- Sinulta löytyy vahvaa keittiöpuolen työkokemusta ja osaamista.
- Vuorotyö sopii sinulle.
- Haluat kehittää arjen tekemistä yhdessä tiimin kanssa.

Mitä se ihan tavallinen työ meillä on
- Henkilökuntaetuja: alennuksia ruoasta, juomasta, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista, pankkipalveluista ja monesta muusta mukavasta asiasta.
- Epassin etuja: jopa 250 € arvosta vuodessa.
- Tulospalkkaus: mahdollisuus ansaita ylimääräistä jopa kahden kuukauden palkan verran vuodessa.
- Rahaa: MaRaVa esihenkilöiden työehtosopimuksen palkkaryhmän 1 mukainen palkka, 2280 €/kk - 2476 €/kk kokemusvuosista riippuen. Lisät tuovat kivasti lisää ansioita. Ne maksetaan myös TES:n mukaisesti.
- Työpaikka, johon on kiva tulla ja olla. Esihenkilötiimissämme ei tarvitse pärjätä yksin - innostamme ja tuemme toinen toisiamme.
- Mahdollisuus oppia ja kehittyä omassa työssä. Jos sinulla on halua ja intoa, meillä voit kasvaa myös kohti uusia uramahdollisuuksia.

Jos tuntuu siltä, että tämä voisi olla sinun paikkasi, kuulemme sinusta mielellämme.

Hakuaika päättyy 16.8.2026. Ethän kuitenkaan jää odottelemaan viime hetkeen, sillä käsittelemme hakemuksia ja voimme edetä valinnoissa jo hakuaikana. Ensimmäinen haastattelukierros toteutetaan Teams-haastatteluna, joten pidäthän silmällä sähköpostiasi - mahdollinen haastattelukutsu saapuu sinne.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa ABC Pitkälahden liikennemyymäläpäällikkö Mira Myllynen, p. 050 446 0227. Jos kiinnostuksesi heräsi tai jokin asia mietityttää, ole rohkeasti yhteydessä - kysymällä se selviää!

Osuuskauppa PeeÄssä on yli 134 000 asiakasomistajan omistama palvelualan yritys Pohjois-Savossa. Tavoitteenamme on olla Parhaan Elämän Edelläkävijä Savossa. Meille se tarkoittaa merkityksellistä työtä, reilua työnantajuutta ja arjen sujuvuutta. Olemme ylpeitä siitä, että voimme tuottaa osuustoiminnallista hyötyä ja kehittää sitä jatkuvasti arvojemme mukaisesti: #tunteella, #toimeliaasti, #ylpeästi ja #yhdessä.

jobs.title: Rental sales agent / Kombinert Utleierepresentant MABI mobility
jobs.description:
Om rollen

Som bilutleieagent hos oss er du en nøkkelperson i kundeopplevelsen. Ditt oppdrag er enkelt, men viktig: At hver kunde forlater oss fornøyd og er glad for å komme tilbake.

Du jobber i et sammensveiset team hvor service er i fokus, og hvor du får en variert arbeidsdag fylt med både kundekontakt og praktiske elementer.

Dine oppgaver

I rollen vil du blant annet:

-Sørge for at bestilte biler er i topp stand før levering

-Motta og sjekke nye kjøretøy

-Utføre skadeinspeksjoner

-Vaske og klargjøre biler (innvendig og utvendig)

-Levere og hente biler mellom stasjoner

-Håndtere enkle administrative oppgaver

-Yte førsteklasses service til våre kunder

Dette er en fleksibel og praktisk jobb -- perfekt for de som liker å være på farten og ta ansvar.

Om oss

MABI mobility er et etablert svensk bilutleiefirma med stasjoner over hele landet. Vi tilbyr en moderne bilpark og setter alltid kunden i fokus.

Har du ingen tidligere erfaring? Ikke noe problem -- vi lærer deg opp!

Hvem er du?

Vi ser etter deg som:

-Har førerkort B (manuell girkasse)

-Snakker og skriver engelsk og norsk

-Har erfaring fra serviceyrker

-Er nøyaktig, ansvarsfull og løsningsorientert

-Trives i et fartsfylt miljø og kan håndtere stressende situasjoner

-Har en positiv holdning og et genuint kundefokus.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

MABI Mobility, er en del av Hedin Mobility Group -- en av Europas største bilforhandlere med virksomhet i 14 land.Siden vi startet vår bilutleievirksomhet i Stockholm i 1989, har vi vokst betydelig og er nå representert med 290 salgssteder og en flåte på 11 000 kjøretøy i Sverige, Belgia, Nederland, Sveits, Norge, Tyskland og Finland.

Vi har som mål å tilby den mest effektive servicen i en bærekraftig mobilitetsverden. Gjennom vår fleksibilitet, omtanke og kontinuerlige ambisjon setter vi standarden høyere enn våre konkurrenter. Vår evne til å tilpasse oss og vårt engasjement for kundeservice har drevet oss til å utfordre markedet, og vi har vokst fra å være en utfordrer til å bli en etablert aktør.Men det er nettopp utfordrermentaliteten som har drevet vår suksess og som fortsatt er kjernen i hvem vi er. Hos MABI er vi dedikert til å gjøre mobilitet tilgjengelig og bærekraftig for alle.

jobs.title: Autolakerer til Skovlunde
jobs.description:
Autolakerer søges til at få ridser og buler til at forsvinde!  

Har du styr på afdækning, slibning og spartling så bilerne står knivskarpe, før de ruller ind i kabinen? Kan du få selv de mest triste biler til at se ud som nye? Så er det dig, vi leder efter! 

Byens bilpleje.com er Danmarks førende virksomhed inden for kosmetisk klargøring af biler; herunder autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse samt udskiftning af autoglas - vi er bilbranchens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Byens bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og beskæftiger i dag over 400 medarbejdere. Hertil håndterer virksomheden mere end 200.000 biler om året..

Hvad skal du lave? 

  • Du bliver en del af et team af lakspecialister, der tryller buler og ridser væk. Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.: 
  • Du fixer buler, spartler, sliber og afdækker (sprøjtelakerer), Så bilerne står som nye 
  • Sikre topkvalitet på det udførte arbejde 
  • Selvom du styrer dine egen opgaver, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det 
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens 

Hvem er du? 

  • Du er en frisk type med humor, der elsker en god snak med kollegaerne over en kaffepause – men også en, der går op i kvalitet og finish. Vi leder efter dig, der: 
  • Har uddannelse eller erfaring som autolakerer 
  • Kan holde styr på opgaverne, selv når der er travlt 
  • Du evner at strukturere dine opgaver 
  • Har kørekort (B) – så du ikke behøver skubbe bilerne selv 
  • Elsker tempoet i en virksomhed, hvor ingen dage er helt ens 

Hvad får du? 

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer – vi betaler for talent! 
  • Gode kollegaer, der kan deres kram (og deler værkstedshistorier i pauserne) 
  • Markeds bedste redskaber/produkter at arbejde med 
  • Mulighed for udvikling 
  • En arbejdsplads med humor, godt humør og højt til loftet  
  • Overenskomst, pension og de fordele, du fortjener 

 Hvad gør du nu? 

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads! 

Vi holder samtaler løbende, fordi vi vil have den helt rigtige medarbejder med på holdet hurtigst muligt. Men hey – vi ved, at kvalitet tager tid, så vi venter gerne på den rette. 

Hvis du tænker: "Det dér job er som skabt til mig!" – så spild ikke tiden! Send din ansøgning afsted med det samme.  

Grundet GDPR-forordningen modtager vi ikke ansøgninger på mail, hvorfor disse ikke tages i betragtning. Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com. 

 Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Susanne Damgaard Petersen 30432854

jobs.title: ISA Creative søger 2 ambitiøse mødebookere – 20–30 timer om ugen
jobs.description:
ISA Creative søger 2 energiske og resultatorienterede mødebookere, som skal være med til at skabe nye kundemøder med danske virksomheder.

Stillingen er på 20–30 timer om ugen og foregår fra vores kontor på Stamholmen i Hvidovre.

Om rollen

Din vigtigste opgave bliver at kontakte danske virksomheder, identificere relevante behov og booke kvalificerede møder til vores digitale rådgivere og specialister.

Du skal ikke selv sælge eller levere hjemmesiderne.

Din opgave er at:

  • Kontakte potentielle kunder telefonisk

  • Tale med virksomhedsejere og beslutningstagere

  • Identificere virksomheder med et digitalt behov

  • Skabe interesse for ISA Creatives løsninger

  • Booke kvalificerede salgsmøder

  • Registrere aktivitet og opfølgning i vores CRM

Vi leverer leads, systemer, træning, scripts og produktviden.

Hvad sælger ISA Creative?

ISA Creative hjælper virksomheder med blandt andet:

  • Websites og landing pages

  • Branding og visuel identitet

  • SEO og digital synlighed

  • AI Visibility / AEO / GEO

  • Leadgenerering

  • Content, foto og video

  • Digitale vækstløsninger

Mødebookeren skal ikke være specialist på disse områder. Du skal kunne skabe en god dialog, stille de rigtige spørgsmål og få den relevante beslutningstager til at tage et møde med vores eksperter.

Hvem søger vi?

Vi leder efter personer, som:

  • Er komfortable med telefonen

  • Har energi og et højt aktivitetsniveau

  • Kommunikerer professionelt på dansk

  • Er udadvendte og vedholdende

  • Motiveres af mål og resultater

  • Kan arbejde struktureret

  • Har lyst til at lære B2B-salg

  • Trives i et miljø med klare KPI'er og forventninger

Erfaring med salg eller mødebooking er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Det kan eksempelvis være en attraktiv stilling for dig, der holder sabbatår, studerer ved siden af eller ønsker at udvikle dig inden for salg og digital marketing.

Arbejdstid og arbejdssted

20–30 timer om ugen. Arbejdet foregår fra vores kontor på Stamholmen i Hvidovre og primært inden for normal dansk arbejdstid, hvor virksomhederne kan kontaktes. Det er ikke en remote-stilling.

Løn

140 kr. i timen.

Derudover får du 300 kr. i bonus for hvert møde, du har booket, som efterfølgende bliver til et salg. Det betyder, at høj performance direkte kan ses på din løn.

Vi tilbyder

  • Professionel salgstræning

  • Produkt- og markedstræning

  • Leads og virksomhedslister

  • CRM og salgssystemer

  • Scripts og strukturerede salgsprocesser

  • Løbende coaching

  • Klare KPI'er

  • Mulighed for at udvikle dig inden for B2B-salg og digital marketing

  • Et ambitiøst miljø med fokus på vækst og performance

Om ISA Creative

ISA Creative er en del af ISA Media Group og arbejder med virksomheder inden for digital udvikling, branding, kommunikation og vækst.

Vi bygger i øjeblikket vores salgsorganisation inden for websites og digitale løsninger yderligere ud. Derfor søger vi nu 2 mødebookere, der skal være med til at skabe fundamentet for vores fortsatte vækst.

Ansøgning

Send os en kort ansøgning med:

  • Navn og alder

  • Hvad du laver i dag

  • Eventuel erfaring med salg eller kundekontakt

  • Hvorfor du tror, du vil være god til mødebooking

  • Hvor mange timer om ugen du ønsker at arbejde

  • Hvornår du kan starte

Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

jobs.title: Head of external supply chain (h/f) (H/F)
jobs.description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



SLS est le leader mondial des trains d'atterrissage, roues & freins, et systèmes associés, pour avions civils, militaires, hélicoptères. Nous maîtrisons l'ensemble du cycle de vie de nos produits, de la conception et la fabrication jusqu'à la maintenance.



Envie d'évoluer dans un environnement international, stimulant et bienveillant, au sein d'une entreprise à taille humaine ? Rejoignez-nous !



Vous ne remplissez pas 100 % des critères ? Ce n'est pas un frein pour nous. Ce que l'on recherche avant tout, ce sont des personnes créatives et engagées !



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.


Descriptif missionKPI's

? OTD&PPM/Customer complaint: Improve supplier quality and delivery Performance through team and supplier management.

? DVI/APQP achieved: NPI and project transfer (Internal to external, or source duplication)

? Percentage of purchasing volume from local Asian supplier

? Team maturity and turnover: deploying standard SCH handbook tools, processes and training.



Roles / main missions

jobs.title: Hanken Business Lab Internship: Social Media and Marketing Intern
jobs.description:
Hanken Business Lab now accepts applications for a SOCIAL MEDIA AND MARKETING INTERN

from 14 September 2026 to 31 May 2027

Hanken Business Lab is a startup incubator that provides growth-oriented support services to its resident startups and entrepreneurs through mentoring, events, wide international networks, community-building activities, and access to resources in both Helsinki and Vaasa.

Were looking for a creative and driven Social Media and Marketing Intern to join our dynamic, startup-focused team. In this role, youll play a hands-on part in elevating our brand visibility, especially across platforms like LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and our website. Youll work closely with our Head of Marketing and Communications to help craft engaging content that speaks to aspiring entrepreneurs, startup founders, mentors, and investors. This internship is ideal for someone who is passionate about entrepreneurship, loves storytelling through video and long-form content, and wants to gain experience across the marketing and branding spectrum in a fast-paced, purpose-driven environment.

We offer a dynamic and international work environment where youll collaborate with entrepreneurs, industry experts, cross-border partners, and fellow students daily. Youll gain hands-on experience in startup support operations, content creation, and event production. This internship is based on-site at our co-working spaces in Helsinki.

Interns at Hanken Business Lab are considered full team members. You'll participate in team meetings, join internal planning sessions, and contribute to shaping our activities, future initiatives, and your own role. The working language at Hanken Business Lab is English.

We are looking for a well-organised, reliable, and diligent 2nd-5th year BSc or MSc student. Students from Hanken will be given priority in the recruitment process.

Key responsibilities:

- Plan, create, and edit short-form video content (e.g. LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok) that tells others about our events, community, and programs and promotes them to our target audiences;
- Plan and write long-form content (e.g. our website) that shares stories from our community to our target audiences;
- Support day-to-day social media activities, from scheduling posts to community engagement;
- Assist with content planning, campaign brainstorming, and organising assets;
- Help market and document our events through visuals, stories, and recaps;
- Collaborate with the Community Intern regularly, e.g. day-to-day co-working space management, collaboration with Hanken Business Lab's resident startups and entrepreneurs.

Preferred background and skills:

- Comfortable being both in front and behind the camera;
- Previous experience in content creation, storytelling, or social media marketing is considered as a plus;
- Strong communication skills, creativity, attention to detail, and a proactive, team-oriented attitude;
- Ability to successfully manage own tasks without heavy supervision and to handle stress and time pressure well;
- Fluency in both spoken and written English. Swedish and/or Finnish are considered an asset;
- Growth mindset with a positive, proactive attitude toward learning and feedback;
- Genuine interest in and care for startup ecosystem;
- Willingness and motivation to shape your own role and take ownership of your work;
- You approach marketing and communications creatively and have a drive to try and test new things;
- Knowledge and understanding of the most common social media channels and motivation to follow changes, latest developments, and trends.

Students interested in getting ECTS for their internship are welcome to contact their department to ensure that this internship meets the set criteria and can be included in the degree.

The position is 20 hours/week with flexible office hours to be jointly decided upon. The salary is 1270 €/month. The trial period is two months.

Enquiries may be directed to Head of Marketing and Communications Emilia Jansén, e-mail emilia.jansen@hanken.fi, mobile +358 50 472 9695.

A CV and cover letter (as a short video of 2-3 minutes max instead of a written document) must be submitted via Hankens recruitment database (link below) by August 24, 2026, 23:59. Please note that applications without a video attachment will not be reviewed. Please ensure that the link to your LinkedIn profile is included in your CV. Other relevant documents (e.g. certificates, recommendations, portfolio) may be submitted with the application. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview; all interviews will take place on August 27–28 and August 31.

jobs.title: Gérant d'équipements de loisirs (H/F)
jobs.description:
Description du poste :

Au sein du Service Loisirs régional, l'agent assure la gestion, l'entretien et le suivi de la maintenance du centre de détente du Cap brun.
Vous coordonnerez les interventions des entreprises extérieures et des prestataires en lien avec les services compétents et veillerez à la bonne exécution des travaux ainsi qu'au maintien en condition des infrastructures et des équipements.
Vous participerez à l'organisation, à la planification et à la mise en œuvre des activités, animations et évènements destinés au personnel du ministère des Armées et à leurs familles. Vous assurerez également le suivi des réservations (cohésion et familles) et contribuerez au bon déroulement des activités saisonnières.
Vous encadrerez fonctionnellement le personnel affecté sur site notamment durant la période estivale (réservistes, Mises Pour Emploi (MPE), renforts.).
Vous serez chargé de la gestion administrative, logistique et matérielle du site et de veiller au respect des normes de sécurité, d'hygiène et de règlementation applicables. Vous participerez aux contrôles périodiques des installations.
Par vos actions, vous contribuerez à la qualité du service rendu, au bien être des usagers et à la valorisation du centre de détente du Cap brun.

Description du profil :

Nous recherchons un agent bénéficiant d'une expérience dans un environnement militaire, de même une expérience dans le domaine sportif ou touristique serait appréciée.
Vous avez une formation ou un cursus dans les domaines de l'animation, de la gestion de loisirs, du sport ou de l'accueil.
Vous êtes particulièrement sensible aux enjeux de cohésion et de soutien du personnel militaire et avez, de plus, un excellent relationnel et une capacité d'adaptation.
Vous êtes polyvalent et disposez de bonnes aptitudes techniques, lesquelles vous permettront d'être en capacité d'assurer des travaux courants d'entretien et de maintenance des installations.
Vous possédez également des compétences en informatique et dans le domaine administratif.
