• Previous experience in an administrative, HR, recruitment coordination, or office support role is advantageous.

jobs.title: OPERATEUR·TRICE AMIANTE (m/f)
jobs.description:
Responsabilités :

L'Opérateur·rice Amiante effectue le retrait des matériaux amiantés en respectant strictement les consignes de la hiérarchie.
Il/Elle est amené·e à travailler en déconstruction ou en réhabilitation, en milieu extérieur ou intérieur.

Voici vos missions :

    Mettre en place les installations de chantier (balisage, confinement, dépression, SAS) et préparer le terrain, les outils, les matériaux nécessaires à l'exécution des travaux,
    Réaliser les travaux de retrait des matériaux contenant de l'amiante dans le respect du plan de retrait établi par l'entreprise,
    Appliquer rigoureusement les modes opératoires et les consignes de sécurité,
    Repérer, séparer et enlever les différents matériaux : bois, métaux, bardages, déchets inertes (plastique, revêtement) sous la directive du chef de chantier,
    Effectuer les opérations de décontamination (personnelle, matériels, zones),
    Assurer le conditionnement, l'étiquetage et l'évacuation des déchets amiantés,
    Renseigner les documents de suivi de chantier (traçabilité, rapports) et rendre compte à la hiérarchie de l'avancement des travaux,
    Utiliser et entretenir les appareils de protection respiratoire et les équipements de protection individuelle (EPI) et collective (EPC).

Compétences requises :

    Connaissance des risques liés à l'amiante (toxicité, pathologies associées, réglementation),
    Lecture et compréhension des modes opératoires (plan de retrait, notice de poste, procédures SS4),
    Savoir reconnaître les matériaux susceptibles de contenir de l'amiante,
    Respect strict des consignes de sécurité (EPI, confinements, décontamination),
    Capacité à utiliser le matériel spécifique (aspirateurs à filtration absolue, unités de décontamination, équipements de confinement),
    Communication et remontée d'informations (alerte en cas de situation à risque),
    Habile de ses mains, disponible et doté·e d'une bonne résistance physique.

Compétences utiles :

    La possession d'une formation de désamianteur est considérée comme un atout,
    Connaissance des normes de sécurité.

Nous offrons :

    Un poste à pourvoir immédiatement dans une entreprise dynamique et en pleine croissance,
    Rémunération selon profil et expérience,
    Mutuelle Santé obligatoire et prise en charge à 100%,
    Parcours de formation

jobs.title: Change Management Specialist - Accounting and Corporate Services Transformation (m/f)
jobs.description:
Change Management Specialist - Accounting and Corporate Services Transformation

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Change Management Specialist to support the transformation of its Accounting, Corporate, Fund and Payroll practices.

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

What will you do?

As Change Management Specialist, you will:
• Support the transformation core team in organising, monitoring and steering the overall transformation agenda.
• Contribute to the definition and implementation of change management plans across departments.
• Assess the impact of transformation initiatives on teams, roles, responsibilities, processes, behaviours and client service delivery.
• Work closely with sponsors, department representatives, managers and operational teams to ensure that change is understood, accepted and adopted.
• Identify adoption risks, resistance points, communication needs, training needs and operational readiness issues.
• Prepare stakeholder communications, internal updates, user engagement material and change adoption reporting.
• Support the preparation of change impact assessments, stakeholder maps, readiness assessments and adoption dashboards.
• Coordinate with the central IT Business Application team, project teams and other internal stakeholders to align implementation plans with business change needs.
• Promote a pragmatic and user-oriented approach to transformation, focused on operational adoption and sustainable change.

This position is for you if:

• You have 4 to 6 years of experience in change management, business transformation, organisational change, consulting, operational excellence or a similar field.
• You have contributed to transformation programmes involving several stakeholders, business teams or departments.
• Experience with accounting, corporate services, fund administration or professional services environments.
• You can translate strategic objectives into practical change actions.
• You are able to assess how change impacts people, processes, roles, responsibilities and ways of working.
• You are comfortable facilitating discussions, structuring feedback and turning complex situations into clear action plans.
• You have strong communication skills and can adapt your message to partners, managers and operational teams.
• You are structured, autonomous and pragmatic, with the ability to monitor progress without taking ownership of each individual project.
• You have a good understanding of digital transformation, business applications and the role technology can play in improving processes, collaboration and service delivery.
• You are familiar with the potential of AI in a business environment and have already used, tested or contributed to practical AI-related use cases.
• You are fluent in English and French.
…then this offer is probably made for you!

It would be an advantage if you also have:

• Exposure to software implementation or digital transformation programmes.
• Knowledge of change management methodologies such as Prosci, ADKAR, Kotter or similar approaches.
• Experience preparing change plans, communication plans, adoption material, training support or stakeholder engagement plans.
• Good command of Microsoft 365 tools, including PowerPoint, Excel, Teams and SharePoint. Experience with project or collaboration tools would be an asset.

What we offer

• A key role in a strategic transformation programme within one of BDO Luxembourg's core business practices.
• The opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders, business teams and technology specialists.
• A varied role combining change management, stakeholder engagement, communication and transformation monitoring.
• A collaborative, multicultural and entrepreneurial working environment.
• The opportunity to contribute to the future operating model of our Accounting, Corporate, Fund and Payroll practices.
• Ongoing learning and development opportunities in line with your strengths and career aspirations.

What´s in it for you:

• Competitive remuneration package including
- a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),
- a discretionary performance bonus
• Pension plan
• Lunch vouchers
• Extra days of annual leave
• Flexible working hours and homeworking options
• Parking spots available for a fee within our building
• Possibility to charge electric vehicles in our parking
• On-site employee restaurant with preferential prices
• Free access to our fitness room
• Sports sessions for small additional charge
• Internal sports groups (e.g. running, cycling and football)
• Career development opportunities through a wide range of trainings (e.g. technical and soft skills, language courses)

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Sector positioning and sales enablement expertise

• Experience collaborating with Market Intelligence/Research and Marketing Communications to produce sector insights, client materials, and events.

We offer more than just a job. With our flexible work model, you can work, rest and recharge. Our competitive compensation packages, paid time off, recognition bonuses and dedicated programs for personal development and well-being help to keep you refreshed and motivated.

We will accompany you on a journey of professional growth, offering an expansive spectrum of prospects to elevate your career in Luxembourg, an emerging financial center. Feel a sense of belonging by enjoying year-round celebrations and engaging events that bring us all together.

Job Description

Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg

We see a world of opportunity. We connect the dots between the insights we uncover and the tangible ways those insights can transform clients' organizations. We are diverse and dedicated problem solvers, part of the worldwide network of high-quality audit, tax and advisory services.
We offer excellent career prospects that balance autonomy, flexibility and responsibility. Our comprehensive benefits inspire our people do and feel their best. Right now, we have more than 1800 employees from over 70 nationalities. Join our growing group of young and youthful innovators to uncover a world of opportunity together.

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Tax Advisor in our Alternative Investments team

With passion and purpose, we deliver modern tax services, data-driven solutions and the international tax advice organizations need to succeed.

What you will be working on

• You will participate in diversified projects with clients in the Alternative Investment Sector.
• You will provide our clients tax structuring and tax due diligence advice. As a Senior Adviser, you will be responsible for handling a varied portfolio of national and international client assignments, participating in client meetings and building excellent relationships with clients.
• You will identify areas where technical judgment is required and recommend appropriate solutions to your manager.
• You will integrate a young and dynamic team, work closely with our experienced consultants, develop your junior colleagues and have extensive contact with colleagues worldwide.

What we look for

• A degree in Economics, Finance or Tax Law.
• An experience from 2 to 4 years in a similar function in corporate tax advisory.
• Solid knowledge about the Luxembourg tax legislation system.
• Positive and enthusiastic attitude and ability to work efficiently and accurately under pressure.
• Full commitment and sharing of knowledge with your colleagues.

Help design and deliver the data infrastructure that Luxembourg and its European partners rely on for secure, lawful access to sensitive data. You will work alongside senior architects on real systems with real deadlines and take on your own architectural scope as you go.

We are looking for a Solution Architect to help design and deliver secure, large-scale data infrastructure, working alongside our senior architects.
You will consolidate functional and non-functional requirements from data providers and partner organisations and translate them into architecture documentation.

Working with community frameworks such as Gaia-X, IDSA and DSSC, you will help build the data solutions our partners across Europe depend on.

Architecture design and documentation

Learn and deliver the core architecture artefacts, starting from established LNDS patterns and templates, and taking on more of the design work as your experience grows.

Requirements and analysis

Support senior architects in gathering and documenting functional and non-functional requirements from data providers, partner organisations and internal stakeholders.
Analyse and document business constraints.

Implementation support

Work with engineering and operations colleagues to turn architecture into working systems.
Support the specification, configuration, and integration of components.
Support technical validation and acceptance activities, including preparing test scenarios and evidence.

Standards, compliance and quality

Learn, adopt and apply LNDS architectural standards, patterns and review practices consistently, and flag where they do not fit.
Support the implementation of technical and organisational measures under Data Protection by Design and Default, working with Legal and data governance colleagues.

Project and consortium contribution

Contribute to project deliverables and milestones, tracking your own commitments and raising slippage early.
Support proposal preparation with technical input and effort estimation.


Who you are

BSc or MSc in a scientific, technological or engineering discipline related to computer science, information technology or computing.
1-2 years working explicitly as a solution or enterprise architect on large-scale or federated data systems.
Working knowledge of distributed systems, APIs and integration patterns, databases, and data modelling.
Exposure with cloud or container platforms, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD pipelines.
Foundational understanding of information security, authentication and authorisation, encryption, and network segmentation.
Able to write clear technical documentation and produce readable diagrams.
Awareness of GDPR and the broader EU data regulatory landscape.
Familiarity with agile delivery practices.
Excellent communication skills in English.
Working knowledge of one of Luxembourg's official languages (French, German or Luxembourgish) is a plus.
Curious, methodical, and comfortable speaking when you do not understand something.
Willingness to learn architectural concepts and methods, and to develop your information security and regulatory knowledge seriously.
Collaborative, adaptable, and able to work effectively in a cross-functional and multicultural environment.
Interest in health data, genomics, data spaces or public sector data infrastructure.
Prior experience in EU-funded projects is a plus.

Dynamic and innovative work environment
Collaboration with diverse stakeholders
Inclusive and diverse culture
European recognition and impactful projects
Shape the future of the data revolution


What sets us apart

The Luxembourg National Data Service is a modern and dynamic undertaking.
We embrace a Lean and Agile mindset, combining the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the responsibility of a public body on a national mission.
We will be a partner of society and industry, collaborating with a hugely diverse group of stakeholders in public research, public authorities, European institutions, academic and private institutions, and small, medium and large companies.

The Pictet Group is one of the world's leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Technology & Operations design and integrate software applications ranging from portfolio management systems, trading platforms to banking and corporate solutions. As a Banking Operations Officer, you will be responsible for overseeing the opening and pricing of a diverse range of financial products. This includes a wide scope of assets, such as listed products (equities, bonds, loans, derivatives), OTC products (IRS, CDS, FX & Equity options, TRS, CFD), and structured products (autocall, reverse convertible, dual currency deposits, accumulators, airbags). You will manage the entire workflow, from trade reception and integration into the bank's database, through lifecycle management, to instrument pricing.

Another aspect of the role will be to manage our complex platform and its development, working closely with our Product Analyst.

• Integrate and control asset openings on our global platform, Neoxam.
• Monitor and publish asset data, prices, Greeks, market data, and analytics across all supported platforms.
• Manage the lifecycle of all assets from an asset data perspective (Corpac events, openings, unwinds).
• Provide support to various users of this data (accountants for investment funds, valuers, administrators, asset managers, wealth managers, etc.).
• Challenge various asset types against counterparty prices.
• Liaise directly with key stakeholders in case of issues.
• Implement the necessary configurations for queries and data/pricing flows for newly registered securities from our various financial information providers (Bloomberg, SIX, Reuters, ICE).
• Regularly review and update these settings.

Your profile

Requested experience:

• Master's degree in Finance, economics.
• 2 to 5 years' experience minimum in a similar position with a strong understanding of financial products and market structures.

Hard skills:

• Strong understanding on financial products.
• Solid technical skills, particularly with data management tools and financial platforms.
• Background in mathematical finance.
• Skilled user of office software applications, especially Excel.
• Programming skills: VBA, SQL or another language is an asset.

Soft skills:

• Ability to handle multiple tasks and projects with versatility in a dynamic environment.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with various teams and stakeholders.
• Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
• An enquiring mind with strong learning skills and a well-developed critical faculty.
• Accuracy and thoroughness in searching for the information required to value securities.
• Good capacity to collaborate and find win-win solution.

Language skills:

• French: fluent level
• English: good knowledge (written and spoken)

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. A day in the life

You will shape the future of advanced technology in AMZL. We are a diverse team that works collaboratively to solve customer problems with innovative solutions. We prioritize empowering our employees to maintain work/life harmony. You will balance writing strategic business cases, evaluating emerging physical AI platforms, and understanding the interactions that will define the future of last-mile logistics.

jobs.title: GBL Strategy Specialist, Global Medical Accommodations (m/f)

GBL Strategy Specialist, Global Medical Accommodations

Description

The Medical Accommodations Global Relations & Strategy Specialist is a specialized individual contributor role within Global Medical Accommodations (GMA), created to align ROW stakeholders to our global strategy, ways of working, and technology direction - while ensuring their legitimate concerns are heard, addressed, or escalated decisively. A key objective of this role is to help GMA progress toward global parity between the US and all other regions, ensuring ROW associates and business partners receive a consistent, high-quality accommodations experience.

This role operates as a strategic stakeholder advocate and internal change agent - listening deeply to regional business concerns, evangelizing the global accommodations mission, having backbone when stakeholder requests conflict with global strategy, and bridging divides where local legal requirements demand differentiation. The specialist owns the overarching program direction and strategy for ROW stakeholder alignment, but executes through partnership with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader, SME/ACES teams, Technology, and others as required.

Key job responsibilities

Stakeholder Advocacy & Strategic Alignment

Serve as the primary point of alignment between ROW stakeholders and GAA's global strategy, building deep understanding of regional business concerns while driving adoption of global ways of working and technology direction.
Evangelize the global accommodations mission and technology strategy to ROW stakeholders, building understanding and buy-in for the direction even when it challenges local preferences or established practices.
Exercise backbone: where stakeholder concerns conflict with global strategy and are not legally required, push back respectfully, bring stakeholders on board with the rationale, or escalate with a clear recommendation.
Where stakeholder concerns are valid - aligned to global policy or driven by local legal requirements - identify gaps and partner with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader to ensure they are addressed through the Global Parity program or technology roadmap.
Identify and surface emerging stakeholder concerns proactively (e.g., self-service models driving unintended volume in EU markets, insufficient medical documentation friction creating compliance risk), working with relevant teams to close gaps before they escalate.
Treat stakeholders as customers: understand their needs, close the loop on their concerns, and drive accountability for resolution.
Propose and implement mechanisms to measure stakeholder satisfaction - addressing the current gap where manager and business partner experience with accommodation services is not systematically captured.
Provide structured, data-backed updates to stakeholders on initiatives and concerns they have raised - keeping them informed, engaged, building trust through transparency and follow-through.

Service Adoption & Awareness

Develop and drive a global strategy to increase adoption of GMA services across ROW countries.
Partner with country operations and HR teams to understand barriers to service utilization, and work with relevant teams to remove friction and increase awareness.
Track adoption metrics by country and region, surfacing gaps and recommending targeted interventions to close them.

Program Ownership & Cross-Functional Execution

Own the overarching ROW stakeholder alignment program and strategic direction, executing through partnership with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader, SME/ACES, Ops Center of Excellence, business policy/standard work teams, Technology, Legal, and Expansions.
Partner with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader to ensure ROW stakeholder needs inform parity priorities. Validate that parity deliverables address field concerns and drive stakeholder adoption of implemented solutions. This role does not own the Global Parity program - it serves as the voice of ROW stakeholders into that program.
Identify ROW-specific technology needs and partner with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader to ensure these are reflected in the technology roadmap and product requirements.
Facilitate cross-functional working groups and governance forums, establishing clear decision rights, escalation pathways, and accountability mechanisms across all stakeholder teams.

Process Improvement and Standardization

Conduct structured current-state analyses and future-state mapping, engaging cross-functional teams to validate findings and build alignment on solutions before scaling.
Facilitate process improvement initiatives across ROW regions, identifying fragmentation and inconsistency in accommodation workflows and partnering with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader and operational teams to drive resolution.
Monitor regional performance against defined GMA expectations and metrics that are important to the business - including new metrics where existing measures do not capture stakeholder or operational reality.

Senior Leadership Engagement & Escalation Management

Build and maintain productive relationships with senior leaders across Operations, PXT, Legal, and WHS - ensuring they are informed, engaged, and aligned on accommodation strategy for their regions.

Draft and deliver structured communications, leadership briefings, and status updates that are concise, data-backed, and appropriate for executive audiences, including contributions to the business's Weekly Business Review (WBR) and Monthly Business Review (MBR) mechanisms as required.

Proactively surface cross-regional risks with proposed mitigation plans.
Exercise sound judgment in identifying when complex issues require escalation, preparing clear, data-driven problem statements, root cause analyses, and recommended actions that enable leaders to make informed decisions quickly.

Data Analysis and Insights

Analyze case data, audit findings, stakeholder feedback, and operational metrics across ROW regions to identify trends, bottlenecks, and emerging issues before they escalate into systemic problems.
Build and maintain tracking mechanisms that provide visibility into case volumes, turnaround times, adjustment types, stakeholder satisfaction, service adoption rates, and compliance adherence across the ROW network.
Use data to prioritize program initiatives, measure the impact of implemented solutions, and communicate progress to stakeholders and leadership.

Quantify the impact of stakeholder-raised concerns (e.g., volume increases attributable to self-service rollout) to inform strategic decisions on technology deployment pace and sequencing.

Regional Expansion and Change Management

Partner with the Expansions team during active country launches, focusing on post-launch adoption and ongoing stakeholder alignment rather than launch execution.
Lead change management for stakeholder adoption of GMA services and strategic initiatives this role drives, including stakeholder communications, training development, and feedback loop mechanisms that ensure adoption and continuous refinement.
Document learnings from ROW implementations and contribute to a central knowledge base that enables teams to benefit from cross-regional experience and avoid duplicating effort.

Test Manager  
Job description:  
As Test Manager, you will plan, coordinate and oversee all testing activities for a major digital programme. You will ensure that end\-to\-end business processes, integrated applications and system interfaces are comprehensively tested and meet the required quality standards before go\-live.  
Your responsibilities will include:  
Developing and implementing the overall test strategy, methodology, governance model and quality standards  
Preparing and maintaining the Master Test Plan, including phases, milestones, schedules and resource planning  
Managing the complete testing lifecycle, including SIT, E2E, UAT, regression and smoke testing  
Planning end\-to\-end test scenarios and ensuring coverage of business\-critical workflows  
Coordinating testing activities and resources across multiple business units and delivery teams  
Defining and monitoring test entry and exit criteria  
Managing dependencies between systems, teams, testing environments and deployment schedules  
Coordinating test environments, change freezes and testing windows  
Defining and managing the defect\-management process  
Prioritising and tracking defects and coordinating their resolution with development teams  
Analysing defect trends, quality metrics and testing risks  
Establishing testing dashboards and KPIs  
Reporting progress, risks, test coverage and defect status to Programme Management and the Steering Committee  
Providing objective input for Go/No\-Go decisions  
Facilitating test\-status meetings and escalating blockers or delays  
Producing key deliverables such as the Test Strategy, Master Test Plan, Test Schedule, Test Case Catalogue, Defect Log, Risk Log and Test Closure Report  
Nice to have  
Experience with digital media, streaming or broadcasting platforms  
Experience coordinating user\-migration testing  
Previous involvement in large\-scale, cross\-organisational transformation programmes  
About the customer:  
Our client is a large Swiss organisation delivering digital services across several business units. The company is currently implementing a complex, organisation\-wide digital programme involving multiple platforms, system interfaces and internal and external stakeholders.  
Requirements:  
Proven professional experience as a Test Manager within complex, multi\-system programmes  
Strong knowledge of SIT, end\-to\-end testing, UAT, regression testing and smoke testing  
Experience developing test strategies, master test plans and testing governance frameworks  
Strong test planning, resource coordination and dependency\-management capabilities  
Solid experience managing defects, quality metrics, testing risks and reporting  
Ability to coordinate multiple business units, delivery teams and technical stakeholders  
Experience working with integrated applications, system interfaces and business\-critical processes

jobs.description:
Vi søger en dygtig kundeservicemedarbejder til vores kontor i Gzira, Malta med opstart hurtigst muligt. Din primære opgave bliver at besvare indkomne skriftlige henvendelser fra vores kunder via e-mail og chat. Vores mål er at sikre, at alle kunder modtager professionel vejledning og den bedst mulige service. Der vil desuden være mulighed for at få flere ansvarsområder i takt med dine præstationer og kompetencer.

Som kundeservicemedarbejder er service din vigtigste opgave. Du skal have lyst til at formulere dig skriftligt, være løsningsorienteret og brænde for at yde en fremragende kundeoplevelse. Ingen opgave er for stor eller for lille, når det handler om at hjælpe vores kunder.

Dine opgaver:

  • Besvare kundeforespørgsler via e-mail og chat.

  • Sikre, at komplekse kundehenvendelser bliver løst hurtigt og tilfredsstillende.

  • Yde teknisk support og vejledning om spil.

  • Overvåge hjemmesidens tilgængelighed og funktionalitet samt rapportere fejl og problemer.

  • Deltage i test af nye produkter og tjenester.

  • Medvirke til at promovere nye produkter og kampagner.

  • Bidrage til andre arbejdsopgaver i virksomheden efter behov.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er serviceorienteret, udadvendt, hjælpsom og imødekommende.

  • Har fremragende skriftlige danskkundskaber og gode engelskkundskaber.

  • Er ansvarsbevidst og motiveret for at nå interne mål.

  • Arbejder struktureret og har sans for detaljer.

  • Har erfaring med digitale arbejdsopgaver – det er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Gode muligheder for udvikling og ansvar

  • Danske kollegaer med et danske chefer

  • Sociale arrangementer

  • Hjælp med praktiske ting ved flytning til Malta

  • 150 euro til flybillet

  • Relocationpakke, så du kommer godt fra start med bolig

Stillingen er på fuld tid og omfatter vagter alle ugens syv dage, fordelt på fem ugentlige vagter inden for tidsrummet kl. 08.00–21.00.

Lokation: Gzira, Malta. Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte os.

jobs.title: Directeur / Directrice d'hôtel (H/F)
jobs.description:
Description du poste :

A PROPOS DE NOUS

Célèbre pour avoir introduit la culture des bars à cocktails à Paris en 2007, le groupe Experimental redéfinit l'hospitalité en proposant des bars à cocktails innovants et des hôtels de charme à travers l'Europe et au-delà.

Les destinations se diversifient au fil des années, de capitales européennes comme Rome, Paris et Londres, à des lieux plus saisonniers comme Comporta, Ibiza ou Minorque pour l'été ou les pistes de ski de Verbier et Val d'Isère pour l'hiver. Le groupe possède également des établissements à Porto, Venise, New York, Biarritz et les Cotswolds.

Nos lieux uniques offrent un mélange de design, de créativité et de service exceptionnel, avec de nouvelles ouvertures à l'horizon.

A PROPOS DU POSTE

Rattaché(e) à la Direction Hôtelière groupe, le/la Coordinateur/Coordinatrice Opening Hotel pilote les ouvertures hôtelières du groupe et collabore avec le/ la F&B Opening Project Manager afin de garantir une expérience client globale cohérente avec l'ADN Experimental sur les chambres, la réception, les espaces communs et la restauration.

Vous accompagnez les équipes sur le terrain depuis la phase de pré-ouverture jusqu'à la stabilisation opérationnelle, en assurant la coordination des différents départements (hébergement, réception, housekeeping, F&B, back-office).
Pour cela, vos missions seront les suivantes :

1. Gestion de projet et budget***Pilote la pré-ouverture : garantir le rétroplanning global et coordonner l'ensemble des parties prenantes(Opérations, Marketing, RH, IT Est responsable du budget de pré-opening, en lien avec le Cost Control et la Finance.***Veille à la mise en place et à l'appropriation des outils (PMS, POS, back-office), en collaboration avec le Support Systèmes.***Assure un reporting régulier et organiser un handover structuré à la fin de chaque phase d'ouverture

2. Logistique et opérations***Prépare et structurer les listes de commandes OS&E (équipements, fournitures, papeterie) et les check-lists opérationnelles.***Organise et suivre les commandes, équipements et fournitures en lien avec les outils et standardsgroupe.***Établi le planning des équipes pour la phase de pré-ouverture.

3. Standards et identité***Véhicule l'identité "Experimental" auprès des équipes et collaborer avec le F&B Opening Project Manager pour un plan de déploiement commun.***Coordonne la rédaction, la mise à jour et le déploiement des standards de service.***En cas de reprise d'hôtels existants, pilote le plan de transition entre pratiques locales et ADN Groupe.

4. Formation et onboarding***Accompagne l'onboarding et le suivi du General Manager.***Coordonne le recrutement de l'ensemble des équipes opérationnelles de l'hôtel selon les budgets et le retroplanning établi.***Organise les formations sur les standards, l'attitude de service et la qualité de l'accueil.***S'assure que les managers maîtrisent et transmettent les standards de qualité aux équipes terrain.

5. Sales & Marketing***Coordonne le déploiement de la présence digitale (OTA, Site Web) des nouveaux établissements selon le rétroplanning établi.***Coordonne l'ouverture des ventes des nouveaux établissements selon le rétroplanning établi.

6. Ouverture et suivi opérationnel***Présence terrain intensive (1 à 3 mois par site ) en participant aux shifts opérationnels clés.***Suit la satisfaction client et l'efficacité opérationnelle pendant les premiers mois et proposer des plans d'actions.***Assure un handover structuré et détaillé à la fin de chaque phase d'ouverture pour les équipes opérationnelles afin de garantir la pérennité des standards.

Vous serez amené à voyager régulièrement dans nos différentes destinations en France et à l'étranger, afin d'assurer un support aux équipes et la mise en place d'une gestion opérationnelle optimale.

À PROPOS DE VOUS***Formation supérieure de type École de commerce ou Master en management hôtelier.***Expérience significative en ouverture d'hôtels ou en direction d'exploitation, dans un environnement lifestyle / 4-5 étoiles, avec une forte culture du service.***Forte appétence et expérience avérée et pour le pilotage de projets transverses, en environnement multi-sites, idéalement dans le secteur hôtelier.***Solide connaissance des opérations hôtelières (hébergement, réception, housekeeping) et bonne compréhension des enjeux F&B.***Maîtrise des outils de gestion hôtelière (PMS, POS, outils de réservation) et intérêt marqué pour les solutions digitales opérationnelles.***Qualités personnelles recherchées : autonomie, adaptabilité, sens aigu du détail, orientation résultats, excellence relationnelle et sens prononcé du service client.***Maîtrise indispensable de l'anglais ; une troisième langue constitue un atout.***Forte mobilité : présence de 1 à 3 mois par site lors des ouvertures, à l'international.

Vivez l'expérience Experimental !

Tout au long de votre expérience, vous serez immergé dans un environnement stimulant et innovant. Vous rejoignez un group

jobs.title: Ingénieur en Intelligence Artificielle et Machine Learning (H/F)
jobs.description:
Description du poste :

En postulant à cette offre, vous aurez l'opportunité de rejoindre une entreprise innovante, née de l'alliance entre l'agilité d'une startup et l'envergure d'un leader mondial du supply chain retail. Spécialisée dans les solutions technologiques de pointe pour le retail moderne, cette entité construit les moteurs de décision basés sur l'IA qui optimisent en temps réel les opérations en magasin sur des dizaines de millions de séries temporelles (forecasting probabiliste de la demande, planification de production, pricing dynamique Ils sont à la recherche d'un(e) AI Engineer pour posséder des features IA de bout en bout et assumer la responsabilité directe de leur impact business : moins de gaspillage, moins de ruptures et plus de marge visibles sur le terrain dès le lendemain.

Vos missions si vous les acceptez Posséder des features IA de bout en bout, du cadrage du besoin à la conception, au build, à l'intégration produit et au déploiement en production.***Assurer la responsabilité du cycle de vie complet des modèles : feature engineering, entraînement, évaluation et monitoring.***Faire progresser le cœur technologique de forecasting et d'optimisation (gestion de la demande censurée par les ruptures, estimation du gaspillage, détection d'anomalies d'inventaire Concevoir des systèmes auto-améliorants grâce à des boucles de feedback mesurant la qualité des décisions en production pour accorder automatiquement les modèles.***Contribuer à l'infrastructure agentique à grande échelle orchestrant les pipelines et servant les produits.***Diagnostiquer et résoudre les défaillances en production, du patch d'urgence à la mise en place de solutions durables.***Faire le pont entre la technique et le business en expliquant les sous-performances et en proposant des solutions viables commercialement et techniquement.

Description du profil :

Et vous Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bac+5 obligatoire issu d'une grande école d'ingénieurs ou d'un Master spécialisé en IA avec un profil quantitatif fort.***Vous disposez d'au moins 1 an d'expérience minimum (hors stages et alternances) en tant que AI Engineer ou ML Engineer.***Vous avez un track record prouvé de mise en production de modèles ML (pas uniquement de la R&D) dans des environnements où le taux de service est critique.***Vous possédez une excellente culture ML générale (Transformers, modèles de fondation, mécanismes d'attention) et maîtrisez parfaitement Python.***Vous maîtrisez au moins un cloud provider (GCP, AWS ou autre).Vous parlez un anglais courant et un français courant.***Vous êtes doté d'une culture de 'builder' : créatif, autonome, axé sur l'ownership total et prêt à faire tout ce qu'il faut pour délivrer.

jobs.title: Recognizing the Friction
jobs.description:
Virtual works adequately for many meetings. But how big is the gap between adequate and optimal for any given meeting? The mode decision should weigh the meeting's importance against the friction of meeting in person â not default to either one.

tClara

  • survey of 522 US-based business leaders, including 95 C-suite respondents
  • Across 26 meeting goals, 43% of leaders rate in-person as the better mode, 35% say virtual, and 22% say mode barely matters â the decision is genuinely goal-dependent, not a fixed rule.
  • In-person is the preferred mode for 22 of 26 goals â especially building trust and teamwork, persuading or selling, and solving important problems.
  • Virtual is preferred for goals like gathering diverse opinions, sharing updates, and using people's time efficiently.
  • Virtual meetings are seen as nearly twice as likely to produce a negative outcome as in-person meetings (47% vs. 25%) â convenience carries real risk.
  • 70% of leaders say a deliberate blend of virtual and in-person work allows them to do their best work; C-suite respondents value in-person meetings more than other leaders do (53% vs. 41%).

Join On’s Footwear Innovation team as the Director of Innovation Management, where you will lead a dynamic group of technology-affine business developers and technical project managers. Your mission will be to amplify the impact of product innovation by strategically managing the innovation portfolio, process, and long-term vision. This role focuses on leading the Innovation Management team, driving active visioning and strategy creation, and ensuring that our innovation initiatives—from "Big Bets" to our iconic technology franchises—are translated into impactful realities for On.

We are seeking a strategic and results-oriented Director of Innovation Management to lead a critical function within our Innovation department. This role is pivotal in ensuring our innovation efforts are strategically focused, efficiently executed, and prioritized across the organization. You will lead a team of talented professionals to maximize the impact of innovation at On, utilizing a strong foundational understanding of technology and material science to guide the strategic direction of our portfolio and technology brand franchises.

Your Mission

Strategic Leadership:
- Develop and implement a comprehensive strategy for Innovation Management, including active visioning and strategy creation, aligning with On's overarching business objectives.
- Lead and mentor the Innovation Management team, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment.
- Drive a culture of continuous improvement in innovation processes and strategic portfolio alignment.
- Act as the primary link between Innovation and the rest of the company to ensure strategic cohesion.

Innovation Management Leadership:
- Ensure Innovation initiatives are strategically aligned with On's overall goals and priorities.
- Oversee the management of the Innovation Portfolio, including prioritization, resource allocation, and progress tracking.
- Serve as the PMO for "Big Bet" Innovation projects, ensuring high-impact initiatives are executed with excellence.
- Lead the continuous improvement and operational excellence of the end-to-end innovation process.
- Develop and implement frameworks and tools to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of innovation activities.

Strategic Technology Alignment:
- Manage specific tech brand franchises and oversee the technology roll-out for key innovations such as Superfoam, CloudTec®, and New Propulsion Tech.
- Ensure the successful identification and evaluation of new technologies and materials that provide a competitive advantage.
- Oversee the strategic technology roadmap, ensuring workstreams are prioritized based on strategic alignment and potential impact.
- Collaborate with all technical teams to ensure a smooth horizontal transition of innovations into the product organization.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
- Work closely with all teams in the product organization to ensure alignment and effective collaboration on innovation initiatives.
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels regarding the innovation portfolio, processes, and technology roadmap.
- Manage budgets and resources effectively, ensuring optimal utilization.

Your story
- Master's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Innovation Management, or a related field.

- Strong foundational understanding of technologies and material science to effectively evaluate innovation potential and manage tech franchises.
- Deep understanding of innovation processes, portfolio management, and operational excellence principles.
- Demonstrated ability to lead and inspire cross-functional teams and drive strategic visioning.
- Excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
- Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
- A strong interest in sports, technology, sustainability, and innovation.

About the Team
The Innovation team is responsible for On’s future products, out-of-the-box thinking and athlete-informed technology that differentiates On’s products in the market to become the most premium global sportswear brand, built on performance, design and impact. Within the Innovation team, you will lead two highly motivated and skilled teams: Innovation Management and Technology Management. The Innovation Management team focuses on the strategic alignment of innovation initiatives, the effective management of our innovation portfolio, and the continuous improvement of our innovation processes. The Technology Management team is responsible for the successful scaling, implementation, and continuous evolution of our key technologies, ensuring that strategic technology initiatives are driven forward effectively. Together, these teams are crucial in translating bold ideas into impactful realities for On.

(camps, colonies de vacances, expéditions ou activités en pleine nature). Alors rejoignez notre équipe en tant que coordinateur-rice du programme Mérite dynamiquesse ! Formation des bénévoles pour devenir tuteurs et responsables expéditions au programme du Mérite dynamiquesse : Développer l'offre de formation selon les besoins du terrain et les exigences institutionnelles ;Recruter des formateurs bénévoles et les soutenir dans leur rôle ;Dispenser les formations. Organisation des expéditions (nationales et internationales) : Coordonner les expéditions organisées par les unités et la gestion du matériel ;Planifier et coordonner les expéditions organisées par la Fondation Mérite dynamiquesse, en coopération avec les responsables expéditions au Luxembourg et dans d'autres pays européens ;Accompagner les dynamiques sur le terrain et assurer la sécurité et la qualité des activités proposées, ainsi que la communication y-relative ;Assurer la formation continue et soutenir les responsables expéditions dans leur rôle. La connaissance du programme Mérite dynamiquesse ou d'un programme similaire est un atout. Intéressé-e ? Envoyez votre candidature (CV + lettre de motivation) à Moovijob.com avant le 1er septembre.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Integrated Marketing team connects our brand story to the world—ensuring that every campaign, launch, and experience builds on global awareness of Notion as the intelligent, AI-connected workspace for modern work. We're looking for an experienced, creative, and rigorous brand campaign expert who excels at conceptualizing innovative campaign strategies and bringing clarity to complex challenges.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

The Campaign Manager, Brand brings Notion’s mission, product capabilities, and customer stories to life through targeted, insight-driven brand campaigns. This role is responsible for conceptualizing, developing, and executing integrated marketing programs that connect Notion’s core value props to the needs and aspirations of our customers—from individuals to global enterprises.

Reporting to the Campaign Lead, you’ll drive seasonal campaigns, brand activations, and special projects that aim to build excitement among both current customers and prospects. You’ll work closely with Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, and Creative to transform feature launches, product education, and customer insights into powerful, scalable brand moments that build understanding, drive conversion, and reinforce Notion’s position as the AI workspace for teams. Responsibilities include:

 - Lead cross-functional campaign execution, from concept to delivery, for both special brand projects and feature-led programs

 - Partner with Creative to generate out-of-the-box brand marketing concepts, breaking from the industry mold and encouraging blue sky thinking

 - Partner with Product Marketing to develop strategies that translate product value into meaningful narratives for the target audience of each activation or campaign

 - Partner with Growth Marketing to define the right mix of content, media, and channels to reach each segment effectively

 - Manage campaign briefs, creative deliverables, and timelines—ensuring clarity, accountability, and alignment across stakeholders

 - Integrate brand and performance media buying from planning through delivery and reporting

 - Define and track KPIs for each campaign, analyzing and sharing results and applying insights to optimize future programs

 - Ensure all campaigns maintain a cohesive Notion voice and brand expression, while adapting to audience needs and regional contexts




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 8+ years of experience in integrated or brand marketing, preferably in AI or tech, with proven success leading complex projects to fruition

 - Idea catalyst: You bring a concept-led approach and an opinionated point of view, sparking, shaping, and shepherding breakthrough concepts until they're undeniable

 - AI fluency: You have deep, first-hand experience experimenting with new AI tools, and are passionate about staying on top of fast-moving industry trends

 - Speed: You bias towards action and operate with ambition, creating processes that help cross-functional teams do the same

 - GTM expert: You have strong understanding of and passion for go-to-market planning, messaging, and storytelling for brand-driven campaigns

 - Collaborative: People on the projects you lead become the best versions of themselves by working with you, across product, creative, and data teams

 - Order agent: You possess strong organizational and analytical skills, with the ability to balance multiple work streams and deadlines at once while iterating for improvement




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Familiarity with hybrid audience targeting

 - Experience supporting global and/or regionalized campaigns

 - Experience using Notion—both personally and professionally

The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $174,000 – $195,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. jobs.description:
Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant (m/f/d)

Luxembourg
Line of Service Advisory
Industry/Sector Banking and Capital Markets
Specialism Fraud, Investigations & Regulatory Enforcement (FIRE)
Management Level Senior Associate

Job Description & Summary

PwC Luxembourg is hiring a Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant (m/f/d). What if it was you?

Your Mission:

In today's increasingly complex regulatory and financial environment, combating financial crime is a critical priority for all organisations. At our firm, the Financial Crime Compliance team acts as a strategic advisor to management and clients, proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks related to money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions breaches, fraud, and other financial crimes.

As a Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in delivering expert guidance, designing robust compliance frameworks, and supporting clients in implementing effective controls to safeguard their operations and reputation.
Be a part of our team where you will:

Client Risk Assessment and Advisory

• Conduct comprehensive financial crime risk assessments, covering AML, sanctions, fraud, and bribery/corruption risks;
• Advise clients on regulatory requirements and best practices under Luxembourg law, EU directives, FATF recommendations, and global standards;
• Assist in designing and implementing financial crime compliance frameworks tailored to client risk profiles.

Customer Due Diligence and Enhanced Due Diligence

• Review and analyze KYC documentation for new clients during onboarding;
• Perform ongoing due diligence and periodic reviews of existing client files;
• Conduct reputational checks and adverse media screening on clients and beneficial owners.

Transaction Monitoring and Investigations

• Design and implement transaction monitoring systems to detect suspicious activities across multiple risk typologies;
• Analyze transactional data to identify unusual patterns indicative of money laundering, fraud, or sanctions breaches;
• Support clients in investigating alerts and preparing Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) for competent authorities.

Sanctions and Screening Controls

• Implement and oversee sanctions screening processes, ensuring compliance with EU, UN, and OFAC lists;
• Review and validate screening results, investigate potential matches, and escalate confirmed hits;
• Advise clients on integrating sanctions screening tools and maintaining up-to-date watchlists.

Fraud and Bribery/Corruption Risk Management

• Assist clients in developing anti-fraud and anti-bribery policies and controls;
• Conduct fraud risk assessments and recommend mitigation measures;
• Support investigations into suspected fraud or corruption cases.

Monitoring, Reporting, and Regulatory Support

• Prepare compliance reports and dashboards for senior management and regulators;
• Support clients during regulatory inspections and audits, ensuring timely and accurate responses;
• Maintain and file confidential compliance documentation in accordance with legal requirements.

Training and Awareness

• Deliver training sessions on financial crime compliance, including AML, sanctions, fraud, and anti-bribery measures;
• Promote awareness of emerging risks, regulatory developments, and industry best practices.

Let's talk about you. If you have/are:

• Hold a university degree (minimum Bac+3) in Law, Finance, Compliance, or a related field;
• Have at least 3–5 years of experience in financial crime compliance, AML, or regulatory advisory within financial services or consulting;
• Possess strong knowledge of Luxembourg and EU financial crime regulations, FATF standards, and global compliance frameworks;
• Bring proven experience in transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, fraud risk management, and investigations;
• Demonstrate excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to manage complex projects and multiple priorities;
• Are fluent in English and French and/or German;
• Hold certifications such as CAMS, CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), or equivalent, which are highly desirable.

PwC Luxembourg (www.pwc.lu) is the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg with over 3,800 people employed from 90 different countries. PwC Luxembourg provides audit, tax and advisory services including management consulting, transaction, financing and regulatory advice. The firm provides advice to a wide variety of clients from local and middle market entrepreneurs to large multinational companies operating from Luxembourg and the Greater Region. The firm supports its clients in creating the value they are looking for by contributing to the smooth operation of the capital markets and providing advice through an industry-focused approach.

At PwC, we help clients build trust and reinvent so they can turn complexity into competitive advantage. We're a tech-forward, people-empowered network with more than 370,000 people in 149 countries. Across audit and assurance, tax and legal, deals and consulting we help build, accelerate and sustain momentum. Find out more at www.pwc.com and www.pwc.lu.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure Security
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Millions of people use Notion every day, and we’re growing quickly. The Infrastructure Security team’s mission is to build a secure-by-default foundation across Notion’s technical stacks—architecting systems that make the secure path the easy path. As an IC4 on this team, you’ll own meaningful infrastructure security problems end-to-end: from identifying risk, to designing pragmatic controls, to shipping secure defaults that scale across engineering.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Proactively enhance the security posture of our AWS accounts and cloud infrastructure.

 - Create secure frameworks for secrets management and authentication/authorization.

 - Design and deploy robust Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions.

 - Provide guidance and education on security and privacy best practices to cross-functional partners.

 - Participate in (and help drive) mitigation strategies during security-related incident response.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Security architecture and expertise: you’ve built and maintained systems to secure cloud architectures, ranging from secrets management to Identity and Access Management solutions.

 - Backend/infrastructure development: you’ve written and shipped production-grade code, and can contribute to the codebase and architecture to raise the bar on secure systems design.

 - Working in production: you can debug systems in production and continuously improve components with minimal disruption.

 - Pragmatic, risk-based prioritization: you model threats, balance trade-offs, and focus security investments where they drive the most business impact.

 - Empathetic communication: you communicate nuanced ideas clearly in writing and in real time; in disagreements, you engage thoughtfully and look for the right compromise.

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - AWS security best practices, zero trust architectures, and/or deep IAM expertise.

 - Data security or privacy engineering experience.

 - Experience applying AI tooling to defensive security workflows.

 - Participation in security communities (local or regional groups, conferences).

 

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $230,000 - $280,000 per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: ein wissenschaftlicher Referent / eine wissenschaftliche Referentin (m/w/d) (Archäologe/Archäologin)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Bauforscher*in

Stellenbeschreibung:
Gestalten Sie die Zukunft der internationalen Forschung

Das Deutsche Archäologische Institut (DAI) ist eine weltweit führende Forschungseinrichtung im Bereich der Archäologie und Altertumswissenschaften. Es ist dem Auswärtigen Amt, einer obersten Bundesbehörde, nachgeordnet und leistet an seinen insgesamt 20 Standorten europa- und weltweit einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Schutz und Erhalt sowie zur Vermittlung von kulturellem Erbe. Sie finden uns im Internet unter http://www.dainst.org (http://www.dainst.org) .

An der Abteilung Madrid des Deutschen Archäologischen Instituts (DAI) ist zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt die Stelle

eines wissenschaftlichen Referenten / einer wissenschaftlichen Referentin (m/w/d)

(Kennziffer: 08/2026)

in Vollzeit im Rahmen eines unbefristeten Beschäftigungs- bzw. Dienstverhältnisses. Eine Teilzeitbeschäftigung ist grundsätzlich möglich. Gehen entsprechende Bewerbungen ein, wird für den Arbeitsplatz geprüft, ob den Teilzeitwünschen im Rahmen der dienstlichen Möglichkeiten (insbesondere hinsichtlich der Anforderungen des Arbeitsplatzes und der gewünschten Gestaltung der Teilzeit) entsprochen werden kann.

Für Tarifbeschäftigte richtet sich das Entgelt beim Vorliegen der persönlichen Voraussetzungen bis Entgeltgruppe 13 TVöD Bund. Bei Vorliegen der laufbahn- und haushaltsrechtlichen Voraussetzungen besteht die Möglichkeit der Ernennung in das Beamtenverhältnis. Für Beamt*innen erfolgt die Besoldung bis Besoldungsgruppe A 13 BBesO. Bei Tarifbeschäftigten des Bundes sowie Beamtinnen und Beamten ist zunächst eine Abordnung mit dem Ziel der Versetzung zum DAI vorgesehen. Der Dienstort ist Madrid.

Das Arbeitsgebiet der Abteilung Madrid umfasst Spanien, Portugal und Marokko. Dieser geografische Raum bildet mit der Meerenge von Gibraltar eine zentrale Brücke zwischen Europa und Afrika sowie zwischen der Mittelmeerwelt und der Atlantikküste. Die Abteilung widmet sich der Erforschung von rund 7.000 Jahren Archäologie in diesen Kulturzonen, vom Neolithikum bis zum Beginn der Neuzeit. Seit ihrem Bestehen hat die Abteilung Madrid leistungsfähige Forschungsinfrastrukturen aufgebaut. Dazu zählen eine der größten archäologischen Fachbibliotheken der Iberischen Halbinsel mit mehr als 90.000 Bänden, umfangreiche Archiv- und Fototheksbestände sowie eine Forschungsstelle in Lissabon.

Aufgabenbeschreibung

Der Aufgabenbereich umfasst insbesondere:

- Entwicklung eigener Forschungsfragen im westlichen Mittelmeerraum (mit Fokus auf Austausch- und Entwicklungsprozesse zwischen Nordafrika und der Iberischen Halbinsel).
- Konzeption und Leitung eines eigenen Forschungsprojektes in Nordafrika (in Marokko und/oder Algerien).
- Leitung und Koordination des Forschungsdatenmanagements und des Archivs/Fotothek der Abteilung
- Capacity building und Netzwerkarbeit, z. B. Durchführung von Schulungen und/oder Summerschools und Mitwirkung in der Verbundforschung des DAI, (z. B. TANA-Netzwerk, TANMed).
- Eigenverantwortliche Budgetplanung und Mittelabrechnung für die betreuten Projekte und Arbeitsbereiche.
- Fachliche Leitung unterstellter Mitarbeiter sowie Anleitung von Hilfskräften und Praktikanten.
- Einwerbung von Drittmitteln.

Ihr Profil

Vorausgesetzt werden:

- Ein mit hervorragender Promotion abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium auf dem Gebiet der Archäologie (Ur- und Frühgeschichte/Vor- und Frühgeschichte, Klassischen Archäologie, Archäologie der römischen Provinzen, Spätantike und frühes Christentum/Christliche Archäologie) oder Bauforschung.
- Deutsch verhandlungssicher in Wort und Schrift (mind. Niveau C2).
- Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Forschungs- und/oder Feldforschungsprojekten in Nordafrika.
- Erfahrung im Bereich Forschungsdatenmanagement und/oder in der Arbeit mit wissenschaftlichen Archiven/Fototheken.
- Vorlage eines überzeugenden Konzeptes zu den wissenschaftlichen Perspektiven und Capacity building für die ersten drei Jahre der Anstellung.

Wir freuen uns über:

- Kenntnisse einer für den Forschungsraum relevanten Sprachen bzw. Bereitschaft zum Erlernen dieser Sprachen.
- Bereitschaft zur Koordinierung von Arbeitsgruppen, Kolloquien und Mitarbeit in internationalen Kooperationen.
- Bereitschaft zum aktiven Auslandsdienst, d. h. internationale Kontaktpflege in Spanien und Nordafrika, enge Zusammenarbeit mit den deutschen Auslandsvertretungen in den Gastländern, Teilnahme an institutseigenen Kolloquien, Tagungen usw.

Als Mitarbeiterin oder Mitarbeiter des DAI bringen Sie eine hohe Sensibilität für Gleichstellung und Antidiskriminierung mit. Sie verfügen über interkulturelle Kompetenz und sind in der Lage, mit Menschen unterschiedlicher Herkunft respektvoll und offen zu kommunizieren und zu kooperieren.

Ihre Vorteile:

Abwechslungsreiche und kulturnahe und Aufgaben

Sie arbeiten in einer national wie international angesehenen Forschungseinrichtung des Bundes, die die weltweite Forschung und Nachwuchsförderung, den Schutz von kulturellem Erbe sowie die kulturelle Verständigung und Zusammenarbeit zum Ziel hat.

Arbeitsplatzsicherheit

Auch in Krisenzeiten bieten wir Ihnen ein sicheres Beschäftigungsverhältnis im öffentlichen Dienst.

Flexibles und familienfreundliches Umfeld

Wir fördern eine gute Vereinbarkeit von Beruf, Familie und Pflege durch:

• flexible Arbeitszeiten (Rahmenarbeitszeit von 6:00 bis 22:00 Uhr)

• Gleitzeit mit Stundenausgleich (z. B. durch Gleittage)

• Möglichkeiten zur Teilzeit und mobilen Arbeit

• kostenfreien Familienservice mit Beratungs- und Vermittlungsangeboten.

Motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld

Unsere Zusammenarbeit ist geprägt von gegenseitigem Respekt, Vertrauen, flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Eigeninitiative, Mitgestaltung und kreative Ideen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht.

Entwicklungs- und Karriereperspektiven

Wir bieten Ihnen ein breites Spektrum an Fort- und Weiterbildungen sowie individuelle Maßnahmen zur Personalentwicklung.

Urlaubsregelung

Sie erhalten 30 Tage Erholungsurlaub (bei einer Teilzeitbeschäftigung wird der Urlaubsanspruch entsprechend der tariflichen/gesetzlichen Vorgaben gewährt). Zusätzlich besteht die Möglichkeit von Sonder- und Bildungsurlaub.

Mobilitätszuschuss

Sie erhalten bei einem Dienstort in Deutschland von uns einen Zuschuss zu einem ÖPNV-Ticket (DeutschlandJobTicket o.a.).

Betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung

Wir bieten eine Mitgliedschaft im Sozialwerk des Auswärtigen Amtes an und ermöglichen so den Zugang zu vergünstigten Freizeit- und Erholungsangeboten. Zusätzlich profitieren Sie von der Kooperation mit Wellhub und erhalten über diese Wellness-Plattform Zugang zu zahlreichen Fitness-Studios, Online-Kursen zu Themen wie z. B. Meditation oder Ernährung und weiteren Angeboten.

Interessenvertretungen

Ihre Interessen werden bei uns von den Personalräten, der Schwerbehindertenvertretung und der Gleichstellungsbeauftragten vertreten.

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung! Senden Sie Ihre Unterlagen (Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf, Ausbildungsnachweis, Arbeitszeugnisse etc.) bis zum

26.08.2026

in einer zusammengefassten PDF-Datei unter Angabe der Kennziffer 08/2026 an bewerbung@dainst.de. (https://mailto:bewerbung@dainst.de) Bitte fügen Sie Ihren Bewerbungsunterlagen weiterhin den auf der Homepage des DAI unter https://www.dainst.org/karriere/bewerben-am-dai (https://www.dainst.org/karriere/bewerben-am-dai) (Formularcenter) eingestellten Bewerbungsbogen „Wissenschaft“ ausgefüllt sowie, sofern Sie bereits im öffentlichen Dienst tätig sind, eine Einverständniserklärung zur Einsicht in Ihre Personalakte bei.

Wir bitten um Verständnis, dass wir nur vollständige Bewerbungen berücksichtigen können.

Haben Sie noch Fragen zu unserem Stellenangebot?

Dann kontaktieren Sie uns für weitere Auskünfte. Schreiben Sie eine E-Mail an bewerbung@dainst.de oder rufen Sie Herrn Sternbeck unter 030/187711-295 an. Für fachliche Fragen wenden Sie sich bitte an Paul Scheding, Leitender Direktor der Abteilung Madrid, E-Mail: paul.scheding@dainst.de.

Weitere Hinweise:

Bewerber*innen (m/w/d) mit Schwerbehinderung oder diesen gleichgestellte Personen werden bei gleicher Eignung entsprechend den gesetzlichen Grundlagen bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

Das DAI gewährleistet gemäß BGleiG die berufliche Gleichstellung unabhängig vom Geschlecht und unterstützt die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie, indem flexible Arbeitszeiten gelebt und Teilzeitmodelle im Rahmen der dienstlichen Möglichkeiten realisiert werden.

Vielfalt ist einer unserer zentralen Organisationswerte. Deshalb begrüßen wir Bewerbungen unabhängig von Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion und Weltanschauung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

Im Zusammenhang mit Ihrer Bewerbung behandeln wir Ihre personenbezogenen Daten mit größter Sorgfalt und Diskretion. Unsere Datenschutzinformation finden Sie auf unserer Webseite unter www.dainst.org/datenschutz (http://www.dainst.org/datenschutz) . Diese informiert Sie gemäß Art. 13 DSGVO über den Umfang und die Art und Weise der Verarbeitung sowie über Ihre diesbezüglichen Rechte.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Zwingend erforderlich: Forschung, Archäologie, Ausgrabungen, Quellenmaterial auswerten (Geschichte)

jobs.title: CFD Software Developer (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
CFD Software Engineer (f/m/d)
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the
world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative
global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a
large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together
while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages
creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our
business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
Position Overview
Are you a passionate Software Engineer who enjoys working at
the intersection of numerical methods, high-performance computing, and
real-world engineering applications? We are searching for a talented CFD
Software Engineer to join our solver development team for Simcenter Ultrafluid (formerly Altair ultraFluidX, https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/) ), a small, dynamic, and agile team delivering world-class CFD software to
industries including automotive, heavy industry, and consumer electronics.
Simcenter Ultrafluid features a native GPU-based
implementation of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), allowing users to run
fully transient, high-fidelity aerodynamics and aeroacoustics simulations
overnight on a single compute server. The solver is designed to handle complex
geometries and demanding industrial use cases, delivering high-fidelity,
predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.
If you are seeking a role where you can contribute directly
to solver development, algorithm implementation, and GPU acceleration, while
translating cutting-edge academic research in numerical methods into a
high-performance, easy-to-use software product, and collaborating closely with
the whole development team on the advancement of the code and its capabilities,
then we'd love to hear from you!
Responsibilities

- Contribute
to the code development of Simcenter Ultrafluid as part of the agile
development team
- Specify,
implement, test, and document new high-quality features of the solver in
close collaboration with the other team members
- Contribute

Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)
