jobs.title: Jurist til spændende stilling i Uddannelsesservice - genopslag
jobs.description:
Et af vores strategiske fokusområder er at sikre en professionel og konsistent behandling af alle studerende, så vi sikrer de studerendes retsstilling. Så når der skal udarbejdes nye studieordninger, en uddannelsesleder skal rådgives om korrekt juridisk håndtering af en sag, når almindelig klagesagsbehandling skal håndteres bedst muligt eller når der skal etableres korrekte arbejdsgange på tværs af organisationen. Ja, så er det der, vi har brug for dig. Hvis du samtidig gerne vil gøre en forskel for fremtidens fagprofessionelle, glæder vi os til at byde dig velkommen på holdet.

Vi søger en jurist til en fast stilling, der kan lide at arbejde med konkret sagsbehandling inden for det uddannelsesjuridiske område samt rådgive og vejlede både studerende og samarbejdspartnere.

Vi går en spændende tid i møde, hvor du med din stærke faglighed inden for uddannelsesjura vil blive en nøglemedarbejder bl.a. ift. implementering af reformen af de professionsrettede uddannelser på Professionshøjskolen Absalon. Hvis du synes, at det lyder interessant, så læs videre her.

Din profil
Du brænder for at sikre compliance og understøtte juridisk korrekte rammer for studerende på Absalon, og du er optaget af at sikre, at kolleger er opdateret med den relevante uddannelsesjuridiske viden. Du har indgående kendskab til forvaltningsret og indsigt eller interesse i jura inden for uddannelsesområdet. De områder, du ikke har et forudgående kendskab til, har du mod på at sætte dig ind i. Du kan derudover nikke genkendende til følgende:

Arbejder selvstændigt, kvalitetsbevidst og løsningsorienteret. Det er naturligt for dig at løse opgaverne selvstændigt og med høj faglig kvalitet. Du kan kombinere din juridiske metode med en pragmatisk og løsningsorienteret tilgang.

Imødekommende, fleksibel og god til at samarbejde. Du har et stærkt blik for processer og kan samarbejde på tværs af faggrænser. Du er serviceorienteret og kan formidle juridisk viden til ikke-jurister på en letforståelig måde, da du skal samarbejde med kolleger med mange forskellige fagligheder. Samtidigt har du gennemslagskraft, når det er nødvendigt for opgaven.

Detaljeorienteret med godt overblik og på forkant med opgaverne. Du kan "skære en sag til", så de væsentlige detaljer fremstår tydelige. Du har en skarp pen og er dygtig til at formulere dig både skriftligt og mundtligt. Herudover trives du med både drifts- og udviklingsopgaver.

Derudover forventer vi, at du:
  • er uddannet jurist - gerne med erfaring fra uddannelsessektoren.
  • har erfaring med journaliseringssystemer og er effektiv, når du behandler sager.
  • er en god kollega

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Din arbejdsdag består som udgangspunkt af følgende opgaver:

Konkret sagsbehandling. Det kan fx være behandling af klagesager fra studerende eller aktindsigtsanmodninger.

Rådgive og vejlede. Det kan fx være at rådgive, sparre og vejlede om håndtering af konkrete sager eller principielle spørgsmål. Du rådgiver studieadministrative medarbejdere, uddannelsesledere og chefer på Absalon, der har brug for juridisk sparring.

Udarbejde og opdatere regler, procedurer og vejledninger på udvalgte områder. Det kan være i forbindelse med nye retningslinjer på forskellige områder eller beslutningsoplæg til fx ledelse eller direktion. Du vil desuden blive involveret i arbejdet med de juridiske aspekter ift. udarbejdelse og implementering af nye studieordninger på baggrund af reformen af de professionsrettede uddannelser, herunder legalitetstjek.

Implementere love og bekendtgørelse mv. Du er ansvarlig for at sikre, at nye regler bliver formidlet til relevante modtagere, herunder at standardbreve og vejledninger opdateres.

Levere input til høringssvar. Det vil også være dig, der udarbejder og koordinerer høringssvar på uddannelsesområdet mv.

Dine kolleger
Du bliver en del af vores uddannelsesjuridiske team i Uddannelsesservice, hvor vi håndterer al administration af Absalons grund-, efter-og videreuddannelse. Afdelingen håndterer også optagelse og vejledning af studerende, SU-opgaver m.v. Tilsammen er vi 80 kolleger i Uddannelsesservice, som er en velfungerende og uhøjtidelig afdeling, hvor vi løfter i flok. Vores kontorer ligger side om side med undervisningslokaler, og vi arbejder tæt på de studerende og tæt med hinanden. Vi vægter kollegial trivsel højt og håber, at du vil være en medspiller.

Du har mulighed for at få arbejdsplads på Campus Roskilde eller Campus Slagelse, der begge ligge tæt på togstation, men du kommer til at samarbejde med og understøtte kolleger på alle vores campusser og bredt i organisationen.

Vi har en uformel omgangstone og har mange bolde i luften, som vi gør os stor umage med at gribe.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker i henhold til Overenskomst for Akademikere i Staten. Der er mulighed for at ansættelse kan ske som specialkonsulent, hvis de rette kompetencer er til stede
  • Stillingen er en fast stilling på fuld tid med tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt
  • Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte teamleder Gitte Saltoft Christiansen på tlf. 7248 2996
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/om-professionshoejskolen-absalon/ledige-stillinger/ eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side, senest den 20. august 2026
  • Vi afholder samtaler løbende

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

jobs.title: Personal & Assistant (Multi-Business Operations)
jobs.description:
Looking for a highly organized, trustworthy, proactive, and versatile Personal & Executive Assistant to support both my personal life and the daily operations of my businesses in Finland.

This is not a traditional office job. Every day is different, and the successful candidate should enjoy variety, solving problems, learning new things, and taking initiative. We are looking for someone who can become a long-term, reliable partner whom I can trust to manage responsibilities independently when needed.

The role supports the following businesses:

- SiivousVelhot (Cleaning Company)

- Lentävä Kalakukko (Café, Bar, Accommodation & Gift Shop)

- E-commerce and Website Projects


Responsibilities

Executive & Administrative Support

- Manage my calendar, appointments, meetings, and daily schedule.

- Organize business and personal tasks and priorities.

- Handle emails and communicate with customers, suppliers, and business partners.

- Prepare reports, documents, presentations, and other administrative materials.

- Coordinate projects and follow up on ongoing tasks.

- Handle confidential information professionally.


Business Operations

- Assist in the daily operations of all businesses.

- Coordinate suppliers, inventory, orders, and bookings.

- Assist with customer service.

- Help improve internal processes and business organization.

- Take over certain responsibilities when I am unavailable.


Website & Technology Support

- Test websites, mobile applications, and software before launch.

- Report bugs, usability issues, and suggestions for improvement.

- Assist with product listings and website content updates.

- Learn and use new software and digital tools quickly.


Personal Assistance

- Organize my personal appointments, calendar, and daily schedule.

- Assist with daily errands, including weekends when necessary.

- Organize flights, hotels, meetings, and travel arrangements.

- Assist with administrative and personal matters.

- Coordinate family logistics and childcare planning when needed.


Childcare Support

- Occasionally assist in caring for my 18-month-old daughter.

- Previous experience caring for young children is required.

- Patience, responsibility, and a genuine interest in children's wellbeing are essential.


Cleaning & Hospitality Support

These duties are only required during exceptional situations, such as unexpected staff shortages, employee absences, or sudden operational needs.

When needed, you may be asked to assist with:

- Hotel room cleaning.

- Café cleaning.

- Cleaning assignments for SiivousVelhot.

- General housekeeping and maintaining high cleanliness standards.


Philippine Administrative Matters

- Assist with matters involving Philippine government agencies.

- Help organize taxes, permits, registrations, and official documents.

- Coordinate with government offices and service providers when necessary.


Requirements

We are looking for someone who is:

- Highly trustworthy and honest.

- Able to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Organized and excellent at time management.

- Flexible and adaptable.

- Comfortable performing a wide variety of tasks.

- Experienced in administration or executive assistance.

- Experienced in caring for young children.

- Comfortable learning new software and technology.

- A good communicator with excellent English skills.

- Knowledge of Finnish is an advantage but not required.

- Knowledge of Philippine government procedures is highly preferred.


Driver's License

A valid driver's license (Category B) is required.

The role involves travelling between different business locations when necessary. Having access to your own car is considered an advantage.

What We Offer

- A unique and varied position where no two days are the same.

- Opportunity to work closely with several growing businesses.

- Long-term employment with opportunities to grow together with the company.

- A supportive and trusting working environment where initiative and ideas are appreciated.

jobs.title: Autokorjaamon työnjohtaja / huoltoneuvoja
jobs.description:
Etsimme tiimiimme Malmille asiakaspalveluhenkistä ja jämäkkää **työnjohtajaa / huoltoneuvojaa** vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

Oletko autoalan ammattilainen, joka pitää langat käsissään kiireenkin keskellä, kommunikoi sujuvasti asiakkaiden kanssa ja varmistaa, että korjaamon arki rullaa tehokkaasti? Jos vastasit kyllä, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö!

Työnkuvasi ja vastuualueesi:

- **Asiakaspalvelu ja vastaanotto:** Otat asiakkaat vastaan hymyssä suin, kartoitat huoltotarpeet ja huolehdit laadukkaasta asiakaskokemuksesta aina auton luovutukseen saakka.

- **Työnsuunnittelu ja -jako:** Organisoit mekaanikkojen työpäivät tehokkaasti ja varmistat, että aikataulut pitävät.

- **Tarjouslaskenta ja osatilaus:** Teet huoltotarjouksia, tilaat tarvittavat varaosat ja huolehdit työnjohtojärjestelmän ajantasaisuudesta

- **Digitaalinen viestintä:** Pidät asiakkaat ajan tasalla huollon edistymisestä (esim. WhatsApp-viestein ja kuvin/videoin) ja vastaat osaltasi sujuvasta asiakkuuksien hoidosta.


Odotamme sinulta:

- Tehtävään soveltuvaa autoalan koulutusta ja/tai vahvaa käytännön kokemusta korjaamon työnjohdon tai huoltoneuvonnan tehtävistä.

- Hyvää teknistä ymmärrystä nykyaikaisista autoista.

- Erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja asiakaspalvelutaitoja sekä sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa (muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi).

- Kykyä hallita useita asioita samanaikaisesti ja tehdä päätöksiä muuttuvissa tilanteissa.

- Hyviä it-taitoja ja kokemusta autoalan ohjelmistoista.


Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työn vakaassa, tunnetussa ketjukorjaamossa.

- Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen ja hyvät henkilöstöedut.

- Nykyaikaiset työkalut ja järjestelmät työsi tueksi.

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi ja kouluttautua autoalan uusimman tekniikan (kuten sähköautojen) parissa.

- Ronskin mutta reilun, ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön tuen.


Hakeminen ja lisätiedot:

Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan heti sopivan henkilön löytyessä.

Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi palkkatoiveineen viimeistään 0**1.09.2026** sähköpostitse osoitteeseen: **Joonas@autoks.fi**.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa: Joonas Vanhanen 044 308 8814

jobs.title: Asiakaspalvelija –liity Valoon tiimiin!
jobs.description:
Nautitko ihmisten auttamisesta ja mutkattoman asiakaspalvelun tarjoamisesta? Haluatko olla osa kasvavaa yritystä, jossa asiakaskokemus on kaiken keskiössä? Etsimme uusia asiakaspalvelijoita tuottamaan erinomaisia kohtaamisia Valoon asiakkaille osana motivoitunutta tiimiä.

Valonnopeudella kasvava Valoo on valokuitumarkkinoiden raikkain ja rohkein toimija, joka tuo laadukkaat, nopeat ja kestävät valokuituyhteydet yhä useampaan suomalaiseen kotiin. Asiakkaille tarjoamme markkinoiden parhaan nettiyhteyden - työntekijöille innostavan, lämpimän ja merkityksellisen työympäristön.

Mitä työpäivääsi kuuluu

Asiakaspalvelijana päätehtäväsi on asiakkaiden kontaktoiminen informatiivisella ja ystävällisellä otteella, asiakaspalvelun kasvoina toimiminen eri yhteydenpitokanavissa sekä luonnollisesti Valoon palveluiden myynti. Sinulla on tärkeä rooli Valoon ilosanoman jalkauttamisessa ja laadukkaan asiakaskokemuksen tuottamisessa. Työtä tehdään pääsääntöisesti Seinäjoen toimistolta käsin ja työpäiväsi sijoittuvat arkipäivisin klo 9-17 ja lauantaisin klo 10-16 väliselle ajalle.

Mitä toivomme sinulta

- Sujuvaa suomen kielen suullista jakirjallista osaamista asiakaspalvelun laadun varmistamiseksi
- Positiivista ja rentoapalveluasennetta - tavoitteenasi on tuottaa mieleenpainuva asiakaskokemus
- Hyvää tilannetajua sekä kiinnostustaasiakasta kohtaan
- Tavoitteellista suhtautumistaasiakaspalveluun
- Kykyä toimia erilaisissavuorovaikutustilanteissa ja kuunnella asiakasta aidosti
- Iloista ja ratkaisukeskeistälähestymistapaa
Aikaisempi kokemus asiakaspalvelusta on eduksesi, mutta ennen kaikkea etsimme hyvää tyyppiä oikealla asenteella.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

- Paikan kasvavassa yrityksessä ja reippaassa, rempseässä työporukassa
- Joustavan työn, jossa arvostetaan yhdessä tekemisen meininkiä
- Kattavan koulutuksen tehtävään -sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis ammattilainen
- Uudet ja raikkaat toimitilat inspiroivassa työympäristössä Seinäjoen keskustassa
- ICT-alan TES:n mukaisen kuukausipalkan 2174 € / kk (osa-aikaisen tuntipalkka 13,44 €) sekä kannustavan bonusjärjestelmän
- Baronan työterveyspalvelut sekä lounasetu
Tarjoamme tehtävää sekä kokoaikaisena että osa-aikaisena. Etsimme tiimiimme kokoaikaisen (37,5 h/vko) asiakaspalvelijan lisäksi myös osa-aikaista tekijää, jonka työaika on noin 20 tuntia viikossa. Työvuorot sijoittuvat asiakaspalvelumme aukioloaikojen mukaisesti.

Jätäthän hakemuksen pikimmiten, sillä käsittelemme hakemuksia koko rekrytointiprosessin ajan!

Rekrytointiin liittyviin kysymyksiin vastaa Baronan henkilöstökonsultti Anni Kivimäki, anni.kivimaki@barona.fi.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä saat Valoon Severi Mattilalta, puh. 0503218347

jobs.title: Senior Automation Manager, Nørresundby, Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you our new Automation Manager with a passion for technology, leadership, and scalable automation solutions?

At DESMI, you will play a key role in strengthening and scaling our automation capabilities across the organization. You will be part of product development & innovation leading a skilled engineering team in Denmark and China to develop reliable and future-proof automation solutions for both products and customized needs.
Working closely with Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, you will ensure strong alignment between technical solutions and business requirements. You will be responsible for setting direction, creating structure across projects, and ensuring high quality delivery of automation solutions across DESMI's global operations.
DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where collaboration, continuous learning, and professional development are at the core of our culture. In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence the direction of our automation landscape, develop your team, and contribute to building scalable and efficient solutions that support our continued growth.

Ideally, we are looking for someone who is:
Technically grounded
Possess strong leadership and people management skills
Structured and organized

A glimpse into the role
You will lead a team of automation engineers while ensuring that our solutions are robust and aligned with business needs. Your primary responsibilities will include:
-Team Leadership & Development: Lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing automation team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
-Project Execution & Prioritization: Plan, structure, and drive execution across multiple automation projects, ensuring clear priorities, efficient resource allocation, and on-time delivery.
-Technical Direction & Quality Assurance: Set the technical direction for automation solutions across hardware and software, ensuring reliable, serviceable, and future-proof designs.
-Operational Ownership of Automation Solutions: Oversee the development and maintenance of automation systems, translating business and product requirements into standardized, scalable technical solutions.
-Stakeholder Management: Act as the key point of contact for stakeholders across Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, ensuring alignment and clear communication on scope, expectations, and deliverables.
-Process & Solution Optimization: Drive structured and transparent workflows across projects, continuously improving processes and enabling efficient and consistent delivery of automation solutions.
-Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Support the ongoing development of DESMI's automation portfolio by promoting a solution-oriented mindset and identifying opportunities for innovation and standardization.

Your next opportunity starts here
We're looking for an experienced and driven leader with a strong technical foundation in automation and a passion for developing both people and solutions. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

We also imagine that you:
Have minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
Bring a strong technical background within automation, electrical engineering, or a similar field, combined with hands-on experience in both hardware and software design
Are structured and capable of creating clarity and overview in complex project environments with multiple ongoing activities
Have strong planning and resource management skills, enabling you to prioritize effectively and ensure successful project execution
Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders across functions and organizational levels
Take a solution-oriented approach and are comfortable setting direction while supporting your team in delivering robust and scalable solutions
Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success
Are fluent in English, as it is DESMI's corporate language

The perks of being at DESMI
Flexible working hours - including possibilities for remote work.
Global career prospects - work with colleagues across Europe, Asia, and the U.S.
Skills development and career growth - Training, job rotation, and internal mobility
Pension - attractive employer contributions
Private healthcare and life insurance
On-site canteen - light breakfast, lunch buffet, and snacks
Company sports & social activities - from badminton and bowling to art clubs and summer parties

What we're about
But we're more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.
When you join DESMI, you can expect:
A collaborative and supportive team environment.
Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
A company that values sustainability and innovation.

We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive - if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.
As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies - the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

Ready to apply?
If you're a dedicated and motivated individual seeking a challenging and rewarding career where you can contribute to a more sustainable future, we encourage you to apply!

To learn more about this please contact Søren Flummer (SORF@desmi.com). We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Dygtig freelance mødebooker
jobs.description:
Freelance mødebooker søges til B2B-mødebooking

Har du solid erfaring med mødebooking og kold kanvas – og motiveres du af frihed, ansvar og resultater?

Hjælp til salg søger en dygtig og stabil freelance mødebooker til booking af kvalificerede B2B-møder for vores kunder.

Stillingen er for dig, der allerede ved, hvad der skal til for at komme igennem til den rette beslutningstager, skabe en god dialog og booke et relevant møde.

Arbejdet udføres hjemmefra, og du kan derfor befinde dig hvor som helst i Danmark eller resten af verden.

Om arbejdet

Du kommer til at arbejde med udgående telefonisk mødebooking for forskellige danske B2B-virksomheder.

Opgaverne vil typisk bestå af:

  • Telefonisk kontakt til potentielle erhvervskunder

  • Kold kanvas og dialog med relevante beslutningstagere

  • Præsentation af kundens løsning på en professionel og troværdig måde

  • Booking af kvalificerede møder

  • Løbende opfølgning og registrering af aktiviteter

  • Tæt dialog med Hjælp til salg omkring kvalitet, resultater og kundernes ønsker

Vi leder efter dig, der

  • Har dokumenteret erfaring med B2B-mødebooking, telefonsalg eller kold kanvas

  • Har eget CVR-nummer og arbejder som selvstændig freelancer

  • Er stabil, selvkørende og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Kan arbejde struktureret og følge op på dine leads

  • Er god til at skabe tillid og føre en naturlig samtale

  • Taler og forstår dansk

  • Har en professionel telefonstemme og en god forretningsforståelse

  • Kan håndtere afvisninger uden at miste motivationen

  • Har de nødvendige rammer til at arbejde hjemmefra, herunder en stabil internetforbindelse og rolige omgivelser

Erfaring er et krav

Dette er ikke en oplæringsstilling.

Det er et krav, at du allerede har praktisk erfaring med mødebooking, kold kanvas eller opsøgende B2B-telefonsalg. Har du ikke denne erfaring, er stillingen desværre ikke det rette match.

Vi forventer ikke, at du kender alle vores kunder eller brancher på forhånd. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du kender håndværket, kan sætte dig ind i nye løsninger og hurtigt omsætte et manuskript til en troværdig samtale.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fleksibelt freelancearbejde hjemmefra

  • Mulighed for at arbejde fra hele verden

  • Aflønning pr. godkendt og kvalificeret møde

  • Forskellige B2B-kunder og brancher

  • Grundig introduktion til den enkelte kunde og opgave

  • Sparring, feedback og løbende dialog

  • Mulighed for et længerevarende samarbejde for den rette person

  • Frihed under ansvar og mulighed for selv at strukturere din arbejdsdag

Aflønning

Du aflønnes pr. booket møde, der lever op til den enkelte kundes aftalte kriterier.

Den konkrete pris pr. møde afhænger af opgaven og aftales inden opstart. Som freelancer fakturerer du Hjælp til salg fra dit eget CVR-nummer.

Om Hjælp til salg

Hjælp til salg har siden 2017 hjulpet danske virksomheder med professionel B2B-mødebooking.

Vi har fokus på møder med kvalitet. Derfor handler arbejdet ikke blot om at få en aftale i kalenderen, men om at booke relevante møder med de rette beslutningstagere og skabe et godt grundlag for kundens videre salgsdialog.

Vi lægger stor vægt på kvalitet, ærlighed, stabilitet og et professionelt samarbejde.

Sådan søger du

Send en kort ansøgning, hvor du beskriver:

  • Din erfaring med mødebooking og kold kanvas

  • Hvilke typer virksomheder eller brancher du tidligere har arbejdet med

  • Hvilke resultater du tidligere har skabt

  • Hvor mange timer du forventer at kunne arbejde om ugen

  • Hvornår du kan starte

  • Bekræftelse på, at du har eget CVR-nummer

Vedlæg gerne dit CV eller et link til din LinkedIn-profil.

Vi kontakter kun ansøgere, der har relevant erfaring og matcher kravene til stillingen.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Metallien talteenoton käyttövarmuusinsinööri (ODR-insinööri)
jobs.description:
Olemme edelläkävijänä rakentamassa vastuullista ja ilmastoystävällistä akkuarvoketjua Eurooppaan. Liity joukkoomme!

Haemme Terrafamelle Sotkamoon

Metallien talteenoton käyttövarmuusinsinööriä

työskentelemään metallien talteenoton käyttövarmuuden parissa. Työsuhde on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva ja työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian. Kyseessä on päivätyö, jossa on hybridityömahdollisuus.

Tehtävässä vastaat metallien talteenoton laitteiden ja prosessien käyttövarmuuden kehittämisestä ja valvonnasta. Toimit tärkeässä roolissa tuotannon tukena varmistaen, että laitteistot toimivat turvallisesti, tehokkaasti ja tavoitteiden mukaisesti. Kunnossapidon kehittäminen ja ODR-toimintamallin (_Operator Driven Reliability_) jatkuva parantaminen ovat keskeinen osa tehtävääsi. Toimit tuotannon ja tehdaspalvelun välisenä linkkinä kehittäen käyttäjäkeskeistä kunnossapitoa sekä varmistaen, että laitteiden päivittäiseen operointiin, tarkastuksiin ja kunnonhallintaan liittyvät toimintamallit tukevat käyttövarmuuden tavoitteita.

Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä tuotanto-organisaation, tehdaspalvelun, teknisten asiantuntijoiden sekä projektiorganisaation kanssa.

Keskeiset työtehtäväsi:

- Metallien talteenoton laitteiden ja prosessien käyttövarmuuden seuranta, analysointi ja kehittäminen

- Käyttäjäkeskeisen kunnossapidon toimintamallien kehittäminen yhteistyössä tuotannon ja tehdaspalvelun kanssa

- ODR-toimintamallin ylläpitäminen, kehittäminen ja jalkauttaminen tuotanto-organisaatioon

- Laitteiden kunnonhallinnan, tarkastuskäytäntöjen ja vikojen ennakkohavainnoinnin kehittäminen

- Käyttövarmuuteen liittyvien häiriöiden ja vikojen juurisyyanalyysien toteuttaminen

- Kehitystoimenpiteiden määrittäminen ja toteutuksen seuranta yhteistyössä tehdaspalvelun kanssa

- Osallistuminen käyttövarmuuteen liittyviin investointi- ja kehitysprojekteihin

- Käyttö- ja kunnossapitohenkilöstön kouluttaminen sekä osaamisen kehittäminen

- Turvallisuuden, käyttöasteen ja kustannustehokkuuden jatkuva parantaminen


Odotamme sinulta:

- Prosessitekniikan- tai konetekniikan tai vastaavan alan korkeakoulututkintoa

- Kehityshenkistä ja järjestelmällistä työotetta

- Analyyttistä työskentelytapaa

- Hyviä kommunikaatiotaitoja ja halua oppia uutta

- Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa


Meillä pääset kehittämään toimintaa siellä, missä tuotanto ja kunnossapito kohtaavat. Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen prosessi-, metalli- tai kaivosteollisuudesta, käyttövarmuuden ja kunnossapidon kehittämisestä sekä kunnossapitojärjestelmien hyödyntämisestä. Jos lisäksi IT-osaamisesi on erinomaisella tasolla, saat tehtävässä loistavan startin.

Tarjoamme sinulle :

- Vastuullisen tehtävän ainutlaatuisessa akkukemikaalien tuotantoketjussamme

- Laajan perehdytyksen ja ammattitaitoiset työkaverit

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa metallien talteenoton kehittämiseen ja omaan ammatilliseen kehittymiseen

- Kattavan työterveyshuollon ja mielen hyvinvointia tukevat palvelut

- Osallistumismahdollisuuden liikunta- ja kulttuurietuihin ja yhteisiin tapahtumiin

jobs.title: Analyste développeur Odoo (m/f) (réf. E) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Employé de l'État Qui recrute ? Vous vous intéressez à la transformation digitale et vous êtes passionné par l'analyse ? Le poste d'analyste développeur Odoo sera affecté à la division informatique de l'ACD qui travaille activement à la digitalisation des démarches et du parcours client, en se focalisant sur une refonte des systèmes existants, une optimisation des processus tout en assurant un environnement de travail optimal pour les agents. Vous contribuerez directement à moderniser le service public et à améliorer l'expérience des citoyens. L'Administration des contributions directes, forte de plus de  agents, répartis sur  équipes, dans  immeubles et  communes, a pour mission de collecter les impôts et taxes nécessaires au financement des services publics et au bon fonctionnement de l'Etat. Ce rôle vous place au carrefour de l'innovation technologique et de l'impact sociétal, en participant activement à l'avenir numérique et stratégique de l'Etat. Missions En tant qu'analyste développeur, vous ferez partie d'une équipe de développement en charge de la mise en place de solutions logicielles basées sur des technologies modernes. Profil Compétences techniques Expérience professionnelle minimale de plus de 5 ans en développement ; Excellente maîtrise de Python (langage et frameworks associés) ; Bonne maîtrise des technologies web (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, etc.) ; Expérience dans le développement d'ERP (Odoo ou équivalent) ; Connaissances solides en bases de données relationnelles et maîtrise du SQL ; Connaissance des standards et bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel (de la conception à la production) ; Expérience avec des outils de gestion de version (Git ou équivalent) ; Maitrise obligatoire des langues françaises et anglaises. Compétences comportementales Passion pour le développement logiciel et les technologies Open Source ; Intérêt pour le clean code et les architectures logicielles modernes ; Curiosité pour les technologies émergentes ; Capacité à analyser et vulgariser des sujets techniques complexes ; Facilité de collaboration en équipe et bonnes capacités de communication ; Capacité à travailler en autonomie et de manier/ière proactive ; Rigueur, sens de la méthode et respect des échéances. Atouts Contributions à des projets Open Source ; Expérience avec des outils tels que PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes ; Connaissances ou expérience avec des architectures modernes (microservices, etc.) ; Expérience en administration de systèmes Linux ; Expérience dans des environnements de développement collaboratifs et agiles ; La maîtrise des langues luxembourgeoise et allemande constituant un avantage. Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut de l'employé de l'État. Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission pour devenir employé de l'État. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 6 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. jobs.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
jobs.description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

jobs.title: Directeur Adjoint d'Hôtel (H/F)
jobs.description:
Description du poste :

Notre client, groupe en forte croissance sur le marché du coliving, nous mandate pour le recrutement d'un(e) Directeur Adjoint de Résidence (F/H) sur Toulouse.


Au sein d'une résidence de nouvelle génération alliant logements, espaces partagés et services, vous intervenez sur des sujets commerciaux, opérationnels et administratifs liés au fonctionnement général du site. Positionné(e) comme le bras droit de la Direction, vos principales missions sont les suivantes Participer à la commercialisation de la résidence : visites, relances, rédaction et signature des contrats, suivi des arrivées et des départs Contribuer à la mise en place de la politique commerciale et marketing du site (animation des réseaux sociaux, partenariats locaux avec les entreprises, écoles et acteurs du territoire Assurer le suivi quotidien des réservations de court séjour et long séjour en accompagnant l'équipe de réception Coordonner l'activité quotidienne des équipes et des prestataires externes (maintenance, entretien, intervenants événementiels Participer à l'animation de la vie du site : organisation d'évènements, développement de la communauté de résidents, suivi de la satisfaction Définir avec la direction les KPI's spécifiques au co-living et aider au clôtures mensuelles Veiller au respect des procédures et des critères de qualité, d'hygiène et de sécurité Assurer le remplacement du Directeur en cas d'absence Description du profil :

Issu(e) d'une formation en hôtellerie, tourisme ou gestion, vous justifiez d'au moins deux ans d'expérience dans le domaine de l'hôtellerie, de l'hébergement ou de l'exploitation de résidences.


Reconnu(e) pour votre relationnel et votre sens du service, vous êtes à l'aise aussi bien dans la relation client et la vente que dans le suivi administratif. Organisé(e) et rigoureux(se), vous savez prioriser les urgences et gérer les imprévus du quotidien d'un site en exploitation.


La résidence accueillant une clientèle internationale, la maîtrise de l'anglais est exigée pour le poste.


Vous rejoignez un groupe dont le réseau de résidences s'étoffe chaque année, et où les parcours d'évolution interne (vers des fonctions de direction de site ou des périmètres élargis) sont une réalité.


Processus de recrutement : Pré-sélection sur CV > Echange téléphonique > Entretien EOSIUM > Références > Entretiens Client. Une prise de références professionnelles sera réalisée, avec votre accord, : elle permettra d'attester la rigueur et le sérieux dont vous avez fait preuve dans de précédentes fonctions.

jobs.title: Store Manager - dubbu
jobs.description:
About the job

dubbu is expanding in Copenhagen, and we are looking for a Store Manager (37 hours/week) to lead our upcoming store — a new version of a familiar location, now including a small serving area inspired by Korean café culture.

As Store Manager, you will be responsible for the daily operations, the team, and ensuring that both the retail space and the serving area run smoothly every day.

You will work closely with the founder team and have significant influence on how the store develops in the coming years.

Your responsibilities

Leadership & team

  • Daily leadership of the team (scheduling, onboarding, training, and feedback)

  • Ensuring a high standard of customer service and sales

  • Coaching the team to improve performance on the sales floor

Store operations

  • Overseeing daily operations (opening/closing, stock deliveries, inventory, routines)

  • Ensuring the store always appears well-organized and ready for customers

  • Working with simple KPIs (sales, conversion rate, AOV)

Serving area

  • Responsible for the operation of the store’s small café area

  • Ensuring consistent quality and service speed

  • Daily cleaning, hygiene, and maintenance of equipment

  • Training staff in workflow and standards

  • Contributing to the development of new drinks inspired by Korean café culture

We are looking for someone who

  • Has 2–3 years of experience in retail or café environments, preferably with operational responsibility

  • Is structured and comfortable working with routines, checklists, and clear standards

  • Can lead a team and maintain calm and overview in a busy environment

  • Is hands-on and takes ownership of both people and operations

  • Has an eye for detail and understands the importance of a well-executed customer experience

It is a plus if you

  • Have experience with barista work, matcha, or espresso

  • Have worked with food hygiene or basic food safety procedures

  • Have experience with merchandising or retail visuals

  • Have an interest in Korean culture, cafés, or beauty

What we offer

  • A central role in a growing company

  • Close collaboration with the founder team

  • Significant influence on the store’s development

  • A strong team and an ambitious brand universe

  • Staff discount across our entire product range

Application

Start date: as soon as possible

Please send your CV and a short application to:

job@dubbu.dk

Subject line: “Store Manager”

jobs.title: Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE:

Replit is the fastest way to turn ideas into software. With our powerful AI-powered Agent and Assistant, anyone can create and launch apps from natural language in just one click. Build and deploy full-stack applications directly from your browser—no setup required. Never written a line of code in your life? No problem. Replit makes software creation accessible, collaborative, and lightning-fast. Join us in our mission to empower the next generation of builders.

We are seeking a Strategic Finance professional to join Replit's growing team in Foster City, CA. In this critical role, you'll work in a lean team supporting high-impact strategic and operational initiatives across the business to drive data-driven decision making. You’ll partner directly with executive leadership and the Board to align financial strategies with our ambitious growth objectives. This role reports to the Head of Finance.




ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

You'll contribute to critical projects across three main core areas:

Internal Strategic & Operational Initiatives

 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Sales, Marketing, Support, Product, and Engineering teams to build financial models and analyses that drive organizational decision-making

 - New product launches: Build and present financial models, business cases, and investment analyses for new product launches

 - GTM Finance: Partner with go-to-market leadership to drive growth through sales capacity planning, funnel and pipeline analytics, pricing strategy and resource allocation

 - Pricing & Packaging: Analyze pricing and packaging strategies using quantitative and qualitative frameworks to recommend optimal approaches

 - Unit Economics: Recommend strategies that balance growth investments with operational efficiency to achieve long-term margin targets

 - International Growth: Analyze global expansion opportunities including localization, regional pricing strategies, go-to-market approaches, and commercial partnerships

 - Enterprise Sales: Partner with sales leadership to scale enterprise sales operations and strategy

Corporate Strategy & Planning

 - Long-Range Planning: Collaborate with FP&A team on forecasting, financial planning, long-range planning, growth headcount planning, and overall financial strategy

 - Board Reporting: Assist in preparing quarterly board materials and presentations

 - Market Insights: Conduct competitive analysis and industry research to inform strategic planning

Corporate Development & Investor Relations

 - Corporate Development: Support corporate development initiatives including M&A, joint ventures, and strategic partnerships from initial sourcing through execution and integration

 - Investor Relations & Fundraising: Support investor relations activities including fundraising, investor communications, and preparation of materials for investors



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 3-6 years in investment banking, private equity, consulting, business operations, and/or strategic finance

 - Experience with SQL, Python, or other data analysis tools

 - An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

 - Self-directed with a strong work ethic and ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines

 - Expert-level financial modeling skills and proficiency with business intelligence tools

 - Strong presence and communication skills

 - Exceptional business judgment with the ability to synthesize complex data into actionable strategic insights

Join Replit and help shape the financial future of a platform that's revolutionizing how people learn, build, and deploy software with AI.




BONUS POINTS: 

 - Experience in strategic finance or related field at a scaling technology company

 - Current Replit user

 - Background in AI or enterprise technology companies

 - Understanding of compute and infrastructure costs in tech environments


This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: ASISTENT/ICA U PRODAJI I PRETPRODAJI
jobs.description:
Opis posla:
  • istraživati tržište i pronalaziti građevinske tvrtke koje odgovaraju našoj ciljanoj skupini
  • sastavljati i redovito ažurirati popise potencijalnih korisnika
  • pronalaziti vlasnike, direktore i druge osobe odgovorne za donošenje odluka
  • istraživati osnovne podatke o tvrtki prije prvog kontakta
  • kontaktirati potencijalne korisnike putem e-maila i telefona
  • predstaviti razlog javljanja i provjeriti postoji li interes za razgovor
  • voditi komunikaciju od prvog kontakta do dogovaranja prodajne prezentacije
  • zakazivati termine i pripremati prodaji informacije o potencijalnom korisniku
  • voditi urednu evidenciju svih kontakata i aktivnosti u HubSpotu
  • pratiti dogovorene rokove i planirati ponovne kontakte
  • pripremati i slati ponude, ugovore i fakture prema postojećim predlošcima
  • surađivati s prodajom i osobom zaduženom za odnose s korisnicima
  • na početku ćete upoznati Insidico, postojeće korisnike i probleme koje aplikacija rješava
  • proći ćete naš način pronalaska potencijalnih korisnika, primjere dosadašnjih e-mailova i poziva, pravila rada u hubspotu te način na koji se dogovorena prezentacija predaje prodaji
  • prve popise kontakata, e-mailove i pozive prolazit ćemo zajedno. Cilj je da nakon razdoblja uhodavanja možete samostalno organizirati svoj rad i voditi pretprodajne aktivnosti
  • opseg aktivnosti i očekivani rezultati prilagođavat će se dogovorenom broju radnih sati
Poslodavac traži:
  • tražimo osobu koja zna jasno komunicirati, dobro organizirati svoj rad i samostalno doći do potrebnih informacija
  • važno nam je da nemate problem nazvati osobu s kojom prethodno niste razgovarali.U ovom poslu bit će neodgovorenih e-mailova, odbijenih poziva i odgovora da tvrtka trenutačno nije zainteresirana. Očekujemo da takve situacije prihvatite kao normalan dio prodajnog procesa i nastavite raditi bez nepotrebnog pritiska na potencijalnog korisnika.
  • prethodno iskustvo u prodaji nije uvjet. Spremni smo raditi i s osobom koja tek ulazi u prodaju, ali očekujemo interes za učenje, samostalnost i odgovornost prema dogovorenim zadacima.
Uvjeti:
  • najmanje završena srednja škola
  • razvijene usmene i pisane komunikacijske vještine
  • organiziranost i sposobnost određivanja prioriteta
  • samostalnost, upornost i snalažljivost
  • urednost u vođenju podataka i praćenju rokova
  • dobro poznavanje rada na računalu
  • korištenje programa Microsoft Office i Outlook
  • spremnost na rad u HubSpotu, Google kalendaru, Google Meetu i internim alatima
  • aktivno znanje hrvatskog jezika
  • B2B prodaji ili telefonskom kontaktiranju potencijalnih korisnika
  • istraživanju tržišta i izradi baza kontakata
  • radu u CRM sustavu, posebno HubSpotu
  • građevinskoj industriji
  • prodaji softvera ili drugih poslovnih usluga
Poslodavac nudi:
  • rad na nepuno radno vrijeme uz mogućnost kasnijeg prelaska na puno radno vrijeme
  • mogućnost rada putem ugovora o radu ili studentskog ugovora
  • fleksibilan raspored unutar unaprijed dogovorenog broja sati
  • rad iz našeg ureda u Osijeku
  • mogućnost djelomičnog rada od kuće nakon razdoblja uhodavanja
  • dogovoreni sustav nagrađivanja prema rezultatima
  • rad u malom timu u kojem ćete izravno surađivati s prodajom i Customer Successom
  • detaljan onboarding i podršku tijekom prvih mjeseci
  • mogućnost napredovanja prema samostalnom vođenju prodajnih prezentacija i prodajnih procesa
Postupak odabira: Kandidati koji uđu u uži izbor bit će pozvani na razgovor i praktično testiranje. Testiranje će uključivati zadatke povezane s istraživanjem potencijalnih korisnika, pisanom komunikacijom, organizacijom rada i kratkom simulacijom telefonskog razgovora. Ne očekujemo da prije razgovora poznajete sve funkcionalnosti Insidica. Zanima nas kako razmišljate, pronalazite informacije, komunicirate i organizirate zadatke. Prijava Pošaljite životopis na matej@insidico.com najkasnije do 01. rujna 2026. Planirani početak rada je tijekom rujna 2026., prema dogovoru s odabranim kandidatom.

jobs.title: Seasonal Chef Opportunities in LEGOLAND® Billund, Denmark (Koch/Köchin)
jobs.description:
Seasonal Chef Opportunities in LEGOLAND® Billund, Denmark

Are you an experienced chef looking for an exciting opportunity in Denmark?

LEGOLAND® Billund is one of Denmark’s most iconic destinations, home to the original LEGOLAND® Park and three unique accommodation facilities: Hotel LEGOLAND®, Castle Hotel LEGOLAND®, and LEGOLAND® Village.

We are currently recruiting chefs for the 2026 high season. Every day, we welcome thousands of holiday guests from around the world as well as conference and business visitors. If you enjoy working in a professional, fast-paced kitchen environment and take pride in delivering high-quality food experiences, we would love to hear from you.

What We Offer

• A unique opportunity to work in one of Denmark’s most popular tourist destinations

• A diverse workplace serving both international leisure guests and conference visitors

• A friendly, supportive, and multicultural team environment

• A fixed work schedule with the possibility of additional hours

• Employment under Danish collective agreements, ensuring fair working conditions and security

• Competitive salary: 29000 DKK -31000 DKK per month, depending on qualifications and experience

• Start date: 1 July 2026, or as soon as possible

• Employment until 30 September 2026, with the possibility of extension

• Assistance with practical arrangements, including accommodation, registration, and settling into life in Denmark

We Are Looking For

• Qualified chefs, or candidates with a minimum of 3 years’ experience in a professional kitchen

• Team players who are positive, reliable, and service-oriented

• Individuals who can work independently and take responsibility for their tasks

• Professionals who thrive in a busy, dynamic environment

• Candidates who can communicate in English or Danish

• Applicants who can start no later than 1 July 2026

Work Eligibility

To be eligible for this position, you must have the legal right to work in Denmark. This means you are either:

• A citizen of an EU/EEA country, or

• In possession of a valid Danish residence and work permit

Interested?

Please send us your CV as soon as possible.

For questions about the position, please contact Niels Switzer, Senoir head chef på

niels.switzer@legoland.dk.

If you have any general questions about your stay, please contact People Partner, Marie-Louise

Bredvig, at llb-hrsupport@legoland.dk

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and positions will be filled as soon as we find the right

candidates.

Join us for an exciting summer season in Denmark and become part of a team that creates

memorable experiences for guests from all over the world.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Hyderabad Infra team builds and maintains Notion's internal async task runner and configuration management platform. The async task runner plays a critical role in ensuring our millions of users have a fast, reliable, and secure experience. The configuration management platform enables safe, explicit configuration management for Notion's product and infrastructure engineers.



As part of the Hyderabad Infra Team, you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape how Notion manages and scales its async task runner and configuration management platform, enabling innovation across the company.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - You will contribute to the evolution and maintenance of our async task runner to meet the needs of over 100 million global users and support the rapid growth of our product and business. 

 - With guidance from senior team members, you'll help ensure our systems remain reliable, efficient, and scalable. You'll evaluate and integrate new technologies to keep us ahead of emerging challenges. 

 - Your work will empower our engineering team to build features confidently while you grow your skills in distributed systems and infrastructure.

 - You will develop the skills and confidence to debug live production systems with minimal disruption, whether replacing components or managing failovers. You will participate in an on-call rotation, responding to incidents to uphold service reliability and quickly restore normal operations.

 - You will partner with product engineers and other infra teams to ensure our platforms align with evolving business needs and product goals.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - A software developer with at least 4 years of experience and the ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.

 - Systems thinker: You understand distributed systems and can design solutions that account for tradeoffs like consistency, latency, and scalability.

 - Pragmatic problem-solver: You prioritize business impact and understand the balance between craft, speed, and long-term maintainability. You’re opinionated but not ideological, and you learn new technologies as you go.

 - Ownership and initiative: You thrive in a fast-moving, unstructured environment and are comfortable taking ownership of ambiguous problems. You act with a bias toward action and focus on results.

 - Customer Empathy: You excel at collaborating across teams, offering guidance and solutions to unblock engineers and support them in building reliable systems. With empathy at the core of your approach, you focus on addressing the needs of those who depend on the async task runner.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Production Designer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We’re looking for a Designer with strong visual taste to help scale Linear’s creative work across web, brand, and marketing. You’ll create polished, high-quality designs across a wide range of surfaces — from landing pages and ad campaigns to sales decks and launch materials — helping bring Linear’s visual language to life everywhere people experience our brand.

When it comes to design, we’re looking to work with people who can pick up any problem and solve it. For us, it’s both how it works and how it looks. At its core, Linear is a developer tool where speed, interactions, and small details matter. We expect a broad set of design skills and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes.

In this role, you will help communicate Linear's story (what we're building and why it matters) as part of our internal creative agency: the Magic Team.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in North American or European time zones. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Work with Marketing to design landing pages, ad campaigns, sales decks, and launch materials

 - Partner with the Magic Team to extend and scale Linear’s visual language across new campaigns and creative surfaces

 - Collaborate with designers, developers, and copywriters to create cohesive marketing experiences across web, social, and brand

What we're looking for

 - Around 2+ years of experience designing for web, marketing, or brand.

 - Excellent visual, UI, motion and interactive design skills

 - Eye for good design, attention to detail, and a genuine love for the craft

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

 - Part I https://linear.app/blog/a-design-reset and Part II https://linear.app/blog/how-we-redesigned-the-linear-ui of how we redesigned the Linear UI

 - Read me https://linear.app/readme a story about our mission

 - Our hiring process: How we hire at Linear https://linear.app/now/how-we-hire-at-linear

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

 - Why and how we do work trials https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear Linear blog post

 - How we structure our product teams https://www.youtube.com/watch?index=59&list=PLXDU_eVOJTx402DljIPagaDKLibF-qfF0&v=I4vvBidQcck talk by our Head of Product, Nan Yu, at Config 2024

 - Crafting quality that endures https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pCil7YNhNCU Config keynote by our Co-founder & CEO, Karri Saarinen

 - Building for quality: Our Investment in Linear https://accel.com/noteworthy/our-investment-in-linear Accel Series B blog post

 - Read about our recent Series C Fundraise https://linear.app/now/building-our-way and Giving our team liquidity https://linear.app/now/giving-our-team-liquidity-through-linear-s-first-tender-offer

Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

A note on recruitment fraud: all official Linear hiring communication comes from an @linear.app http://linear.app email address, and all open roles are listed at linear.app/careers http://linear.app/careers. We never ask candidates for payment or financial information. Suspicious messages can be reported to security@linear.app.

You enjoy working independently, are comfortable working with numbers and reports, and can keep deadlines even when several tasks need attention at the same time. Previous experience with international VAT reporting and knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 would be an advantage.

We offer: We offer modern working conditions in an office building near Ülemiste Centre, a friendly team, interesting work-related challenges, flexible working arrangements, the possibility to work from home up to two days per week, employee benefits related to the aviation industry, stability and a competitive motivation package.

Other requirements: This role could be a good fit for you if you are accurate, responsible and detail-oriented. You enjoy working independently, are comfortable working with numbers and reports, and can keep deadlines even when several tasks need attention at the same time.

We are a great place to work, driven by simplicity, agility and sustainability."
Poste et missions
Vous rejoignez l'équipe de Vincent, composée de 22 personnes en tant que Business Analyst Senior.Vous intégrerez l'équipe Data en place au sein de BPCE ES, répartie entre Paris et Bangalore. Cette équipe a en charge la gestion de la plateforme Data utilisée pour le pilotage commercial, financier, risque et Conformité de BPCE ES. Elle est aussi porteuse des principes Data à appliquer dans les projets de la Business Unit, sur la Data Quality ou la Protection des données.Dans cette équipe, vous aurez notamment l'occasion de contribuer au programme d'intégration de BPCE ES dans le Groupe BPCE, ainsi qu'au support des sujets transverses de la filière Data.Au quotidien, vous avez pour missions de :Recueillir les besoins auprès des Métiers, spécifications et validation des développements de la plateforme Data & Reporting réalisés dans l'équipe Accompagner les entités de la BU sur les évolutions de la plateforme Data et de la filière DataSupporter l'équipe dans les activités de Data Management, notamment le pilotage des usages DataContribuer aux pratiques agiles de l'équipe (slicing, priorisation par la valeur.) et accompagner le métier dans la transformation agileVous aurez l'occasion de partager de votre expérience au sein d'un environnement multiculturel (collaborateurs à Bangalore) et très en lien avec les Métiers et leurs problématiques. Une expérience de développement off-shore serait un plus.

jobs.description:
A Note from the Founder

Why Sticky is Free to Use

Hey â I'm Hamza Saleem, the solo developer behind Sticky.today.

In May 2026, I made a decision most SaaS founders won't make: I fired our payment processor and made Sticky completely free for everyone.

Here's why.

Software Should Be Free

Sticky started as a paid product. Pro plans, trials, subscriptions â the usual SaaS playbook. And it worked. People paid. But something felt off.

The best tools I've ever used didn't ask for my credit card. They just worked. Obsidian, VS Code, Blender â tools that respected me enough to not put a gate between me and my work. I wanted Sticky to be that kind of tool.

So I tore out every line of billing code. No more trials. No more upgrade prompts. No more payment gateways. Just a fast, free canvas for your ideas.

The Internet Has Enough Gatekeepers

Look around â every productivity tool wants $10-20/month from you. Per seat. Per feature. It adds up. And for what? Most of them are glorified text editors with a subscription attached.

Sticky is different. It's a spatial thinking tool built by one person who actually uses it every day. There's no board of investors demanding recurring revenue. There's no pressure to add "enterprise features" nobody asked for. There's just me, building software I believe in, and you, using it however you want.

I don't think thinking should cost money. Your brain doesn't charge you rent. Neither should your canvas.

What You Get (For Free)

Unlimited Boards

Create as many canvases as you need. No caps, no limits.

Real-Time Collaboration

Share boards and work together with live cursors.

AI Idea Generator

Brainstorm with GPT-4o-mini. 10 free generations per day.

Self-Hosting

MIT licensed. Run it on your own infrastructure.

Dynamic Tables

Insert editable tables alongside your sticky notes.

Dark Mode

Easy on the eyes. Built in from day one.

What's Next?

Sticky will keep improving. I'm building it in public â follow along on Twitter/X or check out the source code on GitHub. No investors. No roadmap dictated by revenue targets. Just a guy building software he believes in, for people who actually want to use it.

If you read this far, thanks. If Sticky helps you think, that's the win.

Follow on X View on GitHub

â Hamza Saleem, May 2026

Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



TEAM

Brand & Creative defines how Replit shows up in the world and leads the creative work that brings it to market. Brand & Creative ensures that what Replit is and what Replit makes remain aligned. Resulting in a clear, consistent, and differentiated brand experience across the company.




ROLE

The Brand Designer is responsible for defining, developing, and maintaining the Replit brand system. The role focuses on core brand foundations and their application across key surfaces, including product and marketing. In partnership with internal and external partners, this role ensures the brand is clear, consistent, and scalable across all touchpoints. This role reports to the Brand & Creative Lead.

jobs.title: Associate Development Director and Advisor
jobs.description:
About Contradictum Advisory ehf.

Contradictum Advisory ehf. is a startup dedicated to advising international intellectual property holders in the management and licensing their assets with the objective to steer part of that revenue stream into underfunded projects in Iceland.  Particular emphasis is placed on projects that both serve an immediate domestic need in Iceland and that would meet eligibility requirements under the European Union Green Bond Standard and qualify for the Nordic Swan ecolabel.
Associate Development Director and Advisor.

This is a client-facing position comprised of two primary areas of competence.  The first is in providing advisory and consulting services to intellectual property owners in the North American Market with respect to the use, management, and monetization of their IP portfolios.  The second is in facilitating the investment of IP derived revenue into Iceland-based projects.  Our customer base is comprised of individuals, privately held companies, and family offices who are open diversifying their holdings in EEA and EFTA jurisdictions.  Your role will be to effectively assist clients with maximizing IP derived revenue and presenting opportunities to invest that revenue into target projects in Iceland.  A solid understanding of intellectual property, contracts, procurement processes is essential.  

Main tasks and Responsibilities:
•    Provide strategic direction to clients with respect to intellectual property licensing within the relevant jurisdictional frameworks of each client portfolio.
•    Prepare and present pitch decks to potential investment partners.  
•    Develop investment-ready Iceland-based project proposals.
•    Manage and develop local network of interested counterpart stakeholder and professional service providers related to each project proposal.
•    Identify and liaise with potential new high-net-worth individual investors and small-midsized family office clients in North, Central, and South American markets.
•    Demonstrate extraordinary discretion in all interactions with clients, maintaining the utmost in confidentiality and candor.

Education and licensing:
•    Advanced university-level business or legal education required.  Doctorate of Jurisprudence or Masters of Business Administration with coursework in contracts or international transactions from a top university strongly preferred.
•    Educational coursework in environmental or natural resources usage from an Icelandic University preferred.
•    Admittance to practice before to any US Federal Court.
•    Membership in any North America-based First Nation or Tribal Bar Association strongly preferred.

Qualification Requirements:
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in intellectual property licensing.
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in real property development or prime-contractor representation is highly desirable
•    Minimum 3years of experience in international transactions is highly desirable.
•    Solid Understanding of USPTO and EUIPO standards and procedures.
•    Knowledge of securities and BizOp regulatory standards and requirements is highly desirable.
•    Ability to operate effectively in a multi-time-zone framework convenient to international client domestic work hours.

Language Skills:  Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation English skills are essential.  Additional languages are beneficial.
English [Required] Expert Level
Icelandic [Optional] Intermediate
Spanish [Optional] Intermediate

Compensation:
Compensation is chiefly commission based plus a minimum base salary of 500,000 ISK per month.

Work Hours:
Flexible working hours generally overlapping with the North American Market.  Schedule is expected to vary based on specific client/project needs.
Contact:  For more information, please contact us at CAEHF@proton.me

Vi söker dig som studerar eller redan har utbildning inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen.

Inom hemvården ger vi stöd att bo kvar hemma och leva ett självständigt liv. Vi hjälper till med dagliga sysslor, personlig omvårdnad, socialt stöd eller vård i hemmet. Arbetet är självständigt och du jobbar i två skift, arbetstiderna är mellan kl.7.00-21.00. Arbetet sker främst i de två olika Folkhälsan husen samt i närheten av dem i Ekenäs. jobs.title: Liikuntaleikkikoulun ohjaaja
jobs.description:

- 18:40-19:25 / 2022-syntyneet


Liikuntaleikkikoulu eli liikkari on monipuolinen liikuntakerho 2-6-vuotiaille tytöille ja pojille. Liikuntaleikkikoulussa lapsi oppii kehon hallintaa, perusliikkeitä ja yhdessäoloa sekä kokee oivaltamisen iloa ja onnistumisen elämyksiä.

Liikuntaleikkikoulun ohjaajan tehtäviin kuuluu

- Tuntien suunnittelu ja näiden turvallinen toteuttaminen yhdessä ohjaajaparin kanssa

- Vanhempien kanssa kommunikointi, sekä mahdollisten ongelmatilanteiden selvittäminen


Seuraamme sopii ohjaajaksi täysi-ikäiset innostavat, positiiviset hakijat, joiden mielenkiinto on lasten liikunnassa. Erityisen tärkeää on myös välittävä asenne ohjauksessa lasten positiivisten liikuntakokemusten varmistamiseksi.

Eduksi katsotaan:

- kokemus lasten liikuntaryhmien ohjaamisesta

- alaa opiskelevat tai alalta valmistuneet (liikunnanohjaaja, liikuntaneuvoja, opettaja, varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja, lähihoitaja tms.)

- oma liikuntatausta

- liikuntaleikkikoulun ohjaajakoulutus

jobs.title: Business Development Representative, MEA
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.



This role will be based in either Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy

 - Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers

 - Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

 - Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

 - Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response

 - Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions consultants up for high-quality first conversations

 - Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

 - High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritize based on signal and data, not just volume

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Fluency in Arabic.




NICE TO HAVES:

 -  Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar GTM tooling

 - Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Background in a high-velocity, metric-driven outbound environment with clear pipeline targets

jobs.title: Koulupsykologi, Perhekeskus, Kaarina
jobs.description:
Työskentelet koulupsykologina Kaarinan opiskeluhuollossa S:t Karins svenska skolanissa ja Piispanlähteen koululla (1.-6. luokat) sekä näiden koulujen esiopetusyksiköissä. Tuot psykologista asiantuntijuutta esiopetuksen ja oppilaitoksen käyttöön ja olet mukana tukemassa lasten oppimista, kasvua, kehitystä ja hyvinvointia. Arjessasi yhdistyvät yksilötyö, yhteisöllinen työ ja monialainen yhteistyö koulun henkilöstön sekä opiskeluhuollon muiden ammattilaisten kanssa.

Työssäsi psykologin asiantuntemusta arvostetaan ja se nähdään kouluyhteisössä tärkeänä. Tukenasi ovat johtava koulupsykologi sekä alueen kokenut psykologitiimi, jotka ovat aina tarvittaessa saatavilla.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu:
-oppilaan yksilökohtainen tuki ja ohjaus asiakastyössä oppimiseen, kasvuun, kehitykseen ja hyvinvointiin liittyen
-osallistuminen monialaisen asiantuntijaryhmän työskentelyyn
-yhteisöllinen työ oppilaitoksella
-oppimisvaikeuksien kartoitus.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja merkityksellisen työn, jossa voit suunnitella työpäiväsi joustavasti liukuvaa työaikaa ja osittaista etätyötä hyödyntäen. Saat kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään, mahdollisuuden perustellusti yksilötyönohjaukseen sekä halutessasi kokeneen psykologin mentoriksi. Tuemme osaamisesi kehittymistä ja tarjoamme mahdollisuuden kouluttautua esimerkiksi Terapiat etulinjaan -koulutuksiin. Työhyvinvointisi ja ammatillinen kasvu ovat meille tärkeitä.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Odotamme sinulta sujuvaa suomen ja ruotsin kielen taitoa, kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn sekä hyviä verkosto- ja tiimityötaitoja. Tehtävä edellyttää oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta. Eduksi katsotaan kokemus lasten, nuorten ja perheiden kanssa tehdystä työstä. Huomioimme myös opintojen loppuvaiheessa olevat hakijat.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain 559/94 mukainen psykologin laillistus.

Hae mukaan tekemään vaikuttavaa työtä lasten ja nuorten hyvinvoinnin ja oppimisen tueksi Kaarinaan - odotamme hakemustasi!
