jobs.title: Supply Chain Consultant, Central Jutland, Denmark
jobs.description:
Six months in Delhi. A career without borders.
Are you ready to take your next career move? This opportunity will take you into the international world of fashion and textile business.Our client is a well-established Scandinavian private label and sourcing company with more than fifteen years of experience serving leading European fashion brands. From its headquarters in Denmark, supported by international sourcing and production teams across Asia and Europe, the business has built a reputation for reliability, long-term partnerships and responsible growth. Today, the company is financially strong, highly respected within the industry and entering an ambitious new phase of international expansion.Having successfully developed a mature sourcing platform in China, the next strategic step is India.

To support that journey, we are looking for an internationally minded Supply Chain Consultant who wants far more than another supply chain position.

A role that starts with an adventure... and becomes a career.
For the first six months, you will be based in Delhi. Not simply visiting suppliers. Not attending occasional meetings. But becoming part of the local organisation, working alongside experienced colleagues and helping establish the processes, collaboration and operational excellence that will support the company's future growth in India.You will experience the business from the inside, build relationships across cultures and gain an understanding of international sourcing that few professionals acquire this early in their careers.When first step og your assignment is complete, you will return to Denmark, continuing in an international position with regular travel between Europe and India, helping connect people, ideas and operations across continents. This is not a temporary assignment. It is the beginning of a long-term international career.

More than supply chain.
You will work with sourcing, production, governance, quality and operational processes. But your real contribution will be something much bigger. You will help transfer proven ways of working into a growing international organisation. You will build relationships between colleagues from different cultures. You will support local teams, develop new ways of working and help ensure that ambitious growth is matched by consistent execution. Success in this role will depend just as much on your ability to earn trust as your ability to optimise processes.

Who are you?
Perhaps you are already working as a Buyer, Merchandiser, Production Coordinator, Supply Chain Specialist or Sourcing Consultant within fashion, textiles or consumer goods.You have developed a solid commercial understanding of production and supply chain and now find yourself looking for something larger than the next promotion. You enjoy responsibility. You are naturally curious. You communicate confidently with people from different cultures. You don't mind leaving your comfort zone if it means accelerating your professional development.And while many people talk about wanting an international career, you are genuinely prepared to live it.Previous experience working with suppliers in India would be highly valued, although your attitude, curiosity and ability to build relationships will be equally important.

Why this opportunity stands out
Few organisations can offer the combination of stability and adventure that this role provides.You will join a profitable, well-established international company with an experienced leadership team, an ambitious growth strategy and a genuine commitment to developing its people.During your assignment in Delhi, accommodation and practical support will be provided, allowing you to focus on the experience itself rather than the logistics. This also means that you will have a driver available, as well as help in the household.More importantly, you will gain something that cannot easily be taught in a classroom or acquired through occasional business travel; international credibility, cross-cultural leadership experience, and the confidence that comes from helping build an organisation across borders.

Interested?
If you are looking for a career that combines international experience, meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to influence how an ambitious organisation grows, we would very much like to hear from you.We make it easy for you, so no written application is necessary. We simply ask you to register with your CV. Your interest will be handled with utmost discretion.

The Product Support Manager will be responsible for leading a team of Product Support Specialists in Hyderabad. You will collaborate closely with the Hyderabad Site Lead, regional Heads of Support, and User Operations leadership to ensure cohesive product support operations across the global team. This role will surface customer and product usage trends, drive resolution for executive-level product escalations, and continuously improve global support and escalation processes. The successful candidate should bring deep expertise in product support and escalation management, including experience driving process improvements and collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams.

They will also have strong experience managing a high-performing team of product support specialists across multiple levels, ensuring timely issue resolution, operational excellence, and a seamless customer experience.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - You are extremely user-focused, with a passion for solving problems that increase the user quality of life for customers.

 - You are deeply passionate about developing others, finding energy and purpose in mentoring team members to reach their full potential, and taking pride in seeing them thrive under your leadership.

 - Strong technical support foundations, including log reading and basic debugging, core API concepts, webhook fundamentals, and SSO basics (OAuth and SAML).

 - Proficiency in incorporating AI into day-to-day work (e.g., drafting and refining customer responses, summarizing context, analyzing trends, and accelerating troubleshooting) while applying strong judgment, privacy, and quality standards.

 - Proven ability to triage, troubleshoot, and handle support tickets end-to-end, including prioritization/severity judgment, clear written communication, and timely stakeholder updates.

 - You have strong data reporting and data analytics skills.

 - Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

 - Experience handling business intelligence tools and systems such as Salesforce, Zendesk, Hex, Looker.

 - Experience building robust and scalable processes spanning across go-to-market and technical teams.

 - Ability to deep dive and own projects individually while also delegating and empowering team members to deliver.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

jobs.title: Hotelportier for Boutique Hotel Herman K
jobs.description:
Portier

We are looking for a professional, courteous, and service-oriented Portier who is passionate about hospitality and creating exceptional guest experiences for our Boutique Hotel in the heart of Copenhagen. As one of the first and last team members our guests encounter, you play a vital role in ensuring every arrival and departure leaves a lasting impression.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys being active throughout the day, and takes pride in delivering service with attention to detail. You are approachable, proactive, and professional, with the ability to remain calm and organized even during busy periods.

As part of our team, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the daily operation of a luxury 5-star boutique hotel while working alongside dedicated colleagues who share a passion for excellence, teamwork, and genuine hospitality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Welcome guests warmly upon arrival and wish them a memorable farewell upon departure.

  • Assist guests with luggage to and from their rooms.

  • Support the Front Office team with arrivals, departures, and ensuring a seamless check-in experience.

  • Open doors and escort guests throughout the hotel when needed.

  • Provide information about the hotel, its facilities, and local attractions.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and welcoming entrance, lobby, and surrounding guest areas.

  • Coordinate with Hosts, Housekeeping, and other departments to deliver a seamless guest experience.

  • Respond promptly and professionally to guest requests with discretion and attention to detail.

  • Assist with luggage storage, deliveries, and other operational tasks as required.

  • Help create a warm, welcoming atmosphere that reflects the hotel's high service standards.

What We Offer

  • A key role in creating memorable first and last impressions for our guests.

  • The opportunity to work in a prestigious luxury 5-star boutique hotel.

  • A varied and dynamic working day with guests from around the world.

  • A supportive and professional team environment where collaboration, hospitality, and respect are at the heart of everything we do.

  • Opportunities for personal and professional development through training, coaching, and continuous learning.

  • A workplace with high ambitions, short decision-making processes, and the freedom to take responsibility.

  • Competitive salary and attractive employee benefits.

What We're Looking For

  • Previous experience in hospitality, customer service, or a guest-facing role is an advantage, but not essential.

  • You are friendly, approachable, and genuinely enjoy creating great guest experiences.

  • You work in a structured and reliable manner while taking responsibility for your tasks.

  • You communicate confidently and professionally in English; additional languages are an advantage.

  • You remain calm under pressure and can maintain a positive attitude during busy periods.

  • You are proactive, solution-oriented, and enjoy working as part of a team.

  • You have excellent attention to detail and take pride in maintaining high standards.

  • You are flexible and comfortable working evenings, weekends, and public holidays as required.

  • If the role includes valet parking, a valid driver's license is an advantage but not required for all candidates.

If you are passionate about luxury hospitality and take pride in creating unforgettable guest experiences, we would love to hear from you.

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your application no later than 15 August 2026.

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Zeljka Stefanic Urbina at teamlead@hermank.dk. Please include "Portier" in the subject line of your email.

Part of Bühlmann Hotels

Bühlmann Hotels is home to a collection of unique hotels across Denmark, ranging from vibrant city hotels to iconic boutique properties. While each hotel has its own distinctive character, we are united by a shared commitment to exceptional hospitality and the values that define our culture: care, flexibility, presence, passion, and respect for people and the environment.

Learn more about our hotels at www.buhlmann.dk.

We’re looking for a Finance Business Partner to join Notion’s Strategic Finance team. The ideal candidate brings deep FP&A expertise and a passion for automation and continuous improvement.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
## About Outsite

 

Outsite is a global coliving company for remote workers — hotel-quality service, extended-stay flexibility, and a built-in community, at the intersection of hospitality and lifestyle. We operate 40+ properties across 21+ cities on 5 continents, with 6,000+ verified members and an NPS of 65.

 

## About Outsite for Teams

 

Outsite for Teams is Outsite's B2B expansion — giving companies, teams, and communities access to our global network of coliving and coworking spaces for their employees. Rather than a bulk discount, we position it as a meaningful perk: founders and leaders purchase memberships on behalf of their team, and a dedicated account manager keeps them active and engaged. This is a genuine growth priority for the business, and you'll be one of the first dedicated sales hires driving it.

 

## Role Overview

 

We're hiring a Business Development Representative to build and run outbound sales for Outsite for Teams. You'll identify and prospect the right companies, run discovery calls, and close new business — turning remote-first startups, distributed teams, and growth-stage companies into long-term Outsite for Teams accounts.

 

This is a highly autonomous, build-it-yourself role. You'll help shape the outbound playbook, not just execute someone else's.

 

## Key Responsibilities

 

### 1. Prospecting & Outbound

- Build and work target lists of remote-first and hybrid companies, using signals like team size (50–500), remote/hybrid language in company descriptions, and titles such as Head of People, Chief of Staff, VP of Operations, or Founder

- Source leads via LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Wellfound/AngelList, Crunchbase, remote job boards (We Work Remotely, Remote.co), and Outsite's own member base

- Run cold outbound via email, LinkedIn, and calls, and continuously test and refine messaging

- Reach out to local companies near Outsite locations to sell business travel and corporate stay packages

- Build partnerships with travel agencies and tour operators to generate referral and bundled-stay opportunities

 

### 2. Sales & Pipeline Management

- Run discovery calls to understand a prospect's team, travel patterns, and remote work culture

- Own the full sales cycle from first touch to close

- Keep the CRM clean and current — every deal staged, every next step logged

- Forecast pipeline accurately and hit monthly/quarterly new business targets

 

### 3. Collaboration & Handoff

- Partner with the Head of Marketing on positioning, collateral, and campaigns that support outbound

- Hand off closed accounts cleanly to the account management side, with full context on the client's goals

- Share market feedback — what's resonating, what isn't — to sharpen Outsite for Teams' pitch and ICP over time

 

### 4. Reporting

- Report weekly on pipeline: volume, stage, conversion, and blockers

- Track and share what's working in outbound so it can be systematized

 

## Required Skills & Experience

 

- 1+ years of B2B sales or business development experience (SDR/BDR background a plus)

- Confident, consultative communicator — comfortable running discovery calls with founders and People leaders

- Self-starter who's built pipeline from scratch, not just worked warm leads

- Able to work autonomously and independently 

- Comfortable with taking initiative and being proactive 

- Comfortable working European timezone hours

- Strong written communication — outbound copy is part of the job

- Organized; keeps a CRM honest without being told to

- Comfortable using AI in workflow

 

## Nice to Have

 

- Experience selling to remote-first or distributed teams

- Familiarity with Pipedrive or HubSpot

- Existing network in the startup, remote work, or travel/hospitality space

- Experience selling a membership, subscription, or perk-style product

 

## What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

 

- A working, documented outbound playbook (lists, messaging, cadence)

- A full and accurately-staged pipeline in the CRM

- First qualified meetings booked and first deals in late-stage or closed

- Clear, weekly reporting rhythm established with Marketing

- Sharpened point of view on which ICPs convert fastest

 

## Benefits

 

- Remote, travel encouraged

- Credits for Outsite locations 

- Salary - $45,000 - $50,000 USD + commission

jobs.title: Junior CNC Machinist / CNC Operator
jobs.description:
Start your CNC career with a modern manufacturing company.

 

EasyPartz is looking for a motivated Junior CNC Machinist / CNC Operator who wants to build a long-term career in precision manufacturing.

You will become part of an experienced machining team and develop your skills through daily hands-on work, practical shop-floor learning, and mentorship from experienced CNC machinists. We are looking for people who enjoy practical work, take pride in producing high-quality components, and are eager to continuously develop their technical skills.

International candidates are welcome. For qualified applicants, EasyPartz can support the Danish work permit and visa application process where applicable.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate CNC milling and turning machines under the guidance of experienced machinists.

  • Assist with machine setup, tooling, and workholding.

  • Read and interpret technical drawings and manufacturing instructions.

  • Perform in-process and final measurements using inspection equipment.

  • Monitor machining operations and report deviations.

  • Maintain a clean, safe, and well-organized workplace in accordance with 5S principles.

  • Follow company procedures for quality, safety, and production reporting.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement and efficient workshop operations.

 

Requirements

We are looking for candidates who have:

  • Vocational education or practical experience in CNC machining, machining technology, metalworking, or a related mechanical field.

  • Basic understanding of CNC machining principles and manufacturing processes.

  • Ability to read technical drawings and use standard measuring equipment, or the willingness to develop these skills quickly.

  • Good mechanical aptitude and attention to detail.

  • A responsible attitude towards quality, safety, and teamwork.

  • English communication skills sufficient to work effectively in an international production environment.

  • Motivation to relocate to Denmark and build a long-term career with EasyPartz.

Experience with CNC milling, CNC turning, Fusion 360, Fanuc, Haas, or robotic machine tending is considered an advantage but is not required.

 

What We Offer

  • Permanent full-time employment.

  • Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.

  • Pension and private health insurance.

  • Mentorship from experienced CNC machinists.

  • Modern CNC machines and manufacturing technologies.

  • A clean, well-organized, and safety-focused production environment.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression within the company.

  • Support with relocation and Danish work permit processes for qualified international candidates.

 

About EasyPartz

EasyPartz is a growing Danish precision machining company located in Søborg, just outside Copenhagen. We specialize in CNC milling and turning, producing high-quality precision components for customers across Europe in industries where quality, precision, and reliability are essential.

We are building a digitally driven manufacturing environment, continuously investing in CNC technology, automation, robotics, and digital production systems. By combining skilled craftsmanship with modern manufacturing technologies and Lean principles, we are creating a workplace focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Whether you are starting your career or expanding your experience, you will work alongside skilled professionals in a collaborative environment where learning, responsibility, and continuous development are part of everyday work.

 

Apply

Please send us:

  • Your CV

  • A short introduction about yourself

  • Information about your education and machining experience

Applications are reviewed continuously, and the position will be filled as soon as the right candidate is found.

jobs.title: Professor / Associate Professor in Biomedical Innovation
jobs.description:
The Department of Biomedicine at Faculty of Health Sciences at Aarhus University invites applications for a position as Professor / Associate Professor per 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is a full-time permanent position.

This initiative is a direct extension of Aarhus University’s Strategy 2030, in which research-based innovation and entrepreneurship are central strategic priorities. To strengthen the university’s capacity to translate research into innovation, the university leadership has established a number of new research and innovation positions across Aarhus University. These positions are intended to foster an innovation mindset throughout the university while generating tangible societal impact through research, innovation, entrepreneurship, and collaboration.

The primary focus for this position is research-based innovation. We are looking for scientists with medical research background who sees opportunities in collaboration with the strong existing research groups at Aarhus University and Aarhus University Hospital and leading international institutions.

About the Department
The Department of Biomedicine provides research-based teaching of the highest quality and is responsible for a large part of the medical degree programme. The department employs approx. 600 people from all over the world, and they make use of the department's modern laboratory, core and animal facilities. The Department of Biomedicine focuses on innovation and entrepreneurship. You can read more about the department here and about the faculty here.

Your job responsibilities as Professor / Associate Professor
We offer an attractive career opportunity for researchers with a strong track record in medical research and innovation. The successful candidate is expected to:

  • strengthen the department’s research, innovation, and research-based teaching, and contribute to the academic development of Aarhus University and its national and international profile.

  • conduct original, internationally recognized research and demonstrate scientific excellence at the highest international level.

  • have experience with commercialization of research and technology including protection of intellectual property (IP) rights.

  • contribute to the Faculty of Health Sciences’ strategic priorities in innovation and collaboration by supporting the commercialization of research, building innovation capacity, and developing collaborations with external partners.

  • actively engage in Aarhus University’s innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystem and contribute to translating research into societal impact through innovation, entrepreneurship, spinouts, and collaborations with industry.

  • contribute to academic citizenship by actively engaging in the department's academic community and fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and respectful working environment.


An attractive start package can be negotiated.

You will report to the Head of Department Thomas G. Jensen.

Your competences as Professor / Associate Professor
You are ready to take co-responsibility for the development of the department's activites and for ensuring that we maintain a good work environment. You naturally involve yourself in interdisciplinary collaboration at departmental, faculty and university level as well as nationally and internationally. As a leader, you inspire others and build strong relationships with students, colleagues and partners.

We expect you to be fluent in oral and written English. International applicants are expected to learn Danish.

In the assessment of the candidates, consideration will be given to:

  • the ability to promote and utilize research results

  • experience with innovation activities

  • the ability to contribute to the development of internal and external cooperation

  • track record in attracting funding

  • visions within the research and innovation area

  • track record for commercialisation of research results, including protection of intellectual property

  • track record for fostering collaboration with industry

  • business development

  • experience and insight to the Danish life science industry

  • patenting, licensing and technology transfers

  • visions within the innovation area


In order to be assessed as qualified for a Professor position, you must meet these academic criteria.

In order to be assessed as qualified for an Associate Professor position, you must meet these academic criteria.

If you wish to apply for both positions, please submit two separate applications.

Shortlisting will be used.

Questions about the position
If you have any questions about the position, please contact Head of Department Thomas G. Jensen tel.: (+45) 2778 2805.

Your place of work will be the Department of Biomedicine, Høegh-Guldbergs Gade 10, DK-8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

We expect to conduct interviews in the beginning of November 2026.

Terms of employment - professor

  • In making the appointment, emphasis will be placed on a high degree of original production at an international level and experience from teaching at different levels as well as contributions to the development of teaching activities and teaching material, hereby documenting that the applicant has developed the academic discipline from a research and teaching perspective.

  • Moreover, there will be an assessment of the applicant’s ability to perform research and teaching management tasks.

  • The yearly base salary for a fulltime professor is DKK 866.461,38 (including a position related supplement, a pre-agreed professor supplement and pension (18.07%)). Additional supplement(s) can be negotiated dependent on experience, special qualifications and performance of special functions. Professors have the authority to negotiate pay on their own behalf.



Terms of employment – associate professor

  • Appointment as an associate professor requires research and teaching qualifications at the level that can be achieved through the satisfactory completion of a period of appointment as an assistant professor, but may also be obtained in other ways.

  • The applicant is required to have completed a university pedagogical programme or an equivalent programme.

  • The yearly base salary for a fulltime associate professor is DKK 706.233,06 (including a position related supplement, a pre-agreed associate professor supplememt and pension (18.07%)). Additional supplement(s) can be negotiated dependent on experience, special qualifications and performance of special functions. Authorisation supplement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at Aarhus University negotiates your salary on your behalf.



Other terms of employment

  • Further information on the appointment procedure can be found in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

  • The appointment is in accordance with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (Akademikerne).

  • Remuneration is in accordance with the above, and the Salary agreement catalogue for staff at Health.

  • Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate.

  • Travel and moving expenses may be covered according to the employee in question and, to a limited extent, the accompanying family.

  • Further information on qualification requirements and job description can be found in the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.



Application - professor
Your application must include the following:

  • Motivated application

  • Curriculum Vitae

  • Diploma

  • Template for applicant - professor

  • A list of publications

  • A teaching portfolio. We refer to Guideline on the use of teaching portfolios

  • The ten publications stated as the most important in the 'Template for applicant - professor' must be submitted

  • Research plan, which is part of the 'Template to applicant - professor' can be uploaded separately (optional)

  • Coauthor statement(s) can be uploaded (optional)

  • References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the e-recruitment system (optional)



Application – associate professor
Your application must include the following:

  • Motivated application

  • Curriculum Vitae

  • Diploma

  • Template for applicant - associate professor

  • A list of publications

  • A teaching portfolio. We refer to Guideline on the use of teaching portfolios

  • The five publications stated as the most important in the 'Template for applicant - associate professor' must be submitted

  • Research plan, which is part of the 'Template to applicant - associate professor' can be uploaded separately (optional)

  • Coauthor statement(s) can be uploaded (optional)

  • References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the e-recruitment system (optional)


We refer to the faculty’s Guidelines for applicants.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

International applicant?
Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including assistance with relocation and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information about the International Staff Office and the range of services here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

jobs.title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
jobs.description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

jobs.title: Instruktor/ Veespordijuhendaja (eFoil – elektriline lendav laud) suvehooajaks
jobs.description:
Oleme valmis värbama ka alaealisi. Hooajaline töö mere ääres — õpetad inimesi sõitma elektrilise surfiga, nautima elu ja tundma vabadust

Tööülesanded: Mida sa tegelikult teed?
Sa ei istu kontoris. Sa ei vasta e-kirjadele 8 tundi järjest. Hommikul tuled mere äärde. Päike tõuseb Tallinna lahel. Võtad vastu esimesed külalised — mõned erutunud, mõned natuke hirmul. Annad neile 15-20 minutit ohutusinstruktaaži. Selgitad. Naeratad. Tekitad usalduse. Lähed nendega vette või paadiga kõrval. Näed hetke, kui inimene esimest korda lendab üle vee. Nende nägu ütleb kõik. Filmid neid paadilt, kaldalt — sisu, mis läheb viraalseks. Hoolitsed varustuse eest nagu oma asja eest. Laed akud, puhastd tahvlid, hoiad kogu ala korras ja puhtana. Järgmine klient peab nägema täiuslikku — mitte seda, mis järele jäi. Õhtul — loojang mere kohal. Saun. Ice bath.Jacuzzi. Klientide tänulikud sõnad.

Omalt poolt pakume: Mida sa saad vastu?
→ Tasuta eFoil-sõit! Klientidele see maksab 200€ tunnis. Sinu jaoks — tasuta. → Töö maailma ühe coolima spordiga päikesetõusu ja -loojangu ajal → Tulemustasu + boonused → Sinu nägu on meie sotsiaalmeedia — ehitame koos brändi → Võimalus meiega kasvada — Euroopa, maailm on järgmised → Oled osa millestki, mida pole varem olnud — uue turu ehitamine

Muud nõuded: Keda me otsime?
→ Sa oled füüsiliselt aktiivne — see töö nõuab ikka jõudu, vastupidavust ja liikumist → Sa oskad hästi ujuda ja tunneksid end vabalt avatud vees → Suhtled inimestega loomulikult — see on su tugevus, mitte kohustus → Räägid eesti keelt + inglise ja boonuseks - vene keelt → Oled vastutustundlik ja rahulik ka siis, kui kõik ei lähe plaanipäraselt Me otsime inimest, kes näeb mis on vaja — ja teeb ära. Kes kliendi naeratuse nimel läheb sammu kaugemale ilma, et keegi paluks. Kes vee peal teeb kiireid otsuseid ise — rahulikult, kindlalt. Kes võtab vastutuse enda peale — mitte ei otsi, kelle peale näidata. Positiivsus ei ole siin soov. See on nõue. Energiat, initsiatiivi ja täielikku pühendumist — iga päev, mitte ainult headel päevadel. Suur boonus (aga mitte kohustuslik): → Kogemus surfimises, kite, wake, SUP või muus veespordis → Oled filminud videoid või tead, kuidas Instagram/TikTok toimib → Oled varem töötanud instruktori, giidi või teenindajana Pole kunagi eFoil'i sõitnud? Pole probleemi. Õpetame sind.

jobs.title: Product Sales Specialist - Pet Health (CST timezone)
jobs.description:
Must Love Dogs!!

At Tribe Wellness, we're more than just a tribe – we're a movement. Rooted in courage, empowerment, and integrity, we've pioneered solutions that transform the world's wellness brands into revenue-generating machines. We bridge the gap between brands and revenue by turning our clients’ customers into lifetime supporters, and we do that by turning good salespeople into great salespeople.

At Tribe Wellness Sales, we’re on a mission to help pets live longer, healthier lives through supplements that actually deliver. But here’s the catch: too many pet owners grab a product online and then flounder—unsure how to use it or missing the guidance to make it work. That’s where you, our Product Sales Specialist (called a Protocol Review Specialist in our world), make the difference. Without you, pets miss out on better health, owners lose confidence, and our mission stalls. With you? You’re the spark that turns a purchase into a transformation—for pets and their people.


What You'll Do:

  • Sell: You’ll sell products and services for our pet client, a company built for pet owners, by pet owners, with over a million happy dogs and growing!

  • Grow: Work with a broad range of potential customers, transforming clients’ prospects into brand loyalists.

  • Learn: Work closely with our dedicated leaders, leveraging our top-notch training resources to master the art of selling and representing Tribe's ethos.

  • Earn: Operate with no cap on commission, providing limitless earning potential to integrate with our operations seamlessly.

  • Live: Work from home in a global remote environment, utilizing our communication tools and platforms.

 

What's In It For You:

  • Earnings: This is a commission-only role. You will have between 8 and 18 appointments scheduled for you each day (more if you want them and you are closing sales). You will earn a 20% commission on the gross margin of every sale you make. Please tell us how much you want to earn, and we will show you what it takes to get there. Each sale is between $250 and $2,500.

  • The Tribe Tool Kit: We have a battle-tested tool kit we provide for all our sales consultants, including Rippling and Salesforce, ensuring you're primed for success the second you hit the phones.

  • Remote Work: You’ll have the freedom of a fully remote position, allowing for a work-life balance that suits your lifestyle.

  • Be Part of the Tribe: No matter your title, you’ll join a community that values partnership, advocacy, and growth. We believe in nurturing our team members and fostering an environment of collaboration, support, and mutual success.

 

What We’re Looking For:

  • Highly-driven self starters, who are motivated by growth opportunities and the drive to excel in sales.

  • Knowledge, background, or raw passion around health and wellness.

  • Excellent verbal and written skills, with top-notch communication skills and a knack for building genuine connections.

  • The ability to work 40 hours per week (8 hours per day) starting at 8 AM CST.

  • Reliable internet and equipment are required. Because this position involves frequent phone and video calls, you’ll need a setup that can support clear, uninterrupted conversations.

    This means you should have:

    • A fast and reliable laptop or desktop computer, with a working mic, camera, and a headset, so you can comfortably run our call system, Salesforce, and Zoom at the same time.

    • Ethernet connection strongly preferred because it provides the most consistent call quality. (Usually requires only an inexpensive cable you plug into your desktop/laptop and modem.)

    • Enough dedicated internet speed to support calls and video without freezing, delays, or dropped audio. Minimum [10] Mbps download / [5] Mbps upload of dedicated bandwidth, with latency under ~150ms, jitter under ~30ms, and packet loss under ~1%.

Join us if you’re ready to play a pivotal role in reshaping the world of pet health and wellness while thriving in a growth-centric global environment with amazing people. If that sounds like you, Tribe Wellness is your tribe. Apply today and work with a very different type of company.

jobs.title: Product Quality & Configuration Engineer
jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking a driven Product Quality & Compliance Engineer to lead product quality, digital traceability and defence compliance across our R&D, production, and supplier ecosystem.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product development, quality, and compliance. Your focus will be on owning and embedding digital traceability across our R&D and production processes, ensuring quality, consistency, and transparency throughout the product lifecycle, while maintaining and continually improving our ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System (QMS).

You will be Quadsat’s core quality and compliance ambassador both internally and externally, working across R&D, Production, Supply Chain, Commercial, and with our customers to ensure our products meet the highest standards without compromising the agility and innovation that define Quadsat.

A key part of the role will be to build and own the practical configuration management and digital traceability system that connects engineering work, product releases, BOMs, SBOMs, verification evidence, production builds, defects, and delivered product configurations.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for driving quality and compliance across our engineering and production ecosystem. On a day-to-day basis you can expect to:

  • Drive and govern product quality assurance from early concept and design stage through to verification, production, release and lifecycle support.

  • Build, own, and continuously improve Quadsat’s configuration management and digital traceability setup across tools such as Jira, Confluence, PDM, and production records, ensuring that product baselines, releases, BOMs, SBOMs, defects, deviations, and delivered product configurations are controlled and actively used.

  • Own the engineering governance and digital traceability framework in our Jira environment, including workflow and issue structures, traceability, dashboards, release planning and other related processes.

  • Support the R&D Director in managing development activities through Jira, ensuring that processes and requirements are effectively planned, tracked, and integrated into development and release workflows.

  • Coordinate development cycle reviews, compliance reporting, and engineering metrics using Jira data and provide insights to the R&D Director, developers and other stakeholders to enable informed quality-driven decision-making.

  • Coordinate internal and external product testing activities required to demonstrate product performance, quality, and compliance.

  • Lead compliance initiatives to prepare Quadsat's products and engineering processes for future qualification against defence and customer-specific standards, including frameworks such as MIL-STD, STANAG, AQAP, and DO-178, as required by our customers.

  • Maintain and continuously improve Quadsat's ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring effective governance, process maturity, and a culture of continuous improvement.

Skills & Experience

  • Educational background in engineering or technical field.

  • Proven experience working in a quality or compliance role, translating technical standards and compliance requirements into actionable engineering processes and development activities.

  • Strong project and stakeholder management capabilities.

  • Solid understanding of risk management, DFMEA, requirements management, verification, validation, and test coverage methodologies.

  • You are a Jira super user with hands-on experience setting up and maintaining practical engineering governance, configuration management, release management, defect tracking, traceability, and compliance workflows in Jira or similar systems.

  • A pragmatic mindset that balances agility, engineering effectiveness, and defense-grade quality expectations.

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

All candidates must be eligible to obtain security clearance with the Danish Defence and NATO authorities.

Our Dynamic Work Environment

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, pragmatic engineering, and people who want their work to have a lasting impact beyond individual projects.

About Quadsat

Quadsat develops and builds long-range electronic warfare payloads and software that support multi-domain military operations through fast and precise radio frequency detection and geolocation across the electromagnetic spectrum. Our technology enables defense organizations to maintain mission-critical connectivity, ensure resilient communication infrastructures, and achieve operational readiness.

Contact

For recruitment related questions please contact Aislinn Campbell, HR Director, by mail at afc@quadsat.com or by phone at +45 71 74 97 81.

jobs.title: Strategic Sourcing Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is growing quickly, and our Corporate Services needs are becoming more complex. We’re looking for a Sourcing Manager, Corporate Services to own strategic sourcing and supplier management across critical areas of our company.

In this role, you’ll partner closely with Finance, Legal, InfoSec, Privacy, IT, Compliance, HR, and Facilities to lead sourcing processes, negotiate commercial terms, manage supplier performance, and help teams make clear decisions across cost, quality, speed, risk, and experience.

We’re opening this role to bring strategic sourcing support earlier into the decision-making process, helping leaders clarify the right approach, surface trade-offs, and move faster with confidence as Notion scales. Done well, this role will drive savings and cost avoidance while helping us build supplier agreements that protect the business and support how our teams work.

You’ll be a close partner to our HR and Facilities teams in particular, building sourcing plans that translate business needs into the right supplier strategy, sourcing motion, and negotiation posture.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Deliver measurable savings and cost avoidance across Corporate Services spend, helping fund new initiatives while protecting service quality.

 - Build strategic procurement plans with business partners, starting with HR and Facilities/Real Estate, translating business needs into clear sourcing strategies and negotiation plans.

 - Operate as an extension of stakeholder teams—surfacing trade-offs early, aligning on decisions, and driving clean execution without last-minute fire drills.

 - Partner closely with Legal and Finance to structure deals the business can live with: clear commercial terms, understood budget impacts, and risk-aware contracting.

 - Reduce risk across our vendor portfolio by strengthening contract coverage, supplier governance, and performance management routines.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of experience in sourcing, procurement, category management, or a related field, including 3+ years owning Corporate Services categories such as Facilities/Real Estate, HR Services, Travel, Marketing Services, or Contingent Workforce.

 - Experience independently leading complex sourcing events end to end, including RFx, supplier evaluations, commercial negotiations, and contract execution.

 - Strong business judgment and analytical rigor, including spend analysis, benchmarking, building business cases, and measuring savings/cost avoidance.

 - Deep understanding of source to contract and procure to pay practices, with the ability to guide teams through intake, approvals, vendor onboarding, POs, and contract handoffs without slowing the business down.

 - Strong cross-functional partnership with teams such as Legal, Finance, InfoSec, Privacy, IT, and Compliance, including command of key commercial and legal terms and a track record of reducing risk while delivering value.




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $160,000 - $180,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Replit is changing who gets to build software. We are looking for a Director or VP of Communications to help lead Replit’s next chapter of storytelling, reputation building, and market awareness.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Trust & Safety
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're redefining how software is built and who gets to build it. Our mission is to achieve Autonomy for All: making programming accessible, collaborative, and powered by AI. Realizing that vision requires a platform that legitimate users can trust and adversarial actors cannot exploit.

We're hiring a Data Scientist to help build Replit's Trust & Safety and Anti-Abuse program from the ground up. You'll turn noisy behavioral, identity, payment, infrastructure, and content signals into the measurement systems, detections, and decisions that protect Replit's users, platform, and economics. You'll work closely with Engineering, Support, Legal, Security, Infrastructure, Money, and Growth to make abuse economically unviable while keeping friction low for legitimate users.



Replit sits at the frontier of AI-native abuse. Our platform is a target for phishing and scam hosting, cryptomining, LLM token farming, card and coupon fraud, referral abuse, and increasingly, abuse driven by AI agents themselves. You'll help define how we identify, measure, and respond to these threats without compromising the experience of good users.



WHO YOU ARE

You're a data scientist who moves fast, goes deep, and thinks adversarially. You can spin up an analysis in hours that would take others days, not by cutting corners, but because you've built the intuition and technical toolkit to get to the right answer quickly. You dig past the top-line abuse rate to understand selection effects, missing labels, policy changes, attacker adaptation, and the false positives hidden inside an aggregate metric.

You understand that Trust & Safety data is imperfect and outcomes are high stakes. Ground truth is delayed, biased, and often incomplete; attackers react to defenses; and an apparently effective rule can quietly harm legitimate users. You pressure-test your own work, quantify uncertainty, and distinguish correlation from evidence strong enough to justify enforcement.

You use AI agents and tools aggressively to multiply your output: writing code, exploring data, generating hypotheses, and prototyping investigations. But you treat every AI-assisted output as a draft, not a deliverable. You know what good analysis looks like and won't ship anything that doesn't meet that bar.



YOU WILL

 - Own the analytical foundation for Trust & Safety, including abuse prevalence, fraud loss, false-positive and false-negative rates, time to detect, time to mitigate, appeal and reversal rates, and verification step-up conversion.

 - Build reliable datasets and dbt models that connect product events, account and identity signals, payment activity, infrastructure usage, content classifications, enforcement actions, appeals, and support outcomes.

 - Develop and evaluate risk models, rules, and anomaly-detection systems for threats such as phishing, scam hosting, cryptomining, token farming, payment fraud, promotional abuse, and AI-agent exploitation.

 - Design rigorous offline evaluations, shadow-mode tests, holdouts, and controlled experiments to measure detection quality and the user impact of new policies, enforcement actions, and progressive verification.

 - Define thresholds and decision frameworks that balance abuse reduction, economic loss, customer friction, and false positives across free, paid, and enterprise users.

 - Investigate emerging abuse patterns, quantify their impact, identify coordinated behavior, and turn ambiguous signals into clear recommendations for product and engineering teams.

 - Develop predictive models that estimate account, device, transaction, workspace, or deployment risk and embed those signals into detection, review, and escalation workflows.

 - Partner with Support and Legal to improve case review, appeals, reason-code quality, and feedback loops so human decisions become useful model and policy signals.

 - Build monitoring that detects model drift, attacker adaptation, data-quality failures, and unexpected harm to legitimate users.

 - Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical partners, including the tradeoffs, uncertainty, and evidence behind high-impact decisions.



EXAMPLES OF WHAT YOU COULD DO

 - Build a measurement framework for Replit's abuse surface, reconcile incomplete labels across automated detections, human review, appeals, chargebacks, and support cases, and establish a trustworthy baseline for the first time.

 - Design and evaluate a risk-scoring model for suspicious account clusters using identity, device, payment, graph, and product-behavior signals, then define thresholds that materially reduce fraud while protecting legitimate users.

 - Analyze a phishing detection rule that appears highly precise, uncover that it disproportionately bans paying users with legitimate brand references, and redesign its evaluation and review path to reduce false positives.

 - Measure a progressive verification "ladder of trust," determining when to step users up to additional verification and quantifying the tradeoff between abuse prevented and legitimate-user conversion lost.

 - Detect coordinated token-farming or promotional-abuse networks by combining account-linkage graphs, referral behavior, payment patterns, and infrastructure usage, then partner with Engineering to operationalize the findings.

 - Evaluate a new enforcement policy in shadow mode, estimate its counterfactual impact, and recommend whether to launch, revise, or reject it before any users are affected.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years of experience in data science, product analytics, fraud, risk, trust and safety, or a related field.

 - Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience working with large behavioral datasets and building reliable data models or pipelines.

 - Experience developing and evaluating predictive models, experiments, or decision systems, with sound judgment around uncertainty and tradeoffs.

 - Ability to turn ambiguous data into clear recommendations and communicate them effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

 - Comfort working with imperfect labels, biased samples, and high-impact decisions where false positives matter.

 - You use AI tools extensively to increase your effectiveness while maintaining a high bar for analytical quality.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building or evaluating anti-abuse, fraud, identity, security, spam, integrity, or content-safety systems at scale.

 - Built, shipped, and maintained ML models in production (classification, anomaly detection, or risk scoring), including feature engineering on behavioral and transaction data, threshold selection against precision/recall economics, and post-launch monitoring

 - Experience with graph analysis, entity resolution, coordinated-behavior detection, reputation systems, anomaly detection, or risk scoring.

 - Experience measuring false positives and enforcement harm, designing human-review workflows, or using appeals and case outcomes as model feedback.

 - Familiarity with progressive verification, KYC, account trust, or identity providers such as Prove, Persona, Socure, or Stripe Identity.

 - Experience with causal inference methods such as difference-in-differences, propensity score methods, synthetic control, or uplift modeling.

 - Experience with a modern data stack such as dbt, BigQuery, Snowflake, Fivetran, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Segment.

 - Experience at a consumer platform, developer tool, cloud provider, marketplace, fintech company, or other product with a meaningful adversarial surface.



BONUS POINTS

 - You've built AI-powered analytical tools, investigation systems, automated detections, or novel measurement approaches.

 - You have experience with AI-native abuse such as prompt injection, LLM token farming, model extraction, or agent-driven abuse.

 - You understand freemium, usage-based, or promotional pricing models and the abuse incentives they create.

 - You've worked directly with operational review teams and can translate analytical signals into practical playbooks, queues, and escalation paths.

jobs.title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

jobs.title: Senior AI Builder
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


The AI Studio is the team responsible for designing, building, and operationalizing internal software platforms across every functional department of the company, including People Operations, Customer Support, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Recruiting, and Executive Operations. We treat each internal department as its own product surface, and in truth as its own startup, with its own customers, its own metrics, and its own reasons for existing. We ship custom software, built on Replit’s own platform, to solve operational problems that off-the-shelf SaaS tools cannot serve well at our scale and pace of growth.





POSITION SUMMARY

The Member of Technical Staff (AI Builder) is a full-time builder role with substantial autonomy. You will design, architect, and ship AI-powered internal platforms that run the operations of the company across many departments at once. This is not a role for someone who wants a narrow, well-defined lane. It is a role for someone who wants to walk into an ambiguous business problem, understand it well enough to argue about it with the department lead, and then ship the software that fixes it.

We are looking for people who genuinely understand the mechanics of a business: how revenue is actually made, why recruiting velocity matters, what makes support scale or break, how finance closes a month, and why each department is critical to whether the company wins or loses. You do not need to have run every function, but you need to respect why each one exists and be able to reason about it like an operator, not just an engineer.

Because we treat each department as its own startup, we strongly favor people who have either run their own business or worked on a fast-scaling startup. You know what it feels like to build with incomplete information, to ship before it is comfortable, and to own an outcome rather than a ticket. The work is genuinely a ton of fun, and it is also demanding: it rewards diplomacy, creativity, technical depth, and business acumen in roughly equal measure. You will move fast, work long hours when it matters, and switch fluidly between a deep technical conversation and a conversation with a non-technical stakeholder who just needs their problem solved.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



INTERNAL PLATFORM DESIGN AND ENGINEERING

 - Design, architect, and ship custom AI-powered internal platforms that serve specific operational needs across Replit’s functional departments, including but not limited to People Operations, Customer Support, Sales, Recruiting, Marketing, Finance, and Executive Operations.

 - Translate ambiguous, often non-technical business requirements into technical specifications, system architectures, and shipped software products.

 - Own platform development end-to-end, including front-end interfaces, back-end services, data models, third-party integrations, and AI model orchestration.

Applied AI and Large Language Model Engineering

 - Architect multi-stage AI pipelines incorporating large language models, including prompt engineering, tool-call architecture, structured output generation, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic workflows.

 - Conduct model selection across multiple frontier and open-source providers, evaluating models against cost per query, latency, output quality, reliability, and task-specific performance.

 - Design and implement evaluation frameworks for AI features, including test datasets, scoring rubrics, and regression tests, so that AI-driven workflows stay reliable in production.

 - Optimize AI systems for cost and performance, including the appropriate use of lighter-weight models for qualification passes, batching strategies for high-throughput workloads, and caching architectures.

Business Understanding and Stakeholder Partnership

 - Treat each internal department as its own startup: understand its goals, its constraints, and the metrics that define whether it is succeeding.

 - Partner directly with department leads to identify operational inefficiencies, scope solutions, and prioritize the work that creates the most leverage.

 - Conduct stakeholder interviews, lead requirements-gathering sessions, and translate qualitative feedback into iterative product improvements.

 - Present technical work and operational outcomes to executive leadership, including the President and senior staff, and do it in language each audience can act on.

Third-Party System Integration

 - Design and implement integrations with the third-party platforms used at Replit, including enterprise HR platforms, support ticketing systems, CRM platforms, applicant tracking systems, project management tools, and identity providers.

 - Evaluate third-party APIs, SDKs, and data schemas, and design integration architectures appropriate to scale, security, and maintainability requirements.

Production Operations and Reliability

 - Maintain and operate shipped platforms in production, including dependency management, security updates, observability, error handling, and performance monitoring.

 - Respond to production incidents and continuously iterate on shipped platforms based on user feedback and operational telemetry.

Documentation and Knowledge Transfer

 - Document architectural decisions, system designs, and operational procedures for shipped platforms.

 - Onboard future team members and contribute to the evolution of the AI Studio as the function scales.




WHO YOU ARE

 - You understand how a business actually works and can explain why each department matters to the company winning.

 - You have either run your own business or worked on a fast-scaling startup, and you carry the ownership instinct that comes with it.

 - You are comfortable with long hours and a very high pace, and you treat that as part of the fun rather than a cost.

 - You can engage credibly with both deeply technical people and non-technical stakeholders, often in the same afternoon.

 - You bring diplomacy, creativity, technical knowledge, and business acumen, and you know when each one is the tool the moment calls for.

 - You would rather ship something real and iterate than wait for perfect information.
   
   


EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Technology Management, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a closely related technical or technology-business hybrid field. Equivalent foreign degrees acceptable subject to credential evaluation. Exceptional non-traditional backgrounds with a strong shipped portfolio will be considered.

 - A demonstrated portfolio of shipped software products, including AI-powered applications, and the ability to discuss technical architecture, design trade-offs, and engineering decisions in detail.

 - Experience either running your own business or working at a fast-scaling startup, with real exposure to how the business operated end-to-end.

 - Working proficiency in modern software engineering practices, including version control, code review, deployment pipelines, and production debugging.

 - Hands-on experience with one or more large language model providers and their APIs, tool-calling interfaces, and structured output mechanisms.

 - Demonstrated experience designing prompt and tool-call architectures, conducting model selection across providers, and optimizing AI systems for cost and latency.

 - Programming proficiency in Python and TypeScript or JavaScript, including familiarity with relevant frameworks for AI application development.

 - Experience with relational databases, SQL, and modern data tooling.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present technical work to non-technical stakeholders.

 - Demonstrated ability to operate with autonomy in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Prior experience as a founder, co-founder, or early team member at a venture-backed startup, particularly one with an AI-native product.

 - Prior experience in technology investment analysis or operational consulting, with a demonstrated ability to evaluate business operations and identify high-leverage interventions.

 - Hands-on experience building on the Replit platform, including familiarity with Replit Agent and Replit Deployments.

 - Experience designing and shipping internal tools at a high-growth technology company.

 - Multilingual proficiency, particularly in languages relevant to Replit’s international customer base, including Italian, Portuguese, Spanish, or other major commercial languages.

 - Experience with mobile application development frameworks, including React Native and Expo.
   
   


TRAVEL AND LOCATION REQUIREMENTS

This position is based in Foster City, California, with secondary work performed at the company’s San Francisco, California office. The company operates on a hybrid in-person schedule, with employees expected to be in-office Monday, Wednesday, and Friday in Foster City, and Tuesday and Thursday in San Francisco. Occasional domestic travel may be required for company offsites and customer engagements.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings
